izzyondroid:cgeo.geocaching.name: c:geo
izzyondroid:cgeo.geocaching.description:
c:geo is an open source, full-featured, always ready-to-go unofficial client for geocaching.com and offers basic support for other geocaching platforms (such as Opencaching). It does not require a web browser or exports - just install it and start right away.
 Main features: 
 View caches on a Live Map
 Use Google Maps or OpenStreetMap
 Search for caches by various criteria
 Log your finds online or offline
 Store cache information on your device
 Create and manage waypoints
 Navigate using compass, map, or other apps
 Import/Export GPX files
 Full support for trackables
 Offline caching functions including offline maps
 c:geo is a simple to use but powerful geocaching client with a lot of additional features. All you need to get started is an existing account on geocaching.com or another geocaching platform (like Opencaching). Find caches using the live map or by using one of the many search functions.
 Navigate to a cache or a waypoint of a cache with the built-in compass function, the map or hand over the coordinates to various external apps (e.g. Radar, Google Navigation, StreetView, Locus, Navigon, Sygic and many more).
 Store cache information to your device directly from geocaching.com as well as via GPX file import to have it available whenever you want. You can manage your stored caches in different lists and can sort and filter them according to your needs. Stored caches together with offline map files or static maps can be used to find caches without an internet connection (e.g. when roaming). Logs can be posted online or stored offline for later submission or exported via field notes.
 Search and discover trackables, manage your trackable inventory and drop a Trackable while posting a cache log.
 If you have problems installing or using c:geo please first have a look at our FAQ or consult the user guide . If there are still problems, contact support via email.
 If you would like to know why c:geo needs the permissions requested, please check here for an explanation.

izzyondroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.name: Webview Kiosk
izzyondroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.summary: Turn your Android device into a locked-down web page in fullscreen mode.
izzyondroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.description:
Webview Kiosk is a free and open-source Android application for secure, kiosk-style web browsing.
It can function as digital signage, a kid-friendly restricted browser, an immersive web reader, an interactive sign-up form, a home assistant dashboard, or simply a wall clock.
Designed for small businesses and device owners who are looking for a simple and standalone Kiosk solution.
Key Features
 Core / Standalone 
- Lock Task Mode (Pin): prevent access to your device's home screen, apps and status bar
- Secure Settings: configurations are protected by biometrics, device credentials or custom password
- URL Filtering: use regular expressions to control web access through a URL blacklist and whitelist
- Export/Import: backup and restore user settings in Base64 or JSON format
- Local files: display images, audio, video, HTML or PDF (using Mozilla's PDF.js) in kiosk mode
- Default Launcher: use as the home app and launch other apps in lock task mode (kiosk)
- JS Scripts: supports NFC (Near Field Communication), Eruda console, Dark Reader and custom scripts
- Adblock: blocks ads and trackers using rules from uBlock Origin, AdGuard, EasyList and HaGeZi
 Remote Management / Enterprise 
1. MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport)
- Monitor events, update settings, execute commands and build custom automations
- Requires an MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, or their HomeAssistant integrations)
2. UnifiedPush
- Send commands and update settings via a decentralised push notification system
- Requires a distributor application (e.g. sunup, ntfy, gCompat-UP)
3. Managed Configurations (App Restrictions)
- For fully-managed (company-owned) devices, settings can be configured via an MDM/EMM provider
- Advanced users with a device policy controller (e.g. Test DPC or OwnDroid) can also enforce configurations locally
For more details, visit https://webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk
Permissions
- INTERNET : general web browsing
- ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE : refresh web pages when network connectivity is restored
- ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK : (optional, Android 17+) web apps needing LAN
- CAMERA : (optional) web apps requiring photo/video capture
- RECORD_AUDIO : (optional) web apps requiring audio capture
- MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS : routing audio - needed for microphone
- ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION : (optional) web apps requiring precise geolocation
- ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION : (optional) web apps requiring approximate geolocation
- NFC : read/write NFC tags using hardware
- VIBRATE : (optional) web apps requiring navigator.vibrate(pattern)
- INSTALL_SHORTCUT : home screen launcher shortcuts on Android 7.1 and below
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES : find launchable apps, device owners and lock task packages
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS : (optional) for lock task mode launches and MQTT
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE : persistent notification for required services
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE : return mechanism after opening apps in kiosk
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK : background audio/video streaming, e.g. YouTube
- USE_BIOMETRIC : replaces USE_FINGERPRINT from Android 9.0 onwards
- USE_FINGERPRINT : fingerprint hardware for authentication
- WAKE_LOCK : (optional) wake screen when receiving MQTT commands
- WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE : download files in Android 9.0 and below
- API (Dhizuku) : request shared owner privileges
- API_23 (Shizuku) : auto-activate device/profile owner
Contact
- https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk
- support@webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk
Alternatives

fdroid:ch.hgdev.toposuite.name: TopoSuite
fdroid:ch.hgdev.toposuite.description:
TopoSuite for Android is an application that targets land surveyors by helping
them determining new geographical points based on measurements and offering some
utilities. It is able to do the following calculations:
Polar calculations:
* station orientation
* free station
* polar survey
* polar implantation
* axis implantation
Orthogonal calculations:
* orthogonal survey
* orthogonal tracking
* orthogonal implantation
Intersections calculations:
* lines intersections
* circles intersections
* line / circle intersections
Surface calculations:
* surface included with arc of a circle
* parallel limit displacement regarding compulsory surface
Miscellaneous:
* field / distance
* point projection on a line
* circle computation using three points
* arc of a circle segmentation
Mathematics:
* triangle solver
* circular elements resolution
Data, such as points, can be imported into the application from CSV, LTOP or PTP
file formats and exported to CSV. The history of all the calculations, the
points and application settings can be exported to file (*.tpst) which can be
imported into other instances of the application or simply later on.

This is a fork of the Syncthing-Android wrapper for Syncthing that brings major enhancements like:

fdroid:com.megamaced.nccollectives.name: NC Collectives
fdroid:com.megamaced.nccollectives.summary: Unofficial Android client for Nextcloud Collectives wiki notebooks.
fdroid:com.megamaced.nccollectives.description:
An unofficial native Android client for the Nextcloud Collectives app — wiki-style markdown notebooks hosted on your own Nextcloud server.
Features:
* Five tabs: Home, Collectives, Search, Favorites and Alerts, each keeping its place. Phones get a bottom navigation bar; wide screens get a navigation rail.
* Home, from the local cache so it works offline: edits waiting to sync or in conflict, new alerts, and cards for the pages you opened recently, pages changed since you read them, recently updated pages and your own edits, each with See all for the full list. Plus the tags across every collective.
* Alerts: mentions of you, and changes to pages in collectives set to notify you. Dismissing one clears it on the server too. In-app only: no system notifications.
* Collectives and nested page trees, sorted A–Z, Z–A, newest or oldest first. Pages can also follow the custom order shared with the web app, and be dragged within their parent.
* Markdown rendering with images, links, task lists, tables, syntax-highlighted code blocks, Nextcloud Text callouts (INFO / WARN / ERROR / SUCCESS) and ==highlight== marks. [[Page Name]] wikilinks and relative .md links open in the app; page text can be selected and copied.
* Each page lists its subpages, the pages that link to it, and its headings.
* View-first, with a floating Edit button; the bars slide away as you scroll. Pages can open straight into the editor instead: as each collective is set on the web, or always, under Settings → Editor. Two editors: a native markdown editor with a formatting toolbar and a preview, which works offline (the default), and a collaborative editor backed by Nextcloud Text (beta — real-time editing with others) when the server offers it and you're online.
* Offline reading and editing. Edits made offline are queued, and each is sent against the version it was written from: when the server reports that someone else changed the page meanwhile, your text is kept as a draft beside theirs and you choose which wins.
* Search across every collective through Nextcloud's unified search, with recent searches and tags offered before you type.
* Favorites, grouped by collective.
* Page tags, emoji, rename, move and duplicate; trash and restore, with Undo. Create collectives, change their emoji, and trash, restore or delete them.
* Attachments: inline images, camera or gallery uploads, and other files in a page's folder.
* Quick capture from any app's Share menu: text, links, or images.
* Several Nextcloud accounts, switched without signing out.
* Light, Dark or System theme, and a page text size for pages and both editors.
* Background sync every 1, 6 or 12 hours, daily, or never; pull to refresh; and Sync now.
* Manual update check for installs from GitHub: Settings → About asks GitHub for the latest release only when you tap it. F-Droid users can ignore it: F-Droid updates the app.
Requirements:
* Android 10 (API 29) or newer.
* A Nextcloud instance with the Collectives app installed, served over HTTPS. Plain http:// server addresses are refused.
Signing in uses Nextcloud Login Flow v2: you approve the app in your browser, and your server gives it a device-scoped app password. The app never sees your account password, and you can revoke the device at any time from your Nextcloud security settings.
Privacy:
* The app talks only to the Nextcloud server you configure. The one exception is the update check, which contacts api.github.com only when you tap it, on a separate HTTP client that never carries your Nextcloud credentials.
* No Google Play Services. No Firebase. No analytics. No telemetry. No crash reporters. No advertising IDs.
* The app password is stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences (Tink-backed). Signing out deletes it, along with every cached page and setting.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Nextcloud GmbH or the Nextcloud Collectives team. "Nextcloud" and "Collectives" are trademarks of their respective owners.

fdroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.name: Dhizuku
fdroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.summary: A tool that can share Device Owner permissions to other applications.
fdroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.description:
This app can delegate functions from the device owner.
That is, this app acts as an intermediary to call functions from the device owner.
Normally, this authority can only be delegated to one app, but Dhizuku allows you to delegate the full authority of the device owner to other apps.
It's easy to set up (ex: Shizuku, QR code).
For more information, please see the tutorial .
Usage example, it is ideal when you need to support two or more device owner permissions at the same time.
Specifically, in Japan, you need to support both Aurora Store and Test DPC on a device with some limited functionality.
Even if the app developer does not support Dhizuku, you can force support for Dhizuku by using the Dhizuku-API-Xposed module.

fdroid:com.starry.myne.summary: Android application to download & read ebooks from the Project GutenBerg.
fdroid:com.starry.myne.description:
Myne is a FOSS Android application for downloading and reading ebooks from Project Gutenberg. It uses the GutenDex API to fetch metadata for ebooks in the backend. Additionally, it functions as an EPUB reader, allowing you to easily import and immerse yourself in your favorite EPUB books!
Highlights:
- Clean & beautiful UI based on Google's material design three guidelines.
- Browse and download over 70k free ebooks available in multiple languages and updated daily.
- Comes with inbuilt ebook reader while also having an option to use third-party ebook readers
- Compatible with Android 7.0 and above (API 24+)
- Supports Material You theming in devices running on Android 12+
- Comes in both light and dark mode.
- MAD: UI and logic written with pure Kotlin. Single activity, no fragments, only composable destinations.
PS: *The name of the app is inspired from the main character of an anime called Ascendance of a Bookworm.*
Note: The app also uses the Google Books API to fetch some extra data like book summary and pages count etc, as the GutenBerg project don't include those values in their metadata. It tries it's best to map the data received from Google books with Gutenberg's metadata but the mapping is not 100% accurate and not all books available on GutenBerg is also available on Google books or is available but with different title, so you may find some books without summary or page count etc.

fdroid:info.metadude.android.divoc.sched.description:
Programm App für das Digital Verteiltes Online-Chaos.
https://di.c3voc.de
Wir spielen gerade ein sehr gefährliches Spiel auf unserem Planeten und jedes Mal, wenn wir sehen, dass es uns und unsere Lebensgrundlage zerstört, drücken wir dennoch immer wieder auf „continue“. In Wirklichkeit wird nur – wenn überhaupt – ein kompletter Reboot helfen, sowohl politisch als auch wirtschaftlich, sozial und auch kulturell. Wir haben nur eine Erde als Hardware und unser Life-Support läuft aus.
Dabei ist die Diskussion, ob etwas getan werden muss, ehrlich gesagt auch schon durch. Deshalb muss jetzt endlich darüber geredet werden, was getan werden soll und wie. Und so ist das Motto des DiVOC zu Ostern „Reboot to Respawn“.
 Funktionen: 
* Tagesüberblick über alle Programmpunkte (Vorträge und Self-Organized Sessions)
* Beschreibung von Veranstaltungen lesen
* Veranstaltungen in persönlicher Favoritenliste verwalten
* Favoritenliste exportieren
* Alarm für Veranstaltungen setzen
* Veranstaltungen in Kalender eintragen
* Link zu Veranstaltungen mit anderen teilen
* Programmänderungen einsehen
* Bewertungen und Kommentare für Vorträge und Workshops hinterlassen
* Integration mit dem Engelsystem-Projekt https://engelsystem.de - Online-Tool für Helfer- und Schichtplanung auf großen Events
* Integration mit Chaosflix https://github.com/NiciDieNase/chaosflix - Android App für https://media.ccc.de, teile Fahrplan-Favoriten mit Chaosflix und importiere sie als Bookmarks
🔤 Unterstützte Sprachen 
(Programmtexte ausgenommen)
* Deutsch
* Englisch
* Französisch
* Italienisch
* Japanisch
* Niederländisch
* Polnisch
* Portugiesisch
* Russisch
* Spanisch
* Schwedisch
💡 Inhaltliche Fragen zum Programm kann nur das Content-Team vom DiVOC beantworten. Diese App stellt lediglich das Programm zur Verfügung.
💣 Fehlerberichte sind herzlich willkommen, aber achte darauf, dass du erklärst, wie man den Fehler reproduzieren kann. Bitte nutze den Issue-Tracker: https://github.com/EventFahrplan/EventFahrplan/issues.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=info.metadude.android.congress.schedule

Rediscover the joy of reading your favorite writers and publications with Unread. Unread is an RSS reader with beautiful typography, comfortable gesture-based navigation, and a variety of color themes. Unread is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Capabilities include:
SYNCING: Our free Unread Cloud service keeps your devices in sync. Unread also syncs with BazQux Reader, Birchfeed, Feedbin, Feedly, FreshRSS, Gobbler, Inkwell, Inoreader, Miniflux, and NewsBlur.
AUTOMATIC WEBPAGE TEXT: For feeds that contain only article summaries, Unread will display the full article text from the webpage. Easily switch between feed text and webpage text for any article, and change the default for individual feeds.
WEBSITE ACCOUNTS: For news websites that require an account, sign in and get full webpage text.
SUBSCRIBE IN UNREAD: This share sheet extension lets you subscribe to a website’s feeds while visiting that website from Safari or any other web browser.
SAVE TO UNREAD: This share sheet extension creates an article in Unread with the contents of the webpage you are visiting from Safari or any other web browser. (Subscription required.)
COLOR THEMES: Unread provides a variety of color themes. Choose one theme for light mode and another for dark mode.
CACHING: Unread caches webpage text and images for instant loading and offline access. (Subscription required.)
READ-LATER SERVICES: Unread can save articles to Anybox, Flyleaf, GoodLinks, Instapaper, Matter, Pinboard, Plinky, Quick Reads, Raindrop.io, Readwise, Safari Reading List, and wallabag. On a device with a hardware keyboard, assign a custom keyboard shortcut to each. (Subscription required.)
SHORTCUTS: Perform shortcuts on articles and links inside articles. On a device with a hardware keyboard, assign a custom keyboard shortcut to each. (Subscription required.)
---
“Just a gorgeous app.”
– John Gruber, Daring Fireball
“Most importantly, I should stress again how refreshing it feels to have such a great native experience with Unread. The app is really fast, even when it’s loaded up with hundreds of feeds.”
— Niléane Dorffer, MacStories
“It’s an RSS reader made with taste. It has great typography, themes, search, and compatibility with the usual suspects. I love having this app on my Mac.”
— David Sparks, MacSparky
---
Unread has full VoiceOver coverage. Every screen and every feature is available to users with vision impairments:
• From any screen you can perform a magic tap, a two-finger double tap, to open a menu of options available for that screen.
• When on an article list, there are actions available for each article in the list. After selecting an article, invoke the accessibility rotor and then select “Actions”. There is an action to mark the article read or unread, an action to share the article, and many others.
• Use the VoiceOver escape gesture, a two-finger “Z”, to back out of the current screen.
---
UNREAD SUBSCRIPTION
Unread is a free app. Additional functionality is available with a $29.99 (USD)/year auto-renewing subscription:
• Article actions for sending articles directly to supported bookmarking and read later services, and for sharing via email or iMessage.
• Ability to execute shortcuts on articles and links.
• Caching of webpage text and images.
• Widget customization options.
• Save to Unread share sheet extension.
• Custom app icons.
• Premium support.
A subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Unread’s Terms of Use are available at:
https://www.goldenhillsoftware.com/unread/terms-of-use/

apple-macos:6503129481.name: Freak Workouts: Training
apple-macos:6503129481.summary: Download Freak Workouts: Training by The Freak Company, LLC on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Freak Workouts…
apple-macos:6503129481.description:
Freak Workouts is a focused training companion for people who want to stay consistent, train without breaking focus, and understand the work behind their progress.
Log every set as it happens. Review your volume, exercises, and muscle groups with clarity. Whether you train in a gym, at home, or across both, Freak Workouts turns individual sessions into a precise record of your training.
TRAIN WITHOUT LEAVING THE ZONE
Your phone should support the workout, not interrupt it.
– Log exercises, sets, reps, and load as you train
– Keep a clear view of the work already completed
– Compare your current session with your previous records
– Quickly apply 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, or 100% of your maximum exercise weight
– Keep every exercise log structured, readable, and easy to review later
SEE WHAT YOUR TRAINING IS MISSING
Progressive overload is not about chasing a single number. It is about staying consistent, seeing what you have done, and noticing what needs more attention.
– Review your training history across days, weeks, and months
– Follow total volume over time
– See volume and sets for each muscle group
– Review weight and volume for individual exercises
– Use a clear record of your work to spot gaps before they become plateaus
EXERCISES WITH CONTEXT
Freak Workouts starts with the muscles you want to train.
– Select the muscle groups relevant to your training
– Build your exercise collection from a curated catalogue
– Explore foundational lifts and modern movements
– Read muscle-group descriptions and view clear illustrations
– Create your own exercises and muscle groups when your training requires something specific
A RECORD YOU CAN RETURN TO
Every session becomes part of a larger picture: the exercises you performed, the load you moved, the volume you accumulated, and the muscle groups you trained.
Without the noise and unnecessary layers, just a clean, focused place to train with attention and overload progressively.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.thefreakcompany.com/apps/workouts/privacy
Terms of Use:

flathub:com.boxy_svg.BoxySVG.name: Boxy SVG
flathub:com.boxy_svg.BoxySVG.description:
Boxy SVG project goal is to create the best tool for editing SVG files. For beginners as well as for
 professional designers and developers. On any device and operating system.
 === Core features: === 
 Clean and intuitive UI heavily inspired by Inkscape, Sketch and Adobe Illustrator
 Extensive support for on-canvas editing of object geometry, transform, paint and other properties
 Save to SVG and SVGZ formats, export to PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF and HTML5
 Integration with Pixabay and other libraries with millions of free stock photos and vector assets
 Google Fonts integration with hundreds of free fonts
 Configurable keyboard shortcuts for over 100 commands
 Manual guides, smart guides and grid
 Path operations (unite, intersect, subtract, exclude, close, reverse, etc.)
 Arrangement operations (align to, rotate, flip, order, group, etc.)
 === For web developers: === 
 Chromium-based rendering engine
 SVG and CSS code inspector similar to Chrome Dev Tools
 Clean SVG output that preserves IDs, classes, titles and other metadata
 SVG sprites editing support
 This is official package that is published, maintained and supported by Boxy SVG developer.

flathub:com.github.fontmatrix.Fontmatrix.name: Fontmatrix
flathub:com.github.fontmatrix.Fontmatrix.summary: Organise, inspect and compare your fonts
flathub:com.github.fontmatrix.Fontmatrix.description:
Fontmatrix is a font manager for graphic designers and typesetters who work with hundreds or
 thousands of fonts and do not want to browse overly long lists in dialogs.
 With it you can:
 Activate and deactivate fonts for the other applications
 Tag fonts and group them into sets
 Find fonts with simple or combined filters: tags, metadata, PANOSE classification
 Inspect a font in detail: glyphs, OpenType features, name and TrueType tables
 Compare the glyphs of several fonts on top of each other
 Produce font books as PDF and extract the fonts embedded in a PDF file

flathub:com.github.kalibari.audok.name: Audok
flathub:com.github.kalibari.audok.summary: A free, open source music player
flathub:com.github.kalibari.audok.description:
Audok is a simple linux folder based music player with streamripper and converter support.
 Audok is written in python3, the graphical user interface uses gtk3.
 Audok is a free software under the GPL license.
 Features:
 play mp3,wav,flac files
 youtube-dl support (mp3 downloader)
 streamripper support
 record wav files
 covert wav,ts,flac,mp4 to mp3

flathub:com.nitrokey.nitrokey-app.name: Nitrokey App
flathub:com.nitrokey.nitrokey-app.description:
Nitrokey is an open source/open hardware USB key supporting secure encryption and signing.
 This package installs the official application to manage the features of the different USB keys.

flathub:eu.grimripper.grimripper.name: Grim Ripper
flathub:eu.grimripper.grimripper.description:
Grim Ripper is a graphical audio CD ripper. It fetches CD metadata from online databases and compresses the tracks.
 Supported codecs: WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC, Opus, Wavpack, Musepack, AAC, and Monkey's audio files.
 Features:
 Uses CDDB to name and tag each track.
 Creates M3U playlists
 Can encode to multiple formats in one session
 Simultaneous rip and encode
 Does not require a specific desktop environment

flathub:io.github.BuddySirJava.SSH-Studi.name: SSH Studio
flathub:io.github.BuddySirJava.SSH-Studi.description:
SSH Studio is a native desktop application for managing SSH configuration files. It provides a user-friendly interface to create, edit, and validate SSH hosts without needing to use terminal editors.
 The application offers both visual and text-based editing modes. The visual editor lets you fill in common SSH fields like Host, HostName, User, Port, and IdentityFile with form-based inputs. For advanced users, the raw text editor provides direct access to the configuration with live syntax validation and diff highlighting.
 Key features include inline validation to catch duplicate aliases and syntax errors, search and filtering capabilities, SSH key management tools, and safe saving with automatic backups. The interface is designed for GNOME with support for both light and dark themes.

flathub:io.github.arunsivaramanneo.GPUVi.name: GPU-Viewer
flathub:io.github.arunsivaramanneo.GPUVi.summary: A front-end to glxinfo, vulkaninfo, clinfo and es2_info
flathub:io.github.arunsivaramanneo.GPUVi.description:
This application aims to capture all the important details of glxinfo, vulkaninfo and clinfo
 in a GUI. The project is being developed using python 3 pygobject with GTK4. All the important
 details are extracted using glxinfo/vulkaninfo/clinfo with the combination of grep, CAT , AWK commands
 and displayed in the front-end. There is no hard OpenGL Programming involved, until glxinfo, vulkaninfo
 and clinfo works the GPU-viewer will also work.

flathub:io.github.nate_xyz.Conjure.name: Conjure
flathub:io.github.nate_xyz.Conjure.description: Apply various ImageMagick commands to your images, including resizing, cropping, rotating, flipping, and applying filters and effects.

flathub:io.github.sugarycandybar.Hosty.name: Hosty
flathub:io.github.sugarycandybar.Hosty.description:
Hosty simplifies the process of creating and managing Minecraft servers on Linux. It removes
 technical barriers by automating the installation of necessary server files and handling the required
 Java runtimes for you.
 Built-in Modrinth browser for easy discovery and mod installation
 Integrated Playit support for hosting without manual port forwarding
 Graphical interface for viewing performance and editing server properties
 Dedicated tools to create and restore server backups

flathub:org.kde.kdenlive.name: Kdenlive
flathub:org.kde.kdenlive.description:
Kdenlive is a video editing application with support for many audio and video formats. It offers
 advanced editing features, a variety of effects and transitions, color correction, audio post-production
 and subtitling tools. Additionally, it provides the flexibility to render into practically any
 format of your choice.
 Features:
 Nested Sequences
 Configurable interface and shortcuts
 Scopes: Histogram, Vectorscope, RGB Parade, Waveform and Audio Meter
 Proxy editing
 Free online assets and templates
 Motion tracking
 AI powered tools

flathub:org.simondalvai.pocket-broomball.name: Pocket Broomball
flathub:org.simondalvai.pocket-broomball.description:
The coolest winter sport has finally come to your Linux machine!
 Win the Championship and unlock all the 100+ real-world teams of the following leagues
 North American Broomball League
 Maritime Broomball Association
 Penrith Broomball competition
 Ontario League
 Italian Broomball League
 Swiss Broomball Association A + B
 International Women League
 International League
 Main features
 100+ real-world teams
 20+ different styled balls to collect
 Privacy friendly
 Offline game
 Created with Godot Engine 3
 PS: If you want to add a broomball team to the game, send me a mail at info@simondalvai.org

flathub:org.thonny.Thonny.name: Thonny
flathub:org.thonny.Thonny.description:
Thonny is a simple Python IDE with features useful for learning programming. It comes with a
 debugger which is able to visualize all the conceptual steps taken to run a Python program (executing
 statements, evaluating expressions, maintaining the call stack). There is a GUI for installing
 3rd party packages and special mode for learning about references.
 See the homepage for more information, screenshots and a walk-through video.

flathub:re.fossplant.songrec.name: SongRec
flathub:re.fossplant.songrec.description:
SongRec is an unofficial Shazam client for Linux, written in Rust. It allows you to easily recognize
 songs from your speakers, microphone or audio files.
 Features:
 - Recognize tracks from an arbitrary audio file.
 - Recognize audio from the microphone.
 - Usage from both GUI and command line.
 - Provide an history of the recognized songs on the GUI, exportable to CSV.
 - Continuous song detection from the microphone, with the ability to choose your input device.
 - Ability to recognize songs from your speakers rather than your microphone.

fedora-packages:dispenso/dispenso.name: dispenso
fedora-packages:dispenso/dispenso.summary: A library for working with sets of tasks in parallel
fedora-packages:dispenso/dispenso.description: Dispenso is a library for working with sets of tasks in parallel. It provides mechanisms for thread pools, task sets, parallel for loops, futures, pipelines, and more. Dispenso is a well-tested C++14 library designed to have minimal dependencies (some dependencies are required for the tests and benchmarks), and designed to be clean with compiler sanitizers (ASAN, TSAN). Dispenso is currently being used in dozens of projects and hundreds of C++ files at Meta (formerly Facebook). Dispenso also aims to avoid major disruption at every release. Releases will be made such that major versions are created when a backward incompatibility is introduced, and minor versions are created when substantial features have been added or bugs have been fixed, and the aim would be to only very rarely bump major versions. That should make the project suitable for use from main branch, or if you need a harder requirement, you can base code on a specific version.

fedora-packages:txnupd-rootfs/dracut-vol.name: dracut-volatile-overlay
fedora-packages:txnupd-rootfs/dracut-vol.summary: Dracut module to mount tmpfs overlays on /etc and /var
fedora-packages:txnupd-rootfs/dracut-vol.description: A dracut module that mounts an overlay file system on /etc and on /var, with the upper layer in a tmpfs, so that a system with a read-only root file system boots with writable, non-persistent /etc and /var. To have more persistent locations, such as /root or /home, add further fstab entries. The module is never included in an initramfs by default. Request it explicitly, for example with add_dracutmodules+=" volatile-overlay " in a file in /etc/dracut.conf.d/.

fedora-packages:e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs.name: e2fsprogs
fedora-packages:e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs.summary: Utilities for managing ext2, ext3, and ext4 file systems
fedora-packages:e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs.description: The e2fsprogs package contains a number of utilities for creating, checking, modifying, and correcting any inconsistencies in second, third and fourth extended (ext2/ext3/ext4) file systems. E2fsprogs contains e2fsck (used to repair file system inconsistencies after an unclean shutdown), mke2fs (used to initialize a partition to contain an empty ext2 file system), debugfs (used to examine the internal structure of a file system, to manually repair a corrupted file system, or to create test cases for e2fsck), tune2fs (used to modify file system parameters), and most of the other core ext2fs file system utilities. You should install the e2fsprogs package if you need to manage the performance of an ext2, ext3, or ext4 file system.

Plesken, and T. Schulz at Lehrstuhl B für Mathematik, RWTH Aachen. CARAT is a package for computation with crystallographic groups. CARAT is to a large extent complementary to the GAP 4 package Cryst. In particular, it provides routines for the computation of normalizers and conjugators of finite unimodular groups in GL(n,Z), and routines for the computation of Bravais groups, which are all missing in Cryst. fedora-packages:gap-pkg-kbmag/gap-pkg-kb.name: gap-pkg-kbmag
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-kbmag/gap-pkg-kb.summary: Knuth-Bendix on Monoids and Automatic Groups
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-kbmag/gap-pkg-kb.description: KBMAG (pronounced Kay-bee-mag) stands for Knuth-Bendix on Monoids, and Automatic Groups. It is a stand-alone package written in C, for use under UNIX, with an interface to GAP. There are interfaces for the use of KBMAG with finitely presented groups, monoids and semigroups defined within GAP. The package also contains a collection of routines for manipulating finite state automata, which can be accessed via the GAP interface. The overall objective of KBMAG is to construct a normal form for the elements of a finitely presented group G in terms of the given generators together with a word reduction algorithm for calculating the normal form representation of an element in G, given as a word in the generators. If this can be achieved, then it is also possible to enumerate the words in normal form up to a given length, and to determine the order of the group, by counting the number of words in normal form. In most serious applications, this will be infinite, since finite groups are (with some exceptions) usually handled better by Todd-Coxeter related methods. In fact a finite state automaton W is calculated that accepts precisely the language of words in the group generators that are in normal form, and W is used for the enumeration and counting functions. It is possible to inspect W directly if required; for example, it is often possible to use W to determine whether an element in G has finite or infinite order. The normal form for an element g in G is defined to be the least word in the group generators (and their inverses) that represents G, with respect to a specified ordering on the set of all words in the group generators. KBMAG offers two possible means of achieving these objectives. The first is to apply the Knuth-Bendix algorithm to the group presentation, with one of the available orderings on words, and hope that the algorithm will complete with a finite confluent presentation. (If the group is finite, then it is guaranteed to complete eventually but, like the Todd-Coxeter procedure, it may take a long time, or require more space than is available.) The second is to use the automatic group program. This also uses the Knuth-Bendix procedure as one component of the algorithm, but it aims to compute certain finite state automata rather than to obtain a finite confluent rewriting system, and it completes successfully on many examples for which such a finite system does not exist. In the current implementation, its use is restricted to the shortlex ordering on words. That is, words are ordered first by increasing length, and then words of equal length are ordered lexicographically, using the specified ordering of the generators. The GAP4 version of KBMAG also offers extensive facilities for finding confluent presentations and finding automatic structures relative to a specified finitely generated subgroup of the group G. Finally, there is a collection of functions for manipulating finite state automata that may be of independent interest.

The typeface, together with a complete printing house, was donated in 1821 to the new Greek state by Didot's son, Ambroise Firmin Didot (1790- 1876). fedora-packages:ghc-atomic-write/ghc-ato.name: ghc-atomic-write
fedora-packages:ghc-atomic-write/ghc-ato.description: Atomically write to a file on POSIX-compliant systems while preserving permissions. On most Unix systems, `mv` is an atomic operation. This makes it simple to write to a file atomically just by using the mv operation. However, this will destroy the permissions on the original file. This library does the following to preserve permissions while atomically writing to a file: * If an original file exists, take those permissions and apply them to the temp file before `mv`ing the file into place. * If the original file does not exist, create a following with default permissions (based on the currently-active umask). This way, when the file is `mv`'ed into place, the permissions will be the ones held by the original file. This library is based on similar implementations found in common libraries in Ruby and Python: * <http://apidock.com/rails/File/atomic_write/class Ruby on Rails includes a similar method called atomic_write> * <https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/c4631816132fcfefaba3d123a1d0dfe8bc2866bb/lib/chef/file_content_management/deploy/mv_unix.rb#L23:L71 Chef includes atomic update functionality> * <https://github.com/sashka/atomicfile There is a python library for atomically updating a file> To use `atomic-write`, import the module corresponding to the type you wish to write atomically, e.g., to write a (strict) ByteString atomically: > import System.AtomicWrite.Writer.ByteString Then you can use the atomicWriteFile function that accepts a `FilePath` and a `ByteString`, e.g.: > atomicWriteFile myFilePath myByteString.

fedora-packages:ghc9.8/ghc9.8.description: GHC is a state-of-the-art, open source, compiler and interactive environment for the functional language Haskell. Highlights: - GHC supports the entire Haskell 2010 language plus a wide variety of extensions. - GHC has particularly good support for concurrency and parallelism, including support for Software Transactional Memory (STM). - GHC generates fast code, particularly for concurrent programs. Take a look at GHC's performance on The Computer Language Benchmarks Game. - GHC works on several platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, most varieties of Unix, and several different processor architectures. - GHC has extensive optimisation capabilities, including inter-module optimisation. - GHC compiles Haskell code either directly to native code or using LLVM as a back-end. GHC can also generate C code as an intermediate target for porting to new platforms. The interactive environment compiles Haskell to bytecode, and supports execution of mixed bytecode/compiled programs. - Profiling is supported, both by time/allocation and various kinds of heap profiling. - GHC comes with several libraries, and thousands more are available on Hackage.

The name (failsafe) was chosen both because it is a synonym of surefire and because it implies that when it fails, it does so in a safe way. If you use the Surefire Plugin for running tests, then when you have a test failure, the build will stop at the integration-test phase and your integration test environment will not have been torn down correctly. The Failsafe Plugin is used during the integration-test and verify phases of the build lifecycle to execute the integration tests of an application. The Failsafe Plugin will not fail the build during the integration-test phase thus enabling the post-integration-test phase to execute.

firefox-addons:3097476.name: Pandus: Accessibility and SEO
firefox-addons:3097476.summary: Automated accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and on-page SEO check of the page you are viewing, explained in plain words for site owners. Not a full audit, not legal advice.
firefox-addons:3097476.description:
Pandus checks the page you are on for accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and on-page SEO in one click, and explains every problem in plain words, so the owner of a shop or a client can read it, not only a developer.
It runs in your browser, so it also checks pages behind a login: the cart, the checkout, the customer account or a staging site.
WHAT YOU GET
* Two scores (accessibility and SEO) with blockers and important issues listed first
* Accessibility: the open axe-core engine; problems grouped by rule, WCAG 2.2 A/AA separated from advice (AAA, best practices)
* Rule cards: what is wrong, why it matters for customers, how to fix it, in 7 languages
* SEO tab: indexing, title and description, headings, links, images, structured data, social preview, technical basics, speed of this page load
* Tools for the manual part: element inspector, tab order, headings, landmarks, alt texts, text spacing, 200% zoom, 320 px width, colour vision, contrast with an eyedropper
* A hand-over checklist of 14 things automation cannot check
* Copy the report as Markdown, copy a note for the developer or a ready prompt for an AI assistant
* Optional free Pandus account: weekly results, saving checks of pages behind a login, whole-site check within your plan limits
PRIVACY
The check runs in your browser. No tracking, no analytics, no ads. Data goes to pandus.online only when you connect an account and click an action that needs it (save a check, check the whole site, see weekly results). The extension reads the active tab only when you click its icon or press Alt+Shift+A.
HONEST LIMITS
This is an automated check, not a full audit, and not legal advice. An automated tool finds only part of the problems; a clean result does not mean a site meets any law. The extension finds and explains problems; it does not fix your site and it is not an overlay widget.
Languages: English, Ukrainian, German, Polish, Czech, Romanian, Russian.
Pandus: https://pandus.online/en/accessibility-checker-browser-extension

firefox-addons:162063.summary: Theme Font & Size Changer lets you change the global font size and font family used for the user interface in Firefox. Design your browser with your favorite font.
firefox-addons:162063.description:
THUNDERBIRD USERS PLEASE SWITCH TO THE NEW THUNDERBIRD VERSION BY BELOW URL: 
 https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/theme-font-size-changer-for-tb/ 
 Theme Font & Size Changer is a simple browser tool that lets you change the font size and font family of Firefox and several other Mozilla products. It is especially valuable tool for visually impaired people and wide screen users.
Different from add-ons that enlarge and reduce text on web pages, Theme Font & Size Changer changes the font size and font family in all windows, menus, toolbars, etc within Firefox itself. All font size , font family , and other changes are applied instantly and they are saved permanently and through sessions. You may assign your favorite font into your browser interface and change its size as you wish.
It was initially created to be an accessibility aid for persons with visual impairments and for those without perfect eyesight , but it's also useful for Firefox users with high resolution settings and wide screens .
While Theme Font & Size Changer was written to be used with Firefox default theme, it does work with other non-default themes, but you may come across issues where some elements within Firefox retain the (non-default) font size setting that the theme developer chose for their theme.
There are two places that you can manage the global font size and font family of Firefox via Theme Font & Size Changer :
 Toolbar Button : Click on the Theme Font & Size Changer button to open up Theme Font & Size Changer settings panel. 
 Tools Option : Choose Tools menu from Firefox Menu Bar and click on the Theme Font & Size Changer option. It will open up Theme Font & Size Changer settings panel. 
 Theme Font & Size Changer Settings 
 Zoom: 
This is a global zoom feature that enlarges/zooms both Firefox itself (including buttons and icons), and web page content simultaneously. 
The default Firefox full page zoom controls can still be used independently.
-------------------------------- Font: 
Changes the font family used for Firefox itself (not web pages).
The fonts installed on your system are displayed and can be used. No fonts are installed by Them Font & Size Changer 
-------------------------------- Size: 
Changes the font size used for Firefox itself (not web pages).
-------------------------------- Style: 
Changes the font style for Firefox to Italic.
-------------------------------- Weight: 
Changes the font weight for Firefox to Bold.
-------------------------------- Color: 
Changes the font color for Firefox.
-------------------------------- Background Color: 
Changes the background color of the top toolbars.
-------------------------------- Context Menu: 
Applies Background Color selection to context menus.

bluejetty:00034981:ios.description:
Love Water: A Free, Relaxing Color-Sorting Puzzle Game
Dive into the world of color-matching fun with Love Water, a water sort puzzle game designed to challenge your mind and soothe your soul. Well-suited for casual gaming, brain exercises, stress relief, offline entertainment, and family-friendly activities, this addictive water color sort game offers something for everyone.
—Color-Matching Puzzle Gameplay—
Experience the joy of solving color puzzles in this water sort game. Match the same-colored water in glasses until each color is separated into its own glass. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a relaxing bottle filling game puzzle to enjoy during short breaks or a parent seeking an educational yet fun bottle filling game for your children, this water sorting game is suitable for all ages.
—Thousands of Unique Levels—
Never run out of challenges with thousands of unique and addictive levels in this bottle filling game. Each puzzle in this water sort puzzle game is carefully crafted to keep you entertained. If you're someone who likes to keep their mind active with logic puzzles, Love Water offers endless bottle filling game puzzles to solve.
—Water Sorting Game With a Simple One Finger Control—
Whether you're playing a water pouring game or a liquid sort game, the easy one finger controls make it accessible for everyone. This feature nicely fits commuters looking for a bottle filling game to play on the go or anyone who prefers intuitive touch controls for their gaming experience.
—Offline Mode—
Enjoy the free water sort game of Love Water anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection, making it suitable for long flights, commutes, etc. Ideal for anyone needing some fun offline bottle filling game entertainment.
—Free-to-Play Water Sort Puzzle—
Love Water is completely free to download and play. There are no subscriptions required, making it a truly free water sort game experience. Try the bottle filling game free of change and enjoy endless color-sorting puzzles without any cost. This is great for casual gamers who want an engaging bottle filling game without any financial commitment.
—A Water Sorting Game With No Penalties or Time Limits—
Play at your own pace with no penalties or time limits. Love Water is designed to be a relaxing and stress-free experience. Whether you're enjoying a water sort game or a fill tube game, you can take your time and solve each puzzle without pressure. A nice relaxing bottle filling game for those looking to unwind after a long day.
—Water Color Sort Extra Flask Option—
Stuck on a challenging level in the fill the bottle game? Love Water gives you an extra flask to help you out. This feature offers more flexibility and options to solve the puzzle. It's an excellent feature for players who enjoy problem-solving and need that little extra help to get through tough puzzles.
—Stress-free Bottle Filling Game—
Made a mistake? No problem. Love Water allows you to undo moves with the move cancellation feature. Whether you're playing a water sorting game or a water pouring game, you can easily correct your errors and keep progressing. This is fitting for those who like to experiment with different strategies and approaches.
—Fill The Tube Game For Brain Exercise—
If you find yourself stuck, Love Water lets you restart the water sort puzzle and try a new strategy. A godsend for those tricky levels where you need a second chance. This feature supports brain exercise by encouraging different ways to solve puzzles.
Experience brain-teasing water sort puzzles with Love Water. Whether you're playing to unwind, challenge your brain, or enjoy family-friendly fun, this water sorting game has it all. Embrace the addictive gameplay of free water sort games and discover endless hours of entertainment.

bluejetty:00087937:ios.name: Today in the Word Devotional
bluejetty:00087937:ios.summary: GROW YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD by spending regular time in His Word. The Today in the Word app gives you fresh daily Bible content, new studies each month on complete books of the Bible or biblical topics. Authored by Moody Bible Institute
bluejetty:00087937:ios.description:
GROW YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD by spending regular time in His Word. The Today in the Word app gives you fresh daily Bible content, new studies each month on complete books of the Bible or biblical topics. Authored by Moody Bible Institute professors, you’ll find the devotionals easy to read and listen to, but with rich insights that deepen your understanding of each Scripture passage. 
BUILD THE HABIT OF DAILY BIBLE READING with the newest version of the app. A “devotional streak” lets you track and improve your habit of regular time in God’s Word. You can select any translation of the Bible you prefer. Each day has a beautiful Bible verse graphic to share. There are additional resources for each month’s topic. 
BEST OF ALL, IT IS FREE! There is no charge for any feature of the app which is fully funded by generous readers who believe in the importance of Bible study. By signing up for a free personal account, you can keep your Bible study notes, track completed readings, and save your preferred Bible version. 
Here are 5 reasons to make Today in the Word devotional app your #1 choice: 
1) GET SMALL, BUT MEATY BITES EVERY DAY 
One reader writes, “This is spiritual meat, and I am very grateful.” With Today in the Word, you’ll learn more about the Bible. Each day’s devotional can be read or listened to in less than 5 minutes, but the content is rich enough if you want to spend additional time digging into each passage. We study an entire Bible passage, not just a “feel good” thought based on one verse. 
2) READ THROUGH THE BIBLE, COVER TO COVER 
Have you read through the entire Bible? With the Today in the Word app, you will study every book of the Bible, even ones that you might not have explored before. We aren’t afraid to tackle the tough stuff! Bible professors make even the most difficult passages understandable and help you walk away with a direct application for your life. 
3) GROW IN YOUR FAITH JOURNEY 
“A life changing experience” and “a spiritual revival to my heart”, readers say that this isn’t just about reading the Bible, but letting it change your life! While you may believe that spending regular time in God’s Word strengthens your faith, putting it into practice can be difficult. The app can be used alone or for group study. Each devotional ends with questions that can serve as journal prompts or discussion starters. 
4) GET MONTHLY BONUS RESOURCES 
 - Watch video interviews with devotional authors 
 - Share beautiful Verse-of-the-Day graphics 
 - Select your preferred Bible translation 
 - Receive push notifications that remind you to read the Bible 
 - Record and save your study notes 
 - Listen to audio of each devotional 
 - Listen to abbreviated or full-length audio of each devotional 
 - This app offers push notifications to remind you to read. 
 - Track your reading consistency with a “streak”! 
 - Join a Facebook devotional discussion group 
5) JOIN MORE THAN ONE MILLION READERS! 
Today in the Word readers access the devotional by app, email, audio podcast, and website. We have nearly one million readers in 225 countries who love to spend time in God’s Word. We hope you will join this vibrant community! 
AVAILABLE BIBLE TRANSLATIONS 
The app allows you to select your preferred Bible translation. Choose from NIV, ESV, KJV, NLT and more. Change your translation as often as you would like and save it when you sign up for a free account. 
NO HIDDEN CHARGES! 
Our commitment is to provide this Bible resource at no charge for all. We depend on the support of generous readers to meet the financial needs of this ministry.

bluejetty:00171052:ios.description:
Get fit with Rick: Making workouts fun and weight loss simple.
Get results from home in only 20 minutes per day, while keeping your joints entirely safe.
Pioneer of walking workouts, I created an entire platform dedicated to low impact & joint friendly workouts. This all in one platform gives you the tools and resources you need to get the results you want.
So what's included:
EXCLUSIVE WORKOUTS
-Immerse yourself in seven new genres of walking workouts, from Fun/Uplifting and Cardio to Body Combat, HIIT, Dumbbells & Abs, Boxing & Dance Cardio.
-Tailor your routine with seated workouts, strength workouts, yoga, pilates, and the "Learn to Exercise" series.
RESULTS-BASED PROGRAMS
- Transform your life with our meticulously crafted 6-12 week programs.
- Access a step-by-step blueprint that has proven successful in helping thousands achieve weight loss and maintain it.
- All programs are standing, low-impact, and joint-friendly, ensuring accessibility for all levels and abilities.
- Popular programs include the 6-Week "Let's Sweat," 6-Week "Body Combat," and the comprehensive 12-Week "Sweat, Sculpt & Shred.”
TAKE ON A CHALLENGE
- Amp up the excitement with super fun challenges that keep you on track and set mini goals.
- Choose from 7-30 day challenges, including the 14-day abs challenge, 4-week dance cardio challenge, and the invigorating 5K a day challenge.
MEALS PLANS & RECIPES
- Unlock signature meal plans proven to deliver incredible results while optimizing your health markers.
- Easy-to-follow plans guide you towards success and long-term health.
- Dive into hundreds of recipes, including vegetarian and vegan options, meal prep videos, and Rick's signature cookbook.
PLAN YOUR WORKOUTS
- Take control of your fitness journey with our user-friendly calendar feature to plan and schedule your workouts.
- Build consistency and positive habits by turning your routine on autopilot.
- Create custom playlists of your favorite workouts and save go-to sessions for quick access.
- Download your preferred workouts for offline access, ensuring you can exercise anytime, anywhere.
WHAT OUR MEMBERS HAVE TO SAY
"Proud is an understatement. I took back control of my life last year after discovering Rick. It’s helped me so much not just with my weight but my mental health too. 5 stone gone for good” - Katie Louise
"If someone told me 4 months ago I would have lost 4 stone & going on 2 walks a day, I would have laughed. 
I just want to say thank to Rick and everything he does” - Charlotte Turner
"This membership is the best thing I ever did for myself" - Gills Journey
"I’ve gone from sedentary to being able to run 5K, climb mountains, and walk a minimum of 10k per day. I owe it all to rick. I even encourage my patients as I’m a nurse practictioner” - Helen Smith
Privacy: https://www.getfitwithrick.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://www.getfitwithrick.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00115284:ios.description:
Ready to level up your looks? 
Over 5M+ scans completed. Join 100,000+ users improving their looks with UCHAD.
With our advanced face analysis and structured looksmax guidance, UCHAD gives you honest feedback and a practical plan to improve your attractiveness.
HOW TO USE UCHAD:
1) Download the app.
2) Take a selfie
3) Get your analysis & personalized glow up guide**
**Note: Some features require a paid subscription or in-app purchase. Free features are limited.
Unlock your potential with UCHAD, the popular face rating and looksmaxxing app used by 100,000+ users. Built with advanced AI, UCHAD scans your features, gives you a full attractiveness breakdown, and guides you with personalized tips to glow up, improve confidence, and transform your looks.
CORE FEATURES 
Upload a photo to receive detailed facial insights, including:
- Basic analysis & insights (Free)
- Advanced face analysis (Premium feature - requires purchase)
- Feature-level breakdown: jawline, eyes, skin, hair, symmetry (Premium feature)
- Improvement potential based on facial structure (Premium feature)
- Personalized archetype-style description (Premium feature)
- Clear actionable improvement tips (Premium feature)
NEW FEATURES (Premium features – require purchase)
- AI Portrait Generation (Premium feature - requires purchase): visualize your best self. See enhanced, refined versions of you based on realistic improvements. Think: future you, optimized.
- Ascension Timeline Estimate (Premium feature): based on your current presentation and improvement potential, UCHAD estimates how long meaningful visual changes could take with consistency. No guarantees, just a structured projection.
- CHAD Mode (Premium feature): switch to objective analysis. Direct, structured feedback focused purely on facial metrics and presentation, no fluff.
LOOKSMAX WITH CONFIDENCE (Free with limited features) 
UCHAD helps you improve with practical suggestions for: 
- Grooming and hairstyle
- Jawline and posture focus
- Skincare basics
- Fitness and body presence
- Lifestyle habits that affect appearance
Daily Progress Tracking (Free with limited features)
- Save photos over time
- Track visual changes and improvements
- See how your presentation evolves
AI Coach (Free with limited features. Full access requires purchase)
- Get personalized looksmax, fitness, and self-improvement tips:
- Daily guidance for routines and habits.
- Evidence-based strategies for real results.
Real Feedback from the UCHAD Community:
“I’ve tried other rating apps before like Umax and Jawmax, but UCHAD actually showed me what to work on. After focusing on posture and skincare for a few months, I genuinely look sharper in photos.” – Alex T.
“I was curious about my PSL scores...stumbled into UCHAD. The breakdown was way more detailed than I expected. It pointed out jawline and symmetry stuff I never noticed. Following the plan gave me structure instead of just guessing.” - Ryan K.
Your Starting Point Isn’t Your Limit.
You can’t change your genetics overnight, but you can improve how you present yourself.
With honest analysis, structured guidance, and consistent habits, real progress is possible.
Download UCHAD and start building a better version of yourself - one scan at a time.
NOTE: We do not offer medical advice. Any and all recommendations should be viewed as suggestions, always consult with a professional and do your own research before doing something new.
Full analysis results and premium features require a subscription, available through Apple’s In-App Purchase. 
Terms of Use: https://www.gopromi.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.gopromi.app/privacy-policy
Contact: hello@gopromi.app

Embark on an epic anime adventure in "Lord of Heroes"!

A TALE OF TRIUMPH AND SACRIFICE
bluejetty:00105592:android.description:
Embark on an epic anime adventure in "Lord of Heroes"!
Dive into a stunning anime world where you become the Lord of Avillon. Lead your heroes to reshape the destiny of nations in this immersive anime RPG.
A TALE OF TRIUMPH AND SACRIFICE
As the Lord of Avillon, you'll embark on a gripping journey filled with trials, triumphs, reunions, and farewells. Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and leadership as your decisions shape history. Uncover the mysteries of this mystical anime world through various chapters and side stories, including the War of the Tyrants and more.
MEET EXTRAORDINARY ANIME HEROES
Collect a diverse cast of heroes featuring stunning 3D anime models, each with unique personalities and rich backstories. Summon heroes with Linkstones or recruit them for free through gameplay using Renown and Crystals—currencies anyone can gather just by playing the game! Discover alternate versions of these heroes from different timelines, offering fresh perspectives and exciting narratives. Celebrate their birthdays with in-game events, collect special photocards, and delve into the intricate relationships between heroes in their story archives.
STRATEGIC MASTERY IN TURN-BASED COMBAT
Master an intricate turn-based combat system with limitless combinations of anime heroes. Utilize strategic gameplay mechanics like Chain Burst to unleash multiple ultimate skills in one turn, turning the tide of even the toughest battles. With smart resource management and careful hero selection, outmaneuver complex boss mechanics and conquer challenging content such as the Nightmare difficulty of the story or the Obelisk, even with heroes that have yet to unlock their full potential.
YOUR ADVENTURE, YOUR PACE
Lord of Heroes respects your time while offering a wealth of content for both casual and hardcore anime RPG fans. Passively level up your heroes in the Dakkeon Training Grounds, complete quick daily dungeons for valuable resources, and unite with fellow Lords to challenge formidable foes in joint raids like Silent Straits and Calamity's Cradle. Join a global community and become part of the ultimate anime experience.
What are you waiting for? Join the adventure and become the Lord of Avillon now!

bluejetty:00200200:ios.description:
FSC needed?
You may be a seasoned firearm user and you just need your Firearm Safety Certificate. Or you may be a beginner and need not only to pass DOJ written test, but also to feel confident at any Safe Handling Demonstration and to be safe while handling firearms on a day-to-day basis. Anyway, at AlphaSquared Technologies we strongly believe that everyone must know how to use firearms safely. So, we have created this application to help you with all these matters.
The application contains 300 questions, which help you to master your knowledge by practicing offline (you don't need an Internet connection) and, thus, utilizing your time better.
Our research demonstrated that the most effective preparation is achieved when practice tests contain 10 questions (our research proved that 17.6% of applicants remember better in this case). So, the practice tests are formed to contain 10 questions each.
Features:
- 300 questions based on Firearms Safety Certificate Study Guide and California Law/Gun Laws in California. IMPORTANT: Questions are going to be even harder than at your written test, so that you will surefire pass your FSC test.
- Real test version 1-3 questions included.
- Randomly generated quizzes
- Quiz capacity is optimized for fastest tuition
- Reviewing included comments for the most complicated/tricky questions
- Practical advice and weapon handling techniques from the best firearms instructors
- Safe Handling Demonstration questions

bluejetty:00072929:ios.name: Aisten: Podcast Transcription
bluejetty:00072929:ios.summary:
Podcast Language Learning now supports learning in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Japanese.
Why choose podcasts to learn languages?
I asked DeepSeek about this question and this is his answer:
1. Learn real conversation
bluejetty:00072929:ios.description:
Podcast Language Learning now supports learning in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Japanese.
Why choose podcasts to learn languages?
I asked DeepSeek about this question and this is his answer:
1. Learn real conversations from native speakers - You'll be exposed to natural English expressions rather than dialogue from textbooks.
2. Unconscious Learning - You can listen to podcasts while commuting, exercising, cooking, etc. Easy to integrate into daily life.
3. Improve listening - Listen more and your brain will adapt and understand fast, everyday English conversations.
4. Learn contextual vocabulary - words and phrases are used in real-life situations to help remember them.
5. Voice and Topic Diversity - Find podcasts from native speakers from different countries on topics that interest you.
These points basically summarize the benefits of using podcasts to learn languages, but the reality is that I encountered a pain point in the process of practicing podcasts to learn languages, that is, my vocabulary is too small, and many podcasts do not provide text, even if they do. The text and word search process will also be very cumbersome, so I made this app, hoping to make this matter simpler.
I can't prove to you that this learning method is scientifically effective, nor can I give you any commitment to learning outcomes. I think this may just be an attempt. I hope to find users who are interested in this "method" and can learn from them. I got some recognition or suggestions there, and I hope it will be a useful tool for those friends who are already trying to learn languages in this way.
Privacy Policy: https://josscii.github.io/aisten/privacy.html

bluejetty:00183361:ios.name: FOOBY: Recipes & More
bluejetty:00183361:ios.summary: If you’re not sure what to cook, which recipes to follow, or even if you want to know how to steam your vegetables properly, then the FOOBY app is here to help. With your cookbook on demand, you can find inspiration and recipes, alongside s
bluejetty:00183361:ios.description:
If you’re not sure what to cook, which recipes to follow, or even if you want to know how to steam your vegetables properly, then the FOOBY app is here to help. With your cookbook on demand, you can find inspiration and recipes, alongside shopping lists and step-by-step instructions. You can even exchange culinary ideas with the community. 
**Key features include:**
- A large variety of recipes and cooking tips to inspire you
- Find a suitable recipe for every occasion, complete with a shopping list
- Plan your shopping: the shopping list adjusts itself to the number of people
- Multiple filter options: filter searches according to specific ingredients or dietary requirements
- Cook like a professional with our cooking tips, pictures and videos
**From inspiring ideas to creative meals**
What’s special about the FOOBY app is that it provides you with all the information you could possibly need to make a delicious meal – all you have to do is cook it! There is no shortage of inspiration for your next dish – from a light and fresh salad to a festive roast. The app also recommends a wine pairing with various recipes for the perfect culinary experience. Plus, if you want to learn more about a certain ingredient, you are in good hands with our app – your “cookbook to go”.
**Plan ahead of time**
Each recipe comes with a shopping list, where all the ingredients are sorted by supermarket aisle or section. Once you’ve selected your recipe, simply specify the number of people you’re cooking for and the shopping list quantities will be adjusted automatically. With step-by-step instructions, pictures and how-to videos, the FOOBY recipes are suitable for everyone, from beginners to pros. In addition, the app includes a handy timer that reminds you, for example, when to take your roast out of the oven. The FOOBY app contains everything you’ll ever need to cook creatively at home.
**Collect your favourite recipes**
Food-lovers will be especially delighted with the FOOBY app because it allows you to collect all of your favourite recipes in one place. Save links to recipes from a different site or choose your favourite FOOBY recipes and add them to your profile. Storing recipes from other sites couldn’t be easier, simply save the links in the FOOBY app. For recipes from printed cookbooks or newspapers, simply take a photo with your smartphone camera and save them to your FOOBY app. This way, all your favourite meals are easily available through your “personal cookbook”, from all of your devices.
**little FOOBY**
We have something to celebrate: little FOOBY is here! little FOOBY is all about cooking with little ones. As well as recipes and inspiration, little FOOBY is packed with important and interesting information about cooking with children. Have fun!

bluejetty:00087155:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00087155:ios.description:
FEATURES
• Search over 500,000 words, phrases and synonyms
• Enter crossword clues to search the built-in thesaurus
• Find words with missing letters
• Solves anagrams and codewords
• Powerful filters to refine your searches
• Built-in dictionary, look up over 100,000 definitions
CROSSWORDS
Use ? (press space) to represent a missing letter, try c????w??? to find clockwork and crossword
CROSSWORD CLUES
Use the built in thesaurus to find related words, try condiment to find ketchup, mustard, wasabi...
CROSSWORD PHRASES
Search over 100K built-in phrases, use a hyphen to denote a space, try m????-???-?????? to find motte and bailey, miles per gallon and milky way galaxy
ANAGRAMS
Try vegdances to find scavenged, also finds smaller words such as seance. 
WORDLE
Green letters use the crossword search, eg ??e?t
Grey letters, add them to the Excludes filter
Yellow letters, add them to the Contains filter
CODEWORDS
Try ??112332 to find cassette and pallette, the numbers represent the same repeated letters. Combine these searches with filters to exclude words with letters you already have found.
BLANK LETTERS
Use + to represent blank letters, enter scrabb++ to find crabbers and scrabbly.
SPELLING BEE
Spelling Bee puzzles are where you only use the letters provided but as many times as you like. Try $qntuaei to find: quinquina, aquanaut and queenie
DEFINITIONS
Press a word to view its definition, example usages and synonyms. You can click on the synonyms to view their definitions, press the speak button to listen to the word being spoken by the app.
Note, if no definition is found the app will search the web for a definition.

bluejetty:00182606:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182606:ios.description:
Play Snake like it is 1997. This is a remake of the original Snake, complete with dot-matrix display and monotone sounds.
Rewind time and get a dosis of nostalgia that is as addictive (and frustrating) as the original.
Play Snake '97 and be prepared to lose some productive hours. 
Simply launch the app, touch a button and start!
Snake '97 features:
- old school controls 
- dot-matrix display
- original monotone sounds (bleep bleep)
- 9 original and 3 extra difficulty levels
- Snake 1 and classic Snake 2 
- 7 classic game modes (5110, 3210, 8210, 8850 and 3310, 3410, 7110 with Snake 2)
- bonus creatures (Snake 2)
- go through the walls! (Snake 2)
- 5 original and 2 extra labyrinths (Snake 2)
- a high score that cannot be reset (just like the original)
The story behind this game is that my smartphone got damaged, requiring me to revert back to an old phone. Suddenly I knew the smartphone was missing something and the idea for a accurate Snake remake was born.
Snake '97 is an homage to the classic mobile phone game programmed in 1997.
By carefully analyzing the classic gameplay, timing and controls, this Snake '97 remake is one of the most accurate available.
If you have any questions, comments or suggestions, feel free to contact me.
Have Snake fun! 
Best regards from Amsterdam,
The developer,
Willem.

Sergeant Major (ret) John McPhee AKA “The Sheriff of Baghdad” served a distinguished career in U.S. Army Special Operations for over 20 years, retiring in 2011. Better known for his call sign “SHREK”, John created the Sheriff of Baghdad brand to provide his knowledge to civilians, law-enforcement, and militaries around the world.
John has spent his adult life in Special Operations and Special Mission Units. He has trained countless U.S. Special Operations forces, thousands of International Tier 1 Operators and Special Forces around the world. He is one of the handful of operators with over a decade of combat having served in multiple theaters from Bosnia and South America to recent war efforts in Iraq and Afghanistan.

bluejetty:00115374:ios.description:
Imposter Game: Who is the Spy? is a thrilling social party game of hidden roles, bluffing, and deduction. Perfect for game nights, casual hangouts, or video calls, it brings laughter, suspense, and surprises to any group of friends.
In each round, players are given a secret word, except one: the Impostor, who must fake their way through the conversation and figure out the word without getting exposed. The Civilians must subtly confirm each other’s knowledge of the word while watching closely for anyone acting suspicious.
But there’s another wildcard in the mix: Mr. White. This player doesn’t receive any word at all. No clue, no help, only improvisation and bluffing. If Mr. White survives the round or correctly guesses the word, they win.
The gameplay is simple to learn but full of strategy. Ask questions, answer carefully, and pay attention to tone, hesitation, and clever deception. After every round of discussion, players vote. One by one, the suspects are eliminated. Will you uncover the Impostor, or be tricked by a smooth-talking Mr. White?
Every match is quick, high-stakes, and different from the last. Whether you're playing among friends or with family, the game adapts to any group size and energy level.
Key Features:
◆ Play with 3 up to 24 players - perfect for small groups or large parties
◆ Choose from Impostor, Mr. White, and Civilian roles
◆ Ideal for parties or game nights
◆ No hassle - just open and play
◆ Hundreds of words and themed packs for endless variety
◆ Fun, fast-paced rounds full of laughter and tension

bluejetty:00046354:ios.name: Marble Dating
bluejetty:00046354:ios.summary:
MARBLE, JUST NAME A TIME AND PLACE.
Marble offers a new approach to dating that encourages members to put down their phones and meet in real life. We are a private community where people connect by inviting one another to reservations at re
bluejetty:00046354:ios.description:
MARBLE, JUST NAME A TIME AND PLACE.
Marble offers a new approach to dating that encourages members to put down their phones and meet in real life. We are a private community where people connect by inviting one another to reservations at restaurants and cocktail bars. Marble members set a date with someone first and message later, streamlining the dating process and providing for a more direct, fun and efficient experience. Plus, members can bond over cuisine, ambiance, and places they enjoy. Nobody wants a pen pal. People are done wasting time and energy on swiping, matching, and engaging in pointless back and forth leading nowhere. Marble is transforming the way people date.
HERE’S HOW IT WORKS:
1. Book a reservation for 2, share it with the community and find someone to join you OR
2. Browse dates created by other members and join them on their reservation
3. Access the chat once the date is set
MARBLE’S DIFFERENTIATORS:
* Plan your date before chatting
* Requires reservations at restaurants or cocktail bars
* Maximum of 3 dates simultaneously
MARBLE’S UNIQUE FEATURES:
* Map Feature: Explore the map for dates created by other Marble members and ask to join them on their reservation
* Easy Date Creation: Just copy and paste your reservation confirmation link from the booking platform, select whether the date will be food or drinks, select who’s paying, and add an optional date description
* Maximum of 3 Dates Simultaneously: Focus on just a few people at once and avoid becoming overwhelmed
* Timed Invites/Requests: Respond to invites to join someone’s date or requests to join your date within 24 hours, that way no one is left hanging
* Chat Feature: Access the chat only once the date is set with another Marble member
* Date Confirmation: Members are prompted to confirm they’re going 24 hours before the date
* Date Cancellation: Members have the ability to cancel a date in the app for any reason, so long as it is at least 2 hours prior to the time of the reservation
* Notifications Tab: View all your notifications in one place
APPLICATION AND SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Prospective members may download the app and submit an application. Once submitted, applications are placed in a queue and reviewed continually. Applications can be accepted at any time. Once accepted, members have the option to purchase a 1, 3, or 6 month auto-renewing membership and will have full functionality of the entire service while their subscription is active. Below are the subscription tiers:
Basic Subscription
1 month: $15.00/month
3 months: $10.00/month
6 months: $7.50/month
Premium Subscription
1 month: $30.00/month
3 months: $20.00/month
6 months: $15.00/month
Marble’s community values – trust, respect, and privacy – are core to the membership experience. Members who act in a manner that is not reflective of these values and other community guidelines may have their accounts suspended or terminated.
Initial payment is charged via iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renewals are charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the applicable period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time through iTunes Account Settings. Any subscription cancellation will be effective at the end of the applicable period.
For more, please see our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://www.marbledatingapp.com/privacy-policy
https://www.marbledatingapp.com/terms-of-use
For any questions, comments or concerns, please email us at contact@marbledatingapp.com. 
All photos are of models and are used for illustrative purposes only.

· Add funds to a CSC GO wallet for faster, no transaction-fee wash or dry payment

· Get alerts when your washer/dryer cycle is complete
· View your payment and transaction history
· Request CSC GO Service or Refund right from the app
· Refer a Friend and earn a bonus for every friend that creates an account and does laundry, some limits apply 
CSC GO is here to make your laundry experience simple and convenient. If you like our service, please take a moment to review our app.
Have a question? Tap Help in the app. You can also reach Customer Care by email at CSCGOhelp@cscsw.com
