bluejetty:00065158:ios.description:
NN Direct este aplicația care îți aduce pe telefon ce este mai important să știi despre asigurările și pensiile de la NN.
Poți plăti primele asigurărilor sau contribuțiile pensiilor facultative rapid și în siguranță, cu orice card bancar, și poți salva detaliile cardurilor tale pentru a face plăți mai ușor. Dacă ești printre cei cu apetit pentru investiții, tot prin aplicație poți face tranzacții cu unități de fond în câțiva pași simpli.
Mai mult, ai acces la istoricul primelor de asigurare plătite și al contribuțiilor la pensie și îți poți actualiza datele personale sau de contact oricând apar schimbări, prin simpla scanare a cărții de identitate.
În cazul apariției unui eveniment asigurat, ne poți transmite toate detaliile prin intermediul meniului dedicat din NN Direct, unde poți urmări ulterior statusul solicitării tale. Noi te vom notifica în cazul în care avem nevoie de documente suplimentare, pe care le vei putea încărca tot în aplicație.
Activarea contului se face scurt și de la distanță, iar pentru autentificare poți alege varianta clasică (email și parolă) sau, și mai simplu, cu recunoaștere facială sau amprentă digitală.
Ca să te bucuri de noua experiență care vine cu funcționalități noi și informații pe înțelesul tău, e suficient să actualizezi sau descarci cea mai recentă versiune.
Odată ce te-ai conectat, ne place să credem că avem o aplicație intuitivă și îți va fi ușor să afli ce te interesează.
Dacă nu e așa, dă-ne de veste. În timp ce citești aceste rânduri, echipa noastră lucrează la îmbunătățirea aplicației, așa că apreciem dacă ne lași un review aici. Promitem să răspundem în timp util.

BeU offers a great selection of your local restaurants and shops

About BeU:
BeU is a product by XMT that connects people to what is best in their cities. Taking all the convenience of finding what you need to your hands in a simple and user-friendly manner with the best deals and services all one click away from you. BeU also empowers small local businesses to increase their reach and find new creative ways to connect them to the clients.

Login to your existing SundaySounds.com account to access your
bluejetty:00175221:ios.description:
The Sunday Keys App is the best way to access your favorite resources from SundaySounds.com using just your iPad and now supports hosting your favorite AUv3 instrument plugins!
Login to your existing SundaySounds.com account to access your available content and enjoy an optimized Sunday Keys experience, designed for churches, built for iPad. 
*****You'll need an existing SundaySounds.com account to use the Sunday Keys App. If you don't have any purchased resources you can still login with an existing Sunday Sounds account and try out the App in demo mode. Additional SundaySounds.com content will be made available over time within the Sunday Keys App. 
Sunday Keys features powerful workflows for fast preparation of your worship services and reliable live performance with on the fly flexibility and control. Featuring an interface designed for touch, quickly browse the ready to play Patches or create exactly what you need by easily layering Sounds together across the keyboard. 
The App is designed specifically for the needs of worship teams, so it's easy to stay organized. Easily browse your favorite Sounds, Patches, and Setlists from the User Library with full support for custom folders and built-in search tools. Setlist Sharing makes it easy to send a Setlist to a friend or member of your worship team with just a tap. 
Sunday Keys will deliver reliable performance and incredible results for your worship team, allowing you to take your live worship keys rig to the next level, all from your iPad.
Based on your content from SundaySounds.com choose from a growing library of individual Sounds and ready to play Patches with more content to be added regularly.* Browse a wide selection of incredible Sounds including grand, upright, and felt pianos, warm and evolving pads, strings, synth leads, bass, and more.
You can now also host your favorite AUv3 instrument plugins inside Sunday Keys, making this App the ultimate host for your favorite plugins!
Sunday Keys features a full suite of audio effects including stereo Delay, lush Reverb, Chorus, Tremolo, Rotor, Overdrive, and more plus powerful midi effects including an Arpeggiator, Easy Chord, and a full midi Sequencer, all available for both the internal Sound Library and applying to AUv3 instruments as you'd like.
Use the Tonic Pad Player to glue together your band and cover any transition with gorgeous background ambient pads. You have full control over the drone's sound, crossfade time, and tone so you'll always fill just the right amount of space. Use the Tonic Pad on the fly or easily program seamless changes per Patch as you move through your Setlist. 
Connect any class-compliant Midi hardware and an audio interface to the App and enjoy tactile control via full Midi Learn functionality. Bluetooth and Network Midi are also fully supported! Detailed information on Midi and Audio connections can be found here: https://support.sundaysounds.com/hc/en-us/articles/5874902996247 
Download Sunday Keys to get started with an all new way to play worship keys.
*Content will be added to the Sunday Keys App as it is available. The core Sunday Keys Sound Library will be prioritized as additional Sounds and Patches are added. Once the full library is available the Sunday Keys Sound Library will receive monthly updates according to the terms of our license agreement available at SundaySounds.com

bluejetty:00038805:ios.description:
PhiApp is intended for use by Phi Artists and clients alike. You can choose whether you will use PhiApp as an Artist or a Customer (client). 
If you are a Phi Artist:
Your PhiApp will be equipped with state-of-the-art symmetry tools used to perform treatments such as PhiBrows, Philings, Contour, PhiAreola, and PhiScalp.
The application gives you non-stop access to PhiAcademy’s official medical consultant/physician who will answer any questions and/or concerns you may have, and as quickly as possible. You also have access to our FAQ database, which contains over 7,000 answers and is constantly growing 24/7! 
PhiApp will always notify you of any new products and PhiAcademy courses now available!
This application includes one of the most modern organizational calendars which allows you to organize your schedule – your own personal treatments or those of your entire salon. You can also create multiple calendars for each of your staff members that you can monitor at any time. 
One of the most significant features of this app is fast access to all your clients’ medical and treatment histories but your clients must grant you access to their histories before you are able to view them. 
If you are a customer (client):
The PhiApp aims to inform you of all your treatments and post-treatment aftercare. 
The application allows you to consult with PhiAcademy’s official medical consultant/physician if you should have any questions concerning the use of medication or any illness before, during and after undergoing treatment(s). 
PhiApp allows you to fill in your medical and treatment histories, allowing you to save time when visiting the salon for treatment. This information will be made available to your chosen Artist(s) if you grant access only. 
The app’s map makes it easy for you to find the Phi Artists, Royal Artists, Masters, Grand Masters closest to you.

DogPack is the community built by dog people, for dog people. No banner ads, no brands cluttering your feed. No algorithm engineered to keep you scrolling. Just you, your dog, and people who get it.
YOUR DOG DESERVES THIS 
Post photos and videos without judgment. Get genuine reactions from people who actually care about your dog, not just double taps from strangers. Build a real profile for your pup, follow dogs you love, and find your people nearby.

IF YOUR DOG GOES MISSING 
Send an instant alert to nearby dog owners, walkers, and sitters in seconds. When every minute counts, your community has your back.

Get a verified badge, additional photo generation credits, and boosted profile visibility. Optional. Always.
Free to join. Made by dog people.

bluejetty:00061162:ios.description:
Bible Study App: Chronological Bible Reading Plan, Study Tools & Prayer
Read the Bible, study it deeply, pray, and fellowship — all in one Bible app!
BIBLE STUDY APP: BIBLE READING PLANS
Our daily Bible study connects the New and Old Testament while ordering the Bible chronologically. Each day is broken into 10-minute readings with open-ended questions to help pull out insights. Contextual maps, videos, and daily challenges help you understand the Bible and grow spiritually.
BIBLE STUDY TOOLS
Go deeper in any verse without leaving your Bible reading plan. Tap a verse for cross-references, commentaries, side-by-side comparison in every translation, and a Greek & Hebrew interlinear, or read a whole chapter in it. Tap any Greek or Hebrew word for a full word study: its meaning, its origin, related words in both languages, and every verse in the Bible where that word appears. Search the Bible by topic or by your own words.
PRAYER APP FEATURES
Deepen your daily walk with God with prayer lists and distraction-free prayer sessions that keep time for you.
FELLOWSHIP APP: GROUP CHAT FEATURES
Stay connected in private fellowship groups for your friends or small group (up to 500 users). Share what you are reading and your prayer requests, away from the distractions of big social networks.
PRINTED STUDY GUIDE
Get our printed Chronological study guide and journal at www.BibleStudyTogether.com.
CHRONOLOGICAL CROSS-REFERENCE BIBLE READING PLAN
- Daily readings from the New and Old Testament
- Gospels woven into a single story
- Chronological: read psalms & prophecies in context
- Daily passages connected to show how the New Testament fulfills the Old
- Choose your pace: 2 years, 1 year, 6 months, or 92 days
- Daily open-ended Bible study questions
BIBLE STUDY TOOL FEATURES
- Cross-references & classic Bible commentaries
- Parallel Bible: compare verses across all translations
- Read any chapter in a Greek & Hebrew interlinear
- Word study: Thayer, Brown-Driver-Briggs & Liddell-Scott
- Related Greek & Hebrew words
- Every verse a Greek or Hebrew word appears in
- Highlight in 6 colors, take notes, copy passages
- Look up any Strong's number
- Topical Bible search & whole Bible word search
- History of every word & passage looked up
PRAYER TOOL FEATURES
- Prayer lists of your own & for your group
- Pray in ACTS order with prayer categories
- Timed prayer sessions & prayer streaks
- Answered prayers shared with your group
FELLOWSHIP GROUP CHAT FEATURES
- Post prayer requests, thoughts & Bible insights
- Sync your Bible reading plan with your group
- Group announcements & meeting reminders
- Owner & admin group roles
MORE APP FEATURES
- Verse of the Day & reminders to read and pray
- Read any chapter in its own Bible App tab
- Read in ESV®, NLT®, NASB®, KJV & Berean Standard
- Audio Bible for every reading, highlighted as it reads
- Page mode: read like a paper Bible
- Maps of the places in each reading
- Videos on every Bible book & the Holy Land
- Reading schedule, progress & streaks
- Prayers & highlights sync across devices
MORE BIBLE READING PLANS
- Rapid Chronological Cross-Reference Bible Reading Plan
- One Year Bible Reading Plan & M'Cheyne Plan
- 30-Day Gospel Harmony & The Synthesized Gospels
- 26 topical plans: prayer, hope, anxiety & more
- The 90 Day Big Bible Story & more
Bible Study Together is a complete Bible app for personal Bible study, small groups, and churches.

bluejetty:00022737:ios.name: Elf Studio®
bluejetty:00022737:ios.summary:
Welcome to Elf Studio®! The latest marvel from the Software Elves here at the North Pole Command Center (Creators of Speak to Santa)!
Turn your elf's Christmas mischief into photos and videos set in your own home! Put them under the tree,
bluejetty:00022737:ios.description:
Welcome to Elf Studio®! The latest marvel from the Software Elves here at the North Pole Command Center (Creators of Speak to Santa)!
Turn your elf's Christmas mischief into photos and videos set in your own home! Put them under the tree, send them towards the cookie jar, or dream up a surprise of your own.
- SCAN YOUR OWN ELF! Start with one photo of your elf toy, with room for up to four views. Every account includes one elf scan. Elf Studio Pro includes ten a month, with no additional credit charge.
- NO TOY? DRAW OR DESCRIBE ONE! Sketch your elf on the drawing pad or describe it in words, and the AI turns it into an elf you can cast in any scene.
- QUICK CREATE OR STUDIO! Pick an elf and a photo, then describe the action, or stage your photo by dragging elves and props into place, choosing poses and adjusting sizes.
- GET HELP WITH THE WORDS! Studio builds a scene script from your layout. Get Ideas suggests actions for your photo, and Improve helps rewrite your prompt.
- AI PHOTOS & VIDEOS! Make photo takes, compare them and animate your favorite. Cast up to three elves with their own roles in the scene.
- DIRECT THE SHOT! Create five-second AI videos with Natural, Stop Motion or Storybook styling, camera movement, portrait or landscape framing and optional generated sound. Use start and end images to guide the action.
- MAKE AN EXAMPLE YOUR OWN! Browse scene ideas and use an example recipe with your chosen elf and your own photo.
- THE ELF WORKSHOP! Choose ready-made elves in classic and felt styles, or design one in 3D with hair, hats, outfits, gloves, shoes, glasses and colors, with a live preview.
- ENHANCE WITH AI! Give your elf a lifelike look and keep different looks to choose from.
- BRING THE PROPS! Pick from the prop shelf, scan a toy or describe a prop for the AI to create reference pictures.
- STICKERS & POSES! Make AI stickers of your elf striking new poses, then use those poses in your Studio photos. Add a bust sticker of any custom elf, made right on your device.
- SEND THEM IN MESSAGES! Open Elf Studio® in the Messages app drawer to send the cast, your own elves and the stickers you have made.
- HOME SCREEN WIDGETS! Count the sleeps until Christmas or until your elf arrives, with a posed elf of your choice keeping watch.
- MAKE THEM AR-READY! Generate a 3D model of a scanned elf or prop before placing it in your room.
- FILM IN AUGMENTED REALITY! Place AR-ready elves and props on your floor, draw walking routes, add stops and choose animations. Capture AR photos and videos, with Look at Camera, footsteps, lighting and actions you can trigger while filming. AR needs a compatible device.
- CATCH THEIR FACES! Record the viewer's reaction as your video plays. Reaction recordings stay on your device and are not uploaded to Elf Studio®.
- ADD THE FINISHING TOUCH! Apply eight video looks and filters without changing the original. Find your creations in the Gallery, save them to Photos and share the files.
AI generation needs an internet connection. Once a job is sent, it can continue on our servers while you leave the app. Enable notifications to hear when it is ready.
Your Gallery is stored on this device. Elf Studio® does not provide cloud library backup, so export the memories you want to keep.
AI or AR. Photo or video. Your elf, your home, your Christmas story!
Elf Studio® is created by North Pole Command Centre Limited and works with any toy. Elf Studio® is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Elf on the Shelf®, but many families use Elf Studio® alongside their existing Elf on the Shelf traditions.
Made by the software elves here at the North Pole Command Center!
Elf Studio® is a registered trademark in the United Kingdom, the European Union and the United States. All rights reserved.

bluejetty:00015534:ios.name: 123 Fun Numbers and Math Games
bluejetty:00015534:ios.summary:
Get your little one ready with these Common Core supported math game. Numbers Math Games -123 Fun Numbers is an educational, fun and rewarding app which allow to develop math skills at their own pace while having fun.
Educational content
bluejetty:00015534:ios.description:
Get your little one ready with these Common Core supported math game. Numbers Math Games -123 Fun Numbers is an educational, fun and rewarding app which allow to develop math skills at their own pace while having fun.
Educational content
- Know number names and the count sequence.
- Count forward beginning from a given number within the known sequence.
- Write numbers from 0 to 10. 
- Count to tell the number of objects.
- Understand the relationship between numbers and quantities; connect counting to cardinality.
- Compare numbers.
- Identify whether the number of objects in one group is greater than, less than, or equal to the number of objects in another group.
- Compare two numbers between 1 and 10 presented as written numerals.
- Understand addition as putting together and adding to, and understand subtraction as taking apart and taking from.
- Solve addition and subtraction word problems, and add and subtract within 10.
- Fluently add and subtract within 5.
+++ Six games to consolidate knowledge +++
- Trace numbers from 0 to 10.
- Make a juice from the right number of fruits for thirsty Tashi.
- Place the puzzles in the right order, from the smallest to the biggest. 
- Put the right meerkat (with the right number) into it's aircraft. Compare groups and numbers. 
- Add with apples and numbers.
- Subtract with meerkats and numbers. 
- Choose car, win the race and improve your subtraction and addition skills. 
SNAIL TANK - The reward system
Stars are rewarded for each game which is completed. For each star that is earned, a snail, castle or plant is placed into a digital glass tank were the snails live and sleep. They can be cleaned, fed, cared for, and even dressed in cute little hats. This encourages children to keep practicing and learning in order to fill their tanks; little players have fun while learning to care for animals. 
+++ OVERALL FEATURES +++
* Effective learning tool
* Hundreds of bright, colorful and memorable sounds and illustrations.
* Simple and intuitive menus, navigation and gameplay.
* Developed and reviewed by experts in education.
* Delightful animations will help your kids learn numbers in a fun and engaging way.
* Frequent repetition designed to help learn numbers and their sequences.
* Aligned to Common Core Standards.
* A rich, exploratory environment filled with surprises.
* Funny, bright and creative artwork.
* Your little one can interact with the app at their own pace.
Designed by seasoned experts in early education and based on the proven Montessori approach, this app turns little players into little math wizards!
*****
If you’re experiencing difficulties with audio, please check the audio settings with your device to see if your device is muted. Don’t hesitate to contact customer care at contact@123kidsfun.com

bluejetty:00089417:ios.description:
Perfect for students, consultants, executives, lawyers, and other professionals aiming to achieve more in less time, this app effortlessly boosts productivity. It combines advanced text and voice recognition to instantly record, transcribe audio to text, translate, and edit any speech. Revolutionize the way you capture and organize information with FoxNote - AI Note Taker!
Designed specifically for the needs of adults with ADHD, FoxNote simplifies their daily routines, enhances focus, and helps bring order to chaos. Whether it’s converting voice to notes, structuring ideas, or keeping track of important details, this app is expertly crafted to tackle the challenges of ADHD, making productivity feel effortless.
FoxNote transcribes all your meetings, interviews, lectures, and everyday voice conversations in real time, so you can focus on what matters while the app takes care of the rest. Or make a transcript from video using the YouTube Summary feature—simply paste the link to gain instant insights.
WHY USERS LOVE FOXNOTE
- Speech to Text: Instantly record and transcribe voice memos into clear, organized notes—perfect on the go or during meetings.
- AI Flashcards: Grasp concepts faster and more effectively with concise flashcards.
- Quiz Maker: Prepare for exams or presentations in a fun, interactive way.
- YouTube Summary: Transcribe video to text and get its short-form summary in a matter of seconds.
- Smart Structuring: Capture key points during lectures or meetings, edit and organize your notes.
- Offline Accessibility: Take notes anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
MORE AI SUPERPOWERS
- Text Summarization: Save time and grasp the essence of long texts.
- Proofreading: Create polished, error-free notes without the hassle.
- Real-Time Translation: Break barriers by translating your content into multiple languages.
- Quick Sharing: Seamlessly share notes with friends, family, or colleagues.
- ADHD-Friendly: Stay organized and manage tasks effortlessly with smart AI tools.
Forget the hassle of manual meeting note taking! With its powerful AI for meetings, FoxNote ensures every detail is captured and organized, making it the ultimate tool for keeping track of important discussions and decisions.
Empower your days with our intelligent audio transcription app designed to simplify your life, keep you focused, and help accomplish more with less effort. Smart notes for busy minds!
Privacy Policy: https://ai-note-taker.app/privacy-policy
Term Of Use: https://ai-note-taker.app/terms-conditions
Support Email: support@ai-note-taker.app

bluejetty:00072893:ios.description:
NCLEX RN Test Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry exam experts. With more than 1,500 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the NCLEX RN certification exam on your first try!
NCLEX RN Test Prep 2026 now supports the National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses (NCLEX RN) exam preparation. Our experts will update and revise the content based on the latest exam syllabus provided by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN).
NCLEX RN Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,900 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the NCLEX RN certification exam can be difficult, but with the help of NCLEX RN Test Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the NCLEX RN exam, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of NCLEX RN Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

bluejetty:00029564:ios.name: Glucomate: Blood Sugar Tracker
bluejetty:00029564:ios.summary: Glucomate presents your blood glucose data in an elegant way with glanceable summaries and more detailed charts and lists of data. It can be used to record your blood sugar if you check manually – like a logbook – or it can read your glucos
bluejetty:00029564:ios.description:
Glucomate presents your blood glucose data in an elegant way with glanceable summaries and more detailed charts and lists of data. It can be used to record your blood sugar if you check manually – like a logbook – or it can read your glucose readings from HealthKit. Glucomate helps you review history and trends later on with beautiful summaries and charts, a detailed history view, along with sleep and workout comparisons.
Glucomate is your go-to companion for staying on top of your blood glucose. It works seamlessly with HealthKit on your device. It can access data from a CGM or other glucose monitoring device as long as it exists in HealthKit. Since any readings entered into Glucomate are stored in HealthKit, these readings become available to other apps that use the data.
Glucomate offers a completely free, full-featured Demo Mode. It lets you get a feel for the app before subscribing, or allows you to try out the app even if you don't record your own blood glucose in HealthKit.
Main features:
• Quick entry of blood glucose data into HealthKit on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
• An interactive widget for an even quicker way of entering a new blood glucose reading
• Complications on Apple Watch, widgets on iOS (may require your device to be unlocked for updates to come through)
• A summary of the current day, highlighting the most recent glucose reading, along with highs, lows, and time in range
• Look at glucose readings during workouts or sleep, and compare your waking glucose across days
• Detailed insights and analysis with information and trends from the last 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, or 365 days
• History view with averages, high/low information, time in range, and the ability to view all readings for a given day, along with readings during any sleep or workout from that day
• Customizable charts that you can show, hide, and reorder to personalize your app experience
• A full-featured Demo Mode allowing you to get a feel for the app without having real blood glucose readings in HealthKit
• Support for mmol/L and mg/dL units
Glucomate tries to be the perfect companion for people who monitor their blood glucose. Is something missing? Got an idea? We're always looking for feedback or new ideas. Feel free to get in touch via the "Contact" button in the app. We'd love to chat!
---
Glucomate contains an optional yearly subscription and/or lifetime in-app purchase unlock. A taste of some features is available for free, and some features can be trialed through a Demo Mode. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions and trials renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to expiration of the current period. To turn off auto-renew, and/or to manage your subscription, visit your iTunes/App Store account settings.
Privacy policy: https://glucomate.app/privacy
Terms: https://glucomate.app/terms
---
Glucomate respects your privacy. There's no third-party code, and potentially sensitive information such as data read from or written to HealthKit doesn't leave your device.

bluejetty:00160696:ios.description:
«ТоварБезПереплат» – это информационный сервис по подбору товаров по низким ценам для предварительного заказа у вас в городе!
Бытовая химия, товары для дома и дачи, косметика, средства по уходу за кожей и волосами, канцтовары, книги, товары для детей, белье, чулочно-носочные изделия и многое другое – на повседневных покупках можно экономить!
Выбирайте товары из нашего каталога с помощью поиска или штрихкода, формируйте заказ и забирайте покупку в удобном для вас пункте выдачи. Все товары – в наличие на складе. Заказ формируется сразу после его подтверждения. Доставка в пункт выдачи осуществляется в течение 3-17 дней в зависимости от города и пункта выдачи.
Простой и удобный сервис помогает покупателю подобрать товар по лучшей цене. Вы можете сравнить стоимость по цене за грамм/миллилитр или единицу. Если у вас возникают сложности с выбором или формированием заказа, служба поддержки окажет вам необходимую помощь.
Почему наши товары в приложении стоят дешевле? Мы напрямую работаем с производителями и официальными дистрибьюторами, что позволяет нам гарантировать минимальную цену и высочайшее качество представленных товаров. Мы не несем затраты на рекламу, торговые площади и персонал в магазинах и не закладываем эти расходы в стоимость товаров для наших покупателей. 
Товар Без Переплат – никаких акций, просто низкие цены!

bluejetty:00078010:ios.name: Vision Board Perfectly Happy
bluejetty:00078010:ios.summary:
Perfectly Happy is a vision board app designed for visualization, daily affirmations, motivation, and a positive mindset.
It helps you clearly define your goals, track your emotional well-being, and turn your dream life into everyday realit
bluejetty:00078010:ios.description:
Perfectly Happy is a vision board app designed for visualization, daily affirmations, motivation, and a positive mindset.
It helps you clearly define your goals, track your emotional well-being, and turn your dream life into everyday reality.
Using a combination of digital vision boards, daily affirmations, a mood tracker, music, and gratitude journaling, Perfectly Happy supports one of the most effective mindset techniques: visualization. By seeing your goals regularly and connecting them with positive emotions, you train your mind to stay focused, motivated, and confident.
Why a vision board app works
Visualization and daily affirmations are scientifically supported techniques used by successful athletes, artists, entrepreneurs, and CEOs. When practiced consistently, they help replace negative thought patterns with positive ones, strengthen self-belief, and improve emotional balance.
Perfectly Happy brings these techniques together in one powerful vision board app, always available on your phone.
Create your personal digital vision board
With Perfectly Happy, you can create a digital vision board (also called a dream board or mind movie) that represents your goals and desired life:
- Choose your own photos or search millions of images from built-in image libraries
- Add daily affirmations and motivation quotes
- Combine images, affirmations, music, and spoken words
- Instantly generate an inspiring vision board video that brings your goals to life
The more vivid and emotionally engaging your vision board is, the easier it becomes to stay aligned with your goals.
Daily affirmations, mood tracking & gratitude journal
Perfectly Happy supports long-term change through simple daily habits:
- Over 6,000 daily affirmations and motivation quotes
- Widgets for your home screen
- Daily reminders to view your vision board
- A built in mood tracker to reflect on how you feel each day
- Gratitude journaling to shift your focus toward positivity and abundance
Tracking your mood alongside affirmations and visualization helps you build awareness, stay consistent, and maintain a happy mood over time.
Easy, intuitive & flexible
The app is designed for beginners and advanced users alike. Creating a vision board takes just a few minutes a day and fits easily into any routine.
You can use Perfectly Happy for many areas of life, including:
- Positive mindset & self-confidence
- Motivation & focus
- Career & finances
- Health, body positivity & weight loss
- Stress reduction, sleep & emotional balance
- Relationships, family & spirituality
What you’ll gain
- Clearer goals and priorities
- Increased motivation and focus
- Improved emotional awareness through mood tracking
- More balance, resilience, and well-being
Today, 250,000+ happy visualizers worldwide use Perfectly Happy as their vision board app, affirmations app, and mood tracker.
Start visualizing your dream life today.
Download Perfectly Happy for free and begin your journey toward a happier, more focused you.
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
We offer an annual subscription model for $58.99 that can be canceled at any time. The subscription automatically renews if it is not canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your iTunes account will be charged for the next subscription period within the last 24 hours of the current subscription period. The automatic renewal can be deactivated in the iTunes account settings.
If you have feedback for us, please send it to INFO@PERFECTLYHAPPY.COM. We have put a lot of time & love into our app & therefore look forward to receiving positive feedback. We are also happy to receive suggestions & ideas for improvement, so that we can make the app even better & more interesting for you & others. The app integrates with the APPLE HEALTH APP.
Data & Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions:
https://perfectlyhappy.com/en/terms-and-conditions/
https://perfectlyhappy.com/en/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00121415:ios.description:
Aloha! Welcome to the Hawaiian Airlines app! Our goal: smooth and worry-free travel experience when you travel with us. From streamlined booking to faster check-in, paperless boarding passes, and real-time flight notifications, you'll have everything you need for your travel needs, all in the palm of your hand.
Flight Booking — Search for flights and book a trip to your favorite destinations right in the app.
Enhanced Check-in Experience — Start your day of travel right. Check in up to 24 hours before your flight and your upcoming trip will be ready to view and manage on-the-go.
Trip Management — Once you’ve checked in, view, change or upgrade your seat, check that your flight is on time, see the upgrade list and more.
Mobile Boarding Pass — Access your boarding pass from the convenience of your phone. No paper printing needed! Boarding pass will automatically update if there's a change and is always accessible in the app, even if you are offline. You can also store it in your Apple Wallet.
Real-Time Notifications — Stay informed with up-to-the-minute notifications if your gate or flight time change.
Up-to-the-Minute Flight Status — Get the latest flight departure and arrival times, with ability to “watch” flights and get notified if things change.
Interactive Airport Maps — Get interactive indoor airport maps with turn-by-turn walking directions to your gate, baggage claim, restaurants and lounges at our busiest airports.
Chat with an Agent — Need help? Connect with a Hawaiian Airlines agent quickly and conveniently through the in-app chat and get answers to your questions when you need them.
In-Flight Entertainment — If you’re traveling on our A321neo aircraft, use the app to stream movies, TV shows and more from your mobile device.
Trip Planning — Need help planning an epic trip to Hawaii? Visit our Island Guide for information about each island’s unique character and recommendations for hikes, beaches, restaurants and more.
Standby / Upgrade Waitlist — Know where you are on the Standby or Upgrade list.
Rideshare — Quickly hail a ride from the app to or from the airport with rideshare companies Uber and Lyft.
Mahalo for downloading our app! We’re always making improvements and adding more features. For more information about the app, including frequently asked questions, please visit www.HawaiianAirlines.co

bluejetty:00026404:ios.name: Articulation Teacher - Speech
bluejetty:00026404:ios.summary:
Improve your child's articulation and pronunciation! Brought to you by a Speech Language Pathologist and the creator of the SpeakEasy: Home Speech Therapy app which has accelerated early language development for over 100,000 families.
With
bluejetty:00026404:ios.description:
Improve your child's articulation and pronunciation! Brought to you by a Speech Language Pathologist and the creator of the SpeakEasy: Home Speech Therapy app which has accelerated early language development for over 100,000 families.
With Articulation Teacher, you choose specific sounds to work on with your child. You can work on Early Sounds like D or T, Middle Sounds like G or S, or Late Sounds like L or R. 
Articulation Teacher includes at home articulation activities to do with your child outside of the app as well as games to play with your child in the app. All suggestions are evidence-based and research-backed. Let's dive into what each sound set includes:
---
In-App Games
Our articulation games are best played side by side with your child, but if your child is up for it they can play the games on their own as well. For each sound, we have the following games:
Splat: say the selected word, and have your child splat it from the choices on the screen!
Name It: our simplest game, this is meant for rapidly trying to say different words using digital flash cards. Swipe to the next word and help your child say it out loud.
Sound Check: look at and listen to each word, and have your child decide whether the word includes the sound you're working on or not.
Space Match: play this out-of-this-world memory game, saying each word as you flip over each card, to work on both articulation and cognitive skills.
Paper Games: print a list of articulation practice words and play these games around your house, bringing articulation practice directly into the world around you.
---
Home Activities
Each sound has 5 activities to try with your child at home. You can read these activities ahead of time, then do them with your child when you can. We recommend trying to do at least one Home Activity each day, and we encourage repetition as much as possible!
Home Activities that focus on pronunciation and articulation are the most effective way to spend time with your child to work on speech development. We use videos, books, songs, and the world around you to help integrate articulation practice into every day.
---
What Sounds and Letters Are Included?
In Articulation Teacher, you can work on the following sounds:
Early Sounds: B, P, M, D, T, N, and Vowels
Intermediate Sounds: K, G, W, F, S, SH, and Multisyllabic Words
Advanced Sounds: L, Final -L, R, R Blends, S Blends, and TH
---
More Features
Each sound also has an intro video that teaches you how the sound is made, as well as a digital and printable cue card which you can use to help remind your child to pronounce a sound. This cue card fits within the cueing hierarchy explained in the intro video. Cues are an essential part of articulation practice that we integrate directly into our games and activities.
Plus, check out developmental milestones to know if your child is on track, and read free learning articles related to articulation development.
Articulation Teacher is also meant to be used by SLPs during their sessions as an aid to articulation practice.
For more speech and language activities, including learning key language stimulation strategies, try our other app, SpeakEasy: Home Speech Therapy. Please note, Articulation Teacher is not affiliated with Articulation Station.
Download and become an Articulation Teacher at home today!

bluejetty:00042147:ios.name: Frame Grab
bluejetty:00042147:ios.summary: Frame Grab makes it easy to capture and share any moment from videos stored on your device as still images in JPEG or HEIF format. It supports not only videos stored in the Photos app, but also those in the Music, Podcasts, and TV apps, as
bluejetty:00042147:ios.description:
Frame Grab makes it easy to capture and share any moment from videos stored on your device as still images in JPEG or HEIF format. It supports not only videos stored in the Photos app, but also those in the Music, Podcasts, and TV apps, as long as they are downloaded to your device.
◇◇◇ How to Use ◇◇◇
◆When you launch the app, a list of video categories appears: Photos, Live Photos, Music Videos, Home Videos, Movies, TV Shows, and Podcasts.
◆Tap a category to view its videos, then tap a video to open the player view.
◆Move the playhead to the desired frame. Use the buttons on either side of the play button to step forward or backward one frame at a time.
◆Save Option 1:
Tap the Share button to save the displayed frame to the Photos app, or share it with other apps and services.
◆Save Option 2:
Tap the gray circle button to temporarily save the displayed frame to the Queue. Repeat this for other frames as needed. When you’re ready, tap the red badge showing the number of queued items to open the Queue and save multiple frames at once to the Photos app, or share them with other apps and services.
◆Choose an image format:
Choose JPEG or HEIF in “Settings” > “Image Export Settings” > “Format”.
◇◇◇ Settings ◇◇◇
◆Live Photos:
Choose whether to show Live Photos videos.
◆Quality:
Low, Low-Mid, Hi-Mid, High
◆Size:
Actual size of original video
Half size of original video
Maximum 1920, 960 or 640 pixels
◆Location Info:
Choose whether to embed location data as Exif metadata in the extracted photos. Applies only if the video contains location information.
◆Date-Time Info:
Choose whether to embed the shooting date and time as Exif metadata in the extracted photos.
◇◇◇ Other Features ◇◇◇
◆Playback Speed:
0.5x, 1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x
◆Continuous Grabbing:
Extract multiple frames at user-defined intervals and save them to the Queue.
◇◇◇ Note ◇◇◇ 
◆No recording feature included.
◆Protected videos — such as movies downloaded from the Apple TV Store — cannot be displayed.
◆Images in the Queue may be cleared when either the app or the OS is updated.
◆Videos recorded on iPhone or iPad store only the location where the recording started. Images extracted from the same video will contain the same location information.

Track your sleep with just your phone using Sleepwave’s patented silent sonar technology. Understand your sleep, build healthy habits and wak
bluejetty:00174780:ios.description:
Wake up feeling fresh with Sleepwave, the free motion-sensing smart alarm and sleep tracking app!
Track your sleep with just your phone using Sleepwave’s patented silent sonar technology. Understand your sleep, build healthy habits and wake up at a great moment with a smart alarm that responds to your body movements.
From the creators of SnoreLab, Sleepwave has been featured as App of the Day on the App Store in over 100 countries.
Key features:
CONTACTLESS SLEEP TRACKING
• Track your sleep with just your phone. 
• Sleepwave uses patented silent sonar technology to sense your sleep through motion.
• Wake up to a detailed yet easy-to-understand analysis of your sleep.
SMART ALARM CLOCK — WAKE UP FRESH
• Wake up in sync with your body with Sleepwave's motion-sensing smart alarm.
• Start your day feeling fresh and wake up at a great time.
• Snooze less. Sleep more.
GENTLE ALARM SOUNDS
• Wake up gently with nature sounds and original alarm soundscapes.
• Ease into your morning with Sleepwave’s gentle awakening feature, which plays soft sounds before your main alarm.
• Create your own soundscapes and fall asleep to relaxing sounds.
BUILD HEALTHY SLEEP HABITS
• Set a sleep goal.
• Build a consistent sleep routine with simple goals and a clearer understanding of your sleep.
IMMERSIVE VISUALS THAT RESPOND TO MOVEMENT
• Relax with soft glowing orbs that respond to your movement.
• Designed for low-light conditions, these visuals create a calming atmosphere as you fall asleep.
SOUND RECORDINGS
• Do you snore or talk in your sleep? Find out with Sleepwave's sound recordings.
TIMER MODE
• Power down with a nap or switch to timer mode for focused work or deep relaxation.
SLEEP MEDITATIONS
• Fall asleep better with guided meditations designed to help you unwind and relax.
DREAM JOURNAL
• Write or speak about your dreams to remember and reflect on them.
DAILY GOAL
• Set an intention for tomorrow and start your day with purpose.
HAPTIC SMART ALARM FOR APPLE WATCH
• Wake up at a great time with silent taps on your wrist and get even more detailed sleep insights.
iOS CUSTOMIZATION & WIDGETS
• Access your sleep insights through Lock Screen, Home Screen and Control Center widgets.
• Track your sleep progress with Live Activities.
• Use Siri Shortcuts to start sleep tracking or set alarms with your voice.
APPLE MUSIC AND APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
• Fall asleep or wake up to your favorite music and playlists.
• Write your sleep data to Apple Health to monitor your sleep and wellbeing.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
• Featured as App of the Day on the App Store in 100+ countries.
SLEEPWAVE SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Free Until 2027
Enjoy full access to Sleepwave for free until 31 December 2026.
No subscription or payment is required during this period. You will not be automatically charged when the free access period ends.
From January 2027, continued access to premium features may require a paid subscription. Pricing and subscription options will be provided before you choose to subscribe.
Your use of the app is subject to our Terms of Use https://sleepwave.com/terms-conditions and Privacy Policy https://sleepwave.com/website-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00179594:ios.summary:
Welcome to Pomodoro Hero !
The Pomodoro Technique is a time management system that encourages people to work with the time they have—rather than against it
This is about focus
Using this method, you break your workday into 25-minute chunks
bluejetty:00179594:ios.description:
Welcome to Pomodoro Hero !
The Pomodoro Technique is a time management system that encourages people to work with the time they have—rather than against it
This is about focus
Using this method, you break your workday into 25-minute chunks separated by five-minute breaks. These intervals are referred to as pomodoros.
What do you do in a 5 minute Pomodoro break?
One important thing to remember is that this short break is meant to be a break. The key here is you should spend the time doing something completely different than what you had been doing. You can have a short walk,meditate, drink water, stretch, clean etc.."
Benefits
This technique is an effective way to achieve a balance between quantity and quality, and all you have to do is focus for 25 minutes at a time
How to use Pomodoro Hero?
1. Determine the project to complete
2. Start the Pomodoro Timer (by default is set to 25 minutes but you can adjust in settings)
3. Concentrate on finishing the task to be completed until the Productivity Timer sounds
4. When the timer sounds you can have a break (by default is set to 5 minutes but you can adjust in settings)
5. During the break try to accomplish the recommended habits
6. When the short or long break timer sounds, begin at step 1 again.
POMODORO HERO FEATURES
TIMER
-Customizable pomodoro/breaks lengths
-Notification at the end of a Pomodoro
-Habit suggestions for short and long breaks
-Skip a break after the end of a Pomodoro
-Define interval for long breaks
-Customisable sounds for the alerts
-Half-way alarm - Get notified when you are just in the middle of the pomodoro
-Almost-complete alarm - Get notified when you are about to finish a pomodoro
-Sound Ticking
PROJECTS
- Create as many projects you want
- Define weekly goals per project
- See statistics per project
- Customizable pomodoro/breaks lengths per project
STATISTICS
Pomodoro Hero will keep track of your completed sessions so you can analyse these later in an easy way with our built-in charts
HABITS
As already mentioned above breaks are meant to be a time for relaxation or even better to create new healthy habits.. so during breaks Pomodoro Hero will suggest good habits to do during the 5-minutes break. You can create your own habits from the settings panel.
TROPHIES
Keeping motivated is a very important thing in the road to productivity so we have implemented a trophy system which will keep track of your progress within the app. Are you ready to unlock all the achievements?
THEMES
Dark mode is set by default but you can disable from Settings.
BACKUP
Are you changing your phone and want to keep your historical data? No problem. Take advantage of the backup feature and store it locally or in the cloud.

The Patient Controller (PC) Application was developed by Abbott for people living with chronic pain a
bluejetty:00092286:ios.description:
This app is for use with Abbott rechargeable devices including the Eterna™ Spinal Cord Stimulation system and the Liberta RC™ DBS system. 
The Patient Controller (PC) Application was developed by Abbott for people living with chronic pain and movement disorders who are treated by Abbott neuromodulation devices. This application helps patients conveniently manage the programs prescribed by their physicians and uses Bluetooth® wireless technology to communicate between the implanted stimulator, Charger and the Patient Controller App. The Patient Controller Application runs on Abbott recommended devices (as mentioned below) and is easy to use, while the wireless interface provides patients the convenience of managing prescribed stimulation settings from a familiar iOS device.
Some of the key functions available for patients include:
- Turn stimulation ON/OFF
- Select stimulation programs for changing therapy needs
- Adjust stimulation amplitude
- Check device battery
- Monitor charging of the implanted stimulator
- Adjust charger settings
- Turn on MRI mode for MR Conditional systems
- Activate and de-activate Surgery Mode
In addition, NeuroSphere™ Virtual Clinic on the PC app enables users to connect with their clinicians for routine programming adjustments remotely. Secure in-app video chat enables telehealth sessions directly from within the PC application.
THIS APP DOES NOT PROVIDE MEDICAL ADVICE, NOR SHOULD BE REGARDED AS COMPRISING MEDICAL ADVICE OF ANY NATURE. THE APP IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR THE PROFESSIONAL JUDGEMENT AND TREATMENT BY A PHYSICIAN OR MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL. PATIENTS SHOULD CONSULT WITH THEIR PHYSICIAN PRIOR TO MAKING ANY MEDICAL DECISIONS. IF YOU SUSPECT YOU MAY HAVE A MEDICAL EMERGENCY, PLEASE CONTACT EMERGENCY SERVICES OR YOUR HEALTHCARE PROVIDER.
Note:
- This application will work on select Appleⱡ iPhoneⱡ devices running iOS 15.6.1 or later.
- For a list of compatible devices see https://www.NMmobiledevicesync.com/cp 
- For the Privacy Policy see https://www.virtualclinic.abbott/policies
- For the Terms of Use see https://www.virtualclinic.abbott/policies
- ⱡ iPhone is a registered trademark of Apple, Inc.
- Bluetooth is a registered trademark of Bluetooth SIG

bluejetty:00061710:ios.description:

A POINT OF SALE DESIGNED FOR RETAIL

EMPLOYEE TOOLS FOR EVERY BUSINESS SIZE

bluejetty:00180190:ios.description:
The Quran app (القران) is ultimate companion for every Muslim to listen, read, search and learn the Holy Quran. Choose from 35+ world-famous reciters and listen to high quality audio quran with clear translations in 100+ languages. Personalize your Quran pak reading by selecting your preferred language, Juz, and Surah index giving you full control over how you recite the entire Mushaf. 
The Quran Explorer advanced search engine finds your searched Arabic word from quran and suggests similar Arabic words with quranic verses and details across entire kuran. Enjoy high quality audio recitations with verse highlights, auto-scroll Ayats, and flexible controls to repeat listening verses, chapters, or the full Kuran. 
The Quran app (القران) lets you save bookmarks, collections, compare translations, take quran sharif tafseer notes, share verses as text or images, resume quran recitation, explore word by word grammar, corpus, quran dictionary and cloud storage. Custom font sizes to make recitation comfortable for readers. The Al Quran pro app (القران) lets memorize al quran kareem easily through auto replay of quran audio verses.
It gives you the feel of holding a real coran mushaf in your hands, making your Islamic journey of Arabic learning and reading quran karim with tajweed easier. This Koran pak app aims to convey Allah’s message, deepen understanding, and strengthen your faith and deen.
100+ QURAAN TRANSLATIONS:
Al Quran App (القران) is giving translations in over 100+ languages including quran in English, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Malaysian, Russian, Urdu, and more.
35+ AUDIO QURAN RECITORS:
The Al Quran app (القران) features Audio Quran by 35+ world famous clear quran reciters, including Abdul Basit, Al-Sudais, Mishary rashid alafasy, Ahmed Ajmi and more. 
QURANIC SCRIPTS: 
The Quran app (القران) allows you to recite quran mosshaf and memorize Quran karim in arabic uthmani, arabic naskh (Indopak/Persian) or simple koran scripts. Recite surah yaseen, surah rehman, surah mulk easily.
ADVANCED SEARCH:
Dive deep with the text, voice, and Jump to verse option that finds your desired verse, surah, parah, insights on word occurrences, related Arabic words across the entire coran sharif.
WORD BY WORD GRAMMAR:
Read the Holy Quran (القران) with detailed free quran dictionary, grammar,corpus, tajweed word by word Lemma Information & English translation to enhance your Arabic learning, study, knowledge and Iman. 
BOOKMARK & COLLECTIONS:
The Quran app allows unlimited bookmarks, resume tilawat e Quran Pak from where you left off and create dedicated collections for saving verses in folders like duas, wazaif, and more
NOTES & COMPARE:
Take Quran tafsir notes, save detailed Tafseer with each verse, and compare multiple verses/Ayats translations side-by-side.
NAVIGATION: 
The Al Quran app (القران) lets you scroll through pages, swipe to the next surahs, and jump to any parah reading with multiple qari voices.
ONLINE/OFFLINE QURAN READING: 
Instantly download and play surahs, listen offline quran or online mp3 quran recitations, and easily pick up right where you left off with the Quran majeed app (القران).
CLOUD DATA:
Access your Al Quran app data instantly with a simple sign-in. All notes and collections are securely synced across devices and cloud, with automatic restoration upon app reinstallation.
SHARE:
Share your favorite verses as text or images on Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter, Telegram, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Messenger and many more platforms.
THEMES: 
Quran app (القران) offers dark and light themes for comfortable recitation of holy quran sharif.
MULTILINGUAL:
The Quran app (القران) is available in 11+ languages, making it easy to read, learn, and share Quran Majeed.
Help us improve, Share your suggestions at: support@the-quran.app.

Your Birth Chart
- Break through the clutter. Get a clean astrology app that gives exactly what you need, in the detail and with the best accuracy. Create a profile just once and see an extremely personalized report every day.
- Your birth or natal chart is a view of the heavens for a precise time, date, and location. Get your birth chart created along with key points such as the Moon phase, the preponderance of elements, qualities, and hemisphere emphasis.
- What are your ascendant and ascendant ruler and what do they denote.
- A personalized report of your birth chart giving you detailed information on each of your planet profiles with their house, sign, and dispositor.

Numerology - Numbers for you
- Numerology is a way of finding, through mathematics, the energies we are working within this lifetime. Instant access to your personal numbers such as Life Path Number, Personality Number, Expression Number, Challenge Numbers, Soul Urge Number, and Sub Conscious Number.
- Get a deeper insight into your personality by our numerological interpretations for Life Path, Personality, and Expression numbers.
Daily Horoscopes

- Written by expert astrologers on a daily basis.
Vedic Astrology Tools
- In addition to Western Astrology, Up Astrology also covers various methods of Vedic Astrology calculations and report making. 
- It has Nakshatra Predictions, Biorhythms, KP Kundli, Varshphal Kundli, and Pancha-Pakshi calculations
- Complete Vedic Panchang along with Hindu Festivals and Vratas are all added in this app.

How it works
- Simply create your profile with the birth date, time, and place and you are ready to explore yourself astrologically. Up Astrology, the app is your personal astrology coach.
- You can also add your friends' and family members’ birth details and start viewing their natal charts, solar returns, and much more.

bluejetty:00083302:ios.description:
Help Megan stop the villain who is changing the story of the Dracula novel!
Play a thrilling hidden object adventure game, search for hidden items, and solve fun puzzles!
Will you manage to uncover the mystery of Book Travelers: A Gothic Story? Test your skills in solving engaging puzzles, exploring unusual locations, and unlocking all the secrets of the man in the iron mask. Discover the mystery of what surprises Dracula’s castle holds for Megan.
Dracula kidnaps Megan straight from her bed and wants to make her his bride. Megan must uncover the mystery of the conflict between Dracula and his brides, reconcile them, and discover who is behind these sinister events.
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden object game. You can unlock the full version via an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHY DRACULA THINKS MEGAN’S THE ONE
Why does Dracula want to marry Megan? Dive into an exciting plot filled with mystery and twists. This game is perfect for fans of mystery detective games and unsolved mysteries games.
WHY DRACULA GETS WEAKER EVERY DAY?
Solve fun riddle games, engage in puzzle adventures, and complete mini-games to uncover why the mighty Dracula is weakening every day and who is behind his deteriorating condition. Find and seek hidden objects, missing artifacts, and hidden items! Immerse yourself in fantasy locations and complete mini-games in this thrilling puzzle adventure.
LEARN IF YOU CAN ESCAPE DRACULA’S CASTLE ALIVE
Escape the dungeon and explore the headman's house to uncover vital clues about Dracula’s antagonist. Complete things searching games and feel the thrilling suspense caused by unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO TOM SAWYER IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Megan’s friend, Tom Sawyer, and prepare a birthday surprise for her, as she hasn’t had a warm, cheerful holiday in a long time. Enjoy exclusive bonuses in the Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements and search for collectibles and puzzle pieces!
Book Travelers: A Gothic Story one of the searching games where you need to find hidden items like a detective. Help Megan uncover the secrets behind Dracula's quarrels with his brides, reconcile them, and find out who is behind these eerie events.
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more! 
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use hints if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00173950:ios.name: Smart Switch my Phone Transfer
bluejetty:00173950:ios.summary: All users look for apps to solve everyday problems: using a GPS to get to another place, playing games to kill time on the subway, knowing how many calories they have burned exercising, etc. But what happens when we have changed mobile phon
bluejetty:00173950:ios.description:
All users look for apps to solve everyday problems: using a GPS to get to another place, playing games to kill time on the subway, knowing how many calories they have burned exercising, etc. But what happens when we have changed mobile phones and we don't want to lose any contacts, documents, photos or videos? From Zed Italia we give you the solution!
Smart Switch my Phone allows you to transfer data from your old phone to the new one. This app works by creating a WiFi hotspot, no internet, cables or Bluetooth needed.
With Smart Switch my Phone, you can move your contacts, photos, videos, messages and music with just a few taps. Simply copy all your data from your old phone and transfer it to your new phone using one of the most cutting-edge apps on the market. The data being transferred is secure with end-to-end encryption. Transfer large amounts of data in minutes.
You don't want to copy all the data, you want to transfer just some files? Smart Switch also has a single file sharing module, it copies a single file and sends it only. Transfer the files you want to transfer.
Characteristics
⇄ Move all your data to your new smartphone.
⇄ Works with internet, cables or Bluetooth. Transfer data without any interference.
⇄ Data transfer is secure at both ends. Simply scan the QR code to start the transfer.
⇄ Transfer speeds are up to 200 times faster than Bluetooth.
⇄ The application allows you to select the data you need to transfer.
⇄ Once you select everything you need to transfer, the app shows you an estimated completion time.
⇄ Show your transfer history in one place.
⇄ The app shows the free and used space on your phone.
⇄ Comes with a well-designed and easy-to-use user interface.
⇄ Single file sharing module, it is also possible to share a single file.
⇄ Cross-platform file sharing ⇄
Smart Switch now allows users to transfer and move data from any device to iPhone and vice versa. It's perfect for people who have upgraded to a phone with a different operating system. The procedure for sending and receiving remains practically identical. However, as always, both devices must have the latest respective version of Smart Switch my Phone installed.
How to use:
1. After installation, the user must give the Smart Switch my Phone app all the permissions it requires.
2. As a sender, simply select the files you want to transfer and press "Share".
3. The app will create a personal hotspot and a QR code will be displayed on the screen.
4. To start the transfer by creating a connection, the receiver must scan the QR code.
5. User can find all their transferred files on the transfer history page.
Some of the data we collect
- Device-specific information, such as the device model and the version of the operating system being used. This provides insight into how our app is used so we can improve the user experience and the app itself.
- We collect anonymous data such as statistics, analytics and information about your activity to provide you with a high-quality and reliable experience.
- Payment details and an optional email (if you use Paid Services).
-----------
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
Privacy Policy: https://www.zedit.info/PrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of use: https://www.zedit.info/Service_Terms.html

Just a few of the many reasons you’ll find “Your Happy Place” on One happy island.

bluejetty:00073599:ios.name: Evite: Party Invitation Maker
bluejetty:00073599:ios.summary: Evite helps you connect with friends and family for your most important life moments—from kids' birthdays to weddings to holidays—by offering 1000s of Free and Premium digital invitations for every occasion. With Evite's easy-to-use invitat
bluejetty:00073599:ios.description:
Evite helps you connect with friends and family for your most important life moments—from kids' birthdays to weddings to holidays—by offering 1000s of Free and Premium digital invitations for every occasion. With Evite's easy-to-use invitation maker, you can be the invitation creator you've always wanted to be! You can make invitations and save the dates, then email or text invites and track RSVPs for free—all right from our iPhone app. As the most popular invitation maker app, we make party planning effortless and even more memorable for everyone!
FREE TEMPLATES & RSVP TRACKING TOOLS
Customize your artwork, event title, time, location, host message, gift options and RSVP settings.
Choose from animated, designer, and branded templates for birthdays, weddings and more.
Track RSVPs for free on the Evite app.
Set up iOS notifications to get real-time guest updates.
See when each guest has viewed the invitation.
Send in-app messages to guests you choose.
SIGN-UP LISTS AND GIFTING OPTIONS
Create sign-up lists, what to bring lists, and polls—perfect for potlucks, weddings, school events and more.
Easily share registry links with your guests for Baby Showers, Weddings, Housewarmings and more.
Set up Crowdfunding and Charity Donations directly on your invitation page via Pledge.
TEXT INVITATIONS & SHAREABLE LINKS
Send invitations via SMS or email.
Import guests directly from your phone contacts. 
Use past guest lists for recurring events.
Send a unique shareable link on social media apps.
UPLOAD YOUR OWN
Upload your own photo directly from your camera roll.
Upload your own custom artwork or design into one of our templates.
GUEST EVENT DASHBOARD
RSVP (including your plus-ones!) after receiving your text or email invite.
View event details on-the-go and never miss an event update.
Message back-and-forth with your host and other guests right from your mobile phone or tablet.
Come back to relive memories by visiting the event invitation at any time. Your past events are saved in your profile, so you can find them with ease.
PREMIUM INVITATIONS
Customize your invitation with envelopes, liners, stickers, and backgrounds
Seamless ad-free experience for guests
All Premium invitation payments will be charged to your iCloud account at confirmation of purchase.
EVITE PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Take the pain out of managing professional and year-round events with an Evite Pro subscription. 
Enjoy unlimited ad-free invitations, invite up to 2,500 guests per event and track guest attendance.
When you purchase an Evite Pro subscription: 
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, at which point your account will be charged.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iCloud Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.evite.com/mobile/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.evite.com/mobile/privacy

bluejetty:00177411:ios.description:
Discover an amazing world of 1000+ Nonogram puzzles! Solve a logic number puzzle to uncover a hidden picture of pixel art. Clean your mind.& train your brain. Start playing our picture cross puzzle at an easy level, and become a real Nonogram master! Download & Challenge ! 
Nonogram is picture logic puzzle，you just need to follow the basic rules and logic to reveal the hidden picture. Squares on the board must be colored or left blank, numbers show how many squares to color. Numbers above the column are read from top-to-bottom. Numbers to the left of the rows are read from left-to-right. According the numbers, color a square or mark it with an X. 
Nonogram is also known as Picture Cross, Hanjie, Picross or Griddlers. Nonogram is a kind of picture number puzzle such as Sudoku, it’s a great exercise for your brain!  There are 1000+ pixel logic puzzles, and new puzzles added every day. Solve the logic number puzzles and train your brain NOW! 
You only need to follow two steps to get start: 
1-Look at the numbers at the ends the rows and columns; 
2-Use logic to fill the blocks and discover the hidden picture! 
Griddlers will help you to have a good time no matter wherever you are! Nanogram are suitable for almost everyone. Pass the time solving griddler puzzles and play japanese sudoku puzzles everyday. Perhaps solving number puzzles will turn into a good habit over time. 
Our quick in-game tutorial will have you solving picture cross challenge puzzles like a genius of sudoku -like puzzle games in no time! 
■ 5 difficulty modes for the challenge. Choose the Griddlers game difficulty level that is best for you. 
■ Massive themed puzzle await you to complete. Don’t forget to receive your Achievement rewards. 
■ Relieve stress with relaxing BGM. Gentle music calms you down. 
■ Discover new puzzles at your own pace. Unlock more and more new worlds. 
■ Sign in with Facebook\ Apple to save your progress & play on multiple devices. Also, you can like us in Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NonogramPicrossLogicPuzzles/
◆ SUBSCRIPTION TERMS ◆ 
Length of Subscription: 1 week 
Price: 3 days free trial then $7.99/Week 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period 
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal 
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00180021:ios.summary: In today’s fast-paced world, staying on top of your communication is crucial. Imagine never missing a birthday message, forgetting an important appointment, or failing to follow up with a client again. Welcome to Moxy Messenger, the ultimat
bluejetty:00180021:ios.description:
In today’s fast-paced world, staying on top of your communication is crucial. Imagine never missing a birthday message, forgetting an important appointment, or failing to follow up with a client again. Welcome to Moxy Messenger, the ultimate iOS app for scheduling texts and emails ahead of time. Whether you’re a busy professional, a parent, a student, or a small business owner, Moxy Messenger empowers you to master your messaging and stay organized effortlessly.
Why Moxy Messenger?
With over 15,000 satisfied users since our launch in 2018, Moxy Messenger has become a trusted platform for message scheduling on iOS. Our users rely on Moxy Messenger to ensure their important messages are sent at the right time, every time. Join our growing community and experience the convenience and reliability that Moxy Messenger offers.
Relatable Use Cases:
• For Parents: Schedule morning messages, chore reminders, and daily check-ins with ease, ensuring you stay connected with your family throughout the day.
• For Professionals: Set up meeting reminders, promotional messages, and client follow-ups to maintain consistent communication and drive business growth.
• For Students: Coordinate study reminders, project deadlines, class notes, and social events, helping you manage your academic and social life effectively.
• For Creators: Plan messages for optimal engagement, stay organized with content scheduling, and boost your productivity.
Community Trust:
“I have used this app numerous times to schedule my messages for the morning. I’m a night owl and often get ideas at night. Being able to schedule those messages in an organized way is wonderful.” - Moxy User
Join thousands of satisfied users who trust Moxy Messenger to manage their messaging needs. Our app ensures that your messages are sent from your device, when you say so, with no need for app credits, third parties, or privacy concerns.
Important Note on Automatic Sending:
While Moxy Messenger streamlines the process of scheduling messages, it's important to note that Apple currently restricts third-party apps from automatically sending messages on your behalf. Therefore, at the scheduled time, Moxy Messenger will send you a notification reminder to manually send your message. This restriction is beyond our control, but we are committed to providing auto-sending functionality if Apple ever changes this policy.
How Moxy Messenger Works:
Choose a Message Type: Plan texts and emails for various messaging apps like iMessage, WhatsApp, and Gmail.
Add Recipients: Select recipients from your contacts or manually add their information.
Select a Date: Choose when you want to send your message. Edit and reschedule at any time.
Finish & Save: Type your message and save it to schedule. You can make edits or cancel at any time.
Time to Send: Receive a notification reminder with the message attached. Simply tap the notification to send or reschedule your message.
Features:
Supports SMS, iMessages, Apple Mail, Google Mail, WhatsApp, and group messages
Edit or reschedule any scheduled message
Attach images to scheduled messages and emails
Cancel a message from being sent
Schedule unlimited messages
Reclaim Your Mental Space:
Unload those random thoughts, free up your headspace, and get your time back with Moxy Messenger. Schedule messages for childcare, appointments, follow-ups, special occasions, and more, all with the ease of our intuitive app.
Join Us:
We invite you to experience the difference with Moxy Messenger. Download our app today and take control of your communication. We hope you enjoy using Moxy Messenger as much as we enjoyed creating it for you!
- The Moxy Team

https://www.moxymessenger.com/terms
Privacy Policy:
https://www.moxymessenger.com/privacy

bluejetty:00129314:ios.description:
“Don’t worry. When the rain stops, rainbow will rise.”
■ Somewhere is
a sound app that provides you with soothing and healing sounds created with various sounds from around us such as weather, place, and season.
■ Use
Changing mood, relieving stress and tension, taking a break, enhancing concentration, inducing sleep, putting a baby to sleep, meditation, yoga, studying, reading, working, creative activities, etc.
■ Features
1. Easy control of the volume of each sound
You can control the on/off and volume of each sound separately.
2. Seamless playback
The sound will not disrupt or wake you up with unnatural transition or repetition. 
3. Unnecessary sound excluded
We did not include unnecessary sounds just to expand the number of sources.
4. Add My Music
You can listen to your music by adding them to this app instead of turning on a music player app.
5. Plays at the same time with other app’s music
You can use this at the same time with other apps that play games, music, or videos.
6. Timer with fade-out feature
You can set the ending time, and when the time comes the sound will slowly fade out.
7. Support Screen Rotation (portrait, landscape)
You can rotate the screen in the Option Menu. 
8. Offline access
You can use this app without connecting to Wi-Fi.
9. Background image setting
Try setting the background image that goes with the sound!
10. Time + Slideshow
You can use this as a clock with a slideshow in the background.
■ Note
The sounds and images may change to enhance the app’s quality.

bluejetty:00170680:ios.summary: Put your knowledge to the test by answering increasingly difficult trivia questions. Play through thousands of new questions or real questions that contestants faced on the show. Use your lifelines wisely to climb the money tree and win the
bluejetty:00170680:ios.description:
Put your knowledge to the test by answering increasingly difficult trivia questions. Play through thousands of new questions or real questions that contestants faced on the show. Use your lifelines wisely to climb the money tree and win the grand prize!
Do you have what it takes to become a millionaire?
WHO WANTS TO BE A MILLIONAIRE? FEATURES:
- Play through thousands of challenging questions modernized for 2024!
- Try Champions Mode to play real questions contestants faced on the show. How well can you do against their scores?
- Use your lifelines to give yourself the best chances of winning. Phone a friend, ask the audience, use a 50:50, or swap the question!
- Compete on the leaderboards to showcase your quizzing skills against other players!
- Experience the original, suspense-building music from the series!
- Play on the authentic set from the TV show, simulated in 3D! Feel the drama as the pressure builds.
- The Winning Balance feature continuously displays your total winnings throughout your gameplay.
- Completely ad-free for seamless, uninterrupted gameplay.
PLAY CLASSIC OR CHAMPIONS MODE
Play Classic Mode with tons of new questions designed specifically for the game, or try Champions Mode to answer real questions featured on the TV show!
EXPERIENCE THE ORIGINAL MUSIC AND AUTHENTIC SET IN 3D
Play on a simulated 3D set with sound design and lighting effects identical to the show! Feel the pressure rise with each new question, each more difficult than the last.
STUMPED? USE A LIFELINE!
Use the four signature Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? lifelines to keep yourself in the game! Phone a friend for one-on-one advice, ask the audience for answers from the crowd, use a 50:50 split to eliminate two wrong answers, or swap a question to get something new!
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS
See where you stand on the global leaderboards in three different categories: time to first safety net, average prize money, and total prize earnings. Compete to be recognized as the best Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? player!
Download today to play the authentic Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? game right from the palm of your hand.
