bluejetty:00030706:ios.name: Avira Password Manager
bluejetty:00030706:ios.summary: Avira Password Manager lets you create and manage all your passwords, credit cards, and notes anytime, anywhere. Say goodbye to handwritten notes creating chaos on your desk. The times are over when you had to jot down every password and id
bluejetty:00030706:ios.description:
Avira Password Manager lets you create and manage all your passwords, credit cards, and notes anytime, anywhere. Say goodbye to handwritten notes creating chaos on your desk. The times are over when you had to jot down every password and idea. Plus, there'll be no more struggling to create new passwords or reset old ones. This password organizer makes it a breeze to bring order to your work and personal life. 
And the best thing: Avira, the German security and protection specialist, makes sure your data is encrypted and stays in Germany where data protection and privacy standards are second to none. 
Avira Password Manager works across multiple devices and operating systems. 
◆ ONE PASSWORD FOR ALL DEVICES ◆ 
With Avira Password Manager you only need to remember one single password – the master password. It's like the key to an uncrackable password vault, in which your logins are safely stored. Simply login with this master password and enjoy access to all your accounts and notes on all your devices. 
◆ AUTO-FILL LOGIN FORMS ◆ 
Easy, convenient, time-saving: Avira Password Manager auto-fills your logins across all your favorite websites and apps. 
◆ INSTANT PASSWORD GENERATOR ◆ 
Most internet users use simple and common passwords for all their accounts, making them easy to crack. Avira Password Manager makes it effortless to set strong, unique passwords to give you the best protection against identity theft. 
◆ DIGITAL WALLET ◆ 
You can add your credit cards to your secure digital wallet just by scanning them with your camera. Details like your credit card number and its expiration date will be instantly captured. Your saved credit cards will be available across all your devices. 
◆ AVAILABILITY ◆ 
Avira Password Manager is available as a web dashboard (including browser extension) and as a mobile app. And best of all: Any change you make is synchronized automatically and available on all your other devices. 
◆ SECURITY◆ 
The new Security Status feature shows you at a glance how secure your passwords, accounts, and listed websites are, and whether any of your credentials have already been compromised. You can then take immediate action to improve your online security. 
Your passwords, credit cards, and notes are protected using 256-bit AES encryption – the most secure standard out there. Think of it as your own personal armored password safe. Thanks to your master password only you and you alone have access to them – not even Avira can access your data. For extra security you can use your fingerprint or face ID to unlock Avira Password Manager on Apple devices. 
◆ TWO-FACTOR-AUTHENTICATOR◆ 
We now released a new section for your Two-Factor Authentication codes ("2FA codes"). Avira Password manager now has an in-built authenticator that generates the 2FA codes which means that you don't have to obtain these additional login codes via text-message or via a separate authenticator app. 
Avira Password Manager Pro: Security Status on all platforms, Premium Support. Length of subscription: 1 month or 1 year. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. 
Privacy Policy available at https://www.avira.com/en/general-privacy 
Terms and Conditions available at https://www.avira.com/en/legal-terms

bluejetty:00172075:ios.description:
SmackTok – Where true fans can connect, compete, and win
Ready to level up your daily fantasy sports game? SmackTok is the fastest, easiest, and most thrilling way to test your sports knowledge and win real money. Join contests, socialize with other fans, make your picks, play with real cash, earn graded sports cards, and watch your predictions come to life — all in one slick, social experience.
Built-In Social Feed:
SmackTok is the first sports app built around team specific huddles, giving fans a dedicated place to connect, react, debate, and follow every moment of the season. Join the huddle for your favorite team and jump into real conversations with fans who care about the same players, matchups, and storylines you do. Every huddle becomes its own live community where fans trade insights, celebrate big moments, and keep the energy going before, during, and after game day.
Inside each team huddle, you can share your takes, ask questions, and follow trending discussions. Fans can challenge each other’s predictions, talk through their picks, or decide whether to tail or fade what other fans are thinking. You can message other users directly, build group chats, or even launch your own custom communities around specific topics, teams, or leagues.
Reward Shop:
Earn SMACKS by engaging with the community, making plays, referring friends, giveaways, and more. You can redeem these SMACKS for graded PSA sports cards ranging in value from $100 to $80,000! SmackTok is the only place you can earn graded sports cards for talking smack!
Real Money Plays:
SmackTok now gives you a new way to test your sports knowledge. Make confident picks, place plays on your favorite players, and see your predictions come to life. You can compete for real money in eligible areas, or jump into free-to-play contests where fans can win graded cards, exclusive merch, and many other rewards. It feels bigger than traditional fantasy because it brings social interaction, community energy, and real stakes together in one place.
Pick ’Em Contests for Every Sport:
Test your knowledge on players across all major sports. Whether you’re into NFL, CFB, NBA, CBB, MLB, NHL, Boxing, or UFC, SmackTok has you covered. Choose your players and decide if they’ll deliver more or less than on key stats like passing yards, rebounds, or strikeouts.
Smacktok is the first app where you can also see the lineups other people in the community are creating and choose to tail or fade them directly in the app, making every pick more interactive and social.
Free to Start:
SmackTok is free to play, quick to learn, and insanely fun. Create your entries in seconds, follow your stats live, and feel the adrenaline of every play. Join SmackTok today and experience the new wave of daily fantasy sports — now with real-money plays and a vibrant social twist. The game just got personal. Connect, compete, and win!

When the groom turns toward his bride on the
bluejetty:00030427:ios.description:
Paper Bride is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game which includes traditional Chinese folk cultural elements. Download and experience it if you are interested in traditional Chinese culture. 
When the groom turns toward his bride on the wedding ceremony, her traditional red wedding dress suddenly turns into an ominous white paper one before she vanishes without a trace. You will play as the groom to search for the truth and have bizarre encounters, gradually learning about the dark mystic custom in the bride's home village and a story from the past... 
Inspirations:
There are lots of creative horror stories in traditional Chinese folklore: paper figures blocking the way, underworld spirits marching, bizarre temples, ghost trap... But these elements are rarely used in games. After having nightmares about Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, Extensive Records of the Taiping Era, A Wicked Ghost and other novels and movies, we think it's a shame that only we could experience the horror, so we made this traditional Chinese horror mystery puzzle game to share with the world. 
Features:
-Better Graphics: Better and more stylized art assets and more animations for an immersive experience as though in a horror movie.
-Better Performance: Added dialogues to make the main character more relatable.
-More Horror: 2.53x more terrifying than Hospital 13, not recommended for anyone with heart conditions.
-Better Experience: More reasonable puzzles without minute objects or tappable areas.
-Reasonable Difficulty: No more complex puzzles in the early game as the difficulty increases with each chapter.
Follow our official accounts for more information.
Facebook: @gamefpscom
Twitter: @gamefpscom

Main Functions

bluejetty:00044533:ios.description:
No complex function! This is a simple and easy reading vertical calendar application.
You can also use it as a schedule book, such as writing down the meeting schedule!
Main Functions
- There is a memo function that can be written by each day
- Memo can switch between simple display of headings only and full text display 
- 5 sticky notes can be attached as marks for each date. Convenient for shift management and so on!
- Sticky notes can be selected from casual type of landmark type and button type that can write down letters
- Three calendars can be switched for different purposes, such as for work or private use
Full screen mode which can display all day without scroll from 1st to end!
It is also useful to take screenshots of full screen mode and share the schedule to family etc!
If you are using a memo as a diary, and you want to show only the sticky note to the other people, only the memo will be hidden if you tap the icon in the upper right of the screen.
* Full screen mode is for viewing only. Please edit the memo from the normal mode.
* If you want to delete the already entered memo, please long press the prescribed line.
"ColumnCalendar and Memo" can be used for free at all.

Ready to become the ultimate detective in this investigation game? The files of unsolved cases are open, and the stories of each crime scene are yours to unveil.

bluejetty:00123758:ios.description:
Burako is a game popular in Argentina where you play with a set of numbered tiles. It is a multiplayer game for 2 or 4 players (two pairs).
The objective is to score points by placing tiles on valid combinations. You can form sequences of three or more consecutive numbers of the same color, known as "escaleras". You can also combine sets of three or more tiles of the same number, regardless of color, known as "piernas".
Canastas are combinations of at least seven tiles. You can form impure canastas using wild tiles. Canastas are pure when they have no wild cards added.
Whoever has the most points wins. 
You can find more information on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/jugarburako/
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/?type=TC&lang=en

bluejetty:00151214:ios.description:
Prism Bank is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Prism Bank:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric supported devices. 
To use the Prism Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Prism Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00083499:ios.name: Invoxa: Invoice Maker
bluejetty:00083499:ios.summary:
Create professional invoices and estimates in minutes, send them from your iPhone and get paid faster. Invoxa is the invoice maker for freelancers, contractors and small businesses, and it stays in sync with the Invoxa web app.
SAVE TIME
•
bluejetty:00083499:ios.description:
Create professional invoices and estimates in minutes, send them from your iPhone and get paid faster. Invoxa is the invoice maker for freelancers, contractors and small businesses, and it stays in sync with the Invoxa web app.
SAVE TIME
• Describe it: say or type what the job was, and a draft invoice or estimate fills in with the client, items, tax and due date
• Import your old invoices from PDFs, photos of paper invoices or spreadsheets (CSV, Excel) exported from other invoicing apps, with clients, items and payments
• Payment reminders: clients get a friendly email on the due date and after it, until the invoice is paid; estimates get signing reminders
• CC and BCC when you email a document
CREATE PROFESSIONAL DOCUMENTS
• Invoices, estimates and purchase orders with your logo, colors and layout
• Live preview: see the document exactly as your client will while you edit it
• Sections, discounts, taxes, shipping, deposits, notes and signatures
• Your own numbering, labels, columns and custom fields
• Duplicate a document to start the next one faster
SEND AND GET PAID
• Email documents to clients from the app, or share a link, a PDF or a printout
• See when a client opens a document
• Let clients pay invoices online by card through Stripe
• Record full and partial payments and keep the payment history
• Recurring invoices that repeat every week, every few weeks or every month
• Clients approve or reject estimates online; turn an approved estimate into an invoice
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR BUSINESS
• Dashboard with revenue, outstanding and overdue amounts
• Push notifications when a client views, approves or pays
• Reports: sales summary, sales by client and by item, sales journal, taxes, outstanding balance by age
• Filter and sort your lists and export them to CSV
CLIENTS AND ITEMS
• Clients with several emails, phone numbers and addresses, with address suggestions as you type
• A catalog of your products and services with prices and units
ONE ACCOUNT ON PHONE AND WEB
• The same account on your iPhone and on the web at app.invoxa.com
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email
• Dark mode, no ads
INVOXA PRO
New subscribers start with a 7-day free trial of Invoxa Pro, then it is billed monthly or yearly. Without a subscription you can create and edit documents, clients and items, and send, download, print or share your first 3 documents for free. Invoxa Pro removes the limit and adds recurring invoices, document import and CSV and report exports.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends, or when you confirm the purchase if you have had a trial before. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.invoxa.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.invoxa.com/privacy-policy/
Questions or ideas? Write to support@invoxa.com

bluejetty:00014062:ios.summary:
With the Eurobank Mobile App, you manage and control your finances securely and easily. In addition, you can take advantage of free products and services.
All your finances on one screen: Accounts, debit and credit cards, even from other b
bluejetty:00014062:ios.description:
With the Eurobank Mobile App, you manage and control your finances securely and easily. In addition, you can take advantage of free products and services.
All your finances on one screen: Accounts, debit and credit cards, even from other banks, loans and investments—all managed from one place. With the “Edit view” option, you can customize the screen environment according to your needs.
Everyday banking services from your mobile: In the “Quick actions” section, you can see the actions you perform most often and complete them faster, while you can set up standing orders, save favorite transactions, and make transfers using contacts. At the same time, you can obtain the products you need online without visiting a branch, and if you wish, you can also easily and quickly book an appointment at a branch through the app.
Earn rewards from your everyday purchases with the €pistrofi Rewards Program:
With every purchase you make using your Eurobank cards at participating merchants, you earn €pistrofi reward euros. Redeem them on your next purchases and pay less—or even nothing at all!
Through the Eurobank Mobile App, you have access to all the features of the €pistrofi Rewards Program. Discover participating merchants and the latest offers, track the €pistrofi reward euros you've earned, review your redemptions, and view an analysis of your purchases. This way, you can make the most of all the benefits of the €pistrofi Rewards Program, wherever you are.
Access to free products and services that match your lifestyle: Travellers Prepaid card, ideal for travel, with 0% currency conversion fees, even on weekends. Digital allowance for children aged 15 to 17 with the Eurobank Teens service, offering free prepaid card issuance and free top-ups with any amount you choose. Free money transfers to anyone in Greece with the IRIS payments service, without using an IBAN. Introduction to investing with the EverydayInvest service, ideal for starting to invest small amounts easily and simply through your daily transactions.
Real-time card management:
 Set limits for your transactions, cancel your card in case of loss and automatically get a new one, manage your purchases, view your card PIN, or request reissuance.
Support whenever you need it: 
The digital assistant EVA is always available to answer your questions and guide you whenever you need help.
Security in every step:
 Log in and perform transactions using modern security methods such as biometrics or PIN. Receive real-time notifications via push notifications for every activity on your accounts and cards. With Emergency Lock, you can stop all activity across your digital channels and accounts with a single tap, set your card limits to zero, and disconnect your devices. If you cannot find your card, you can temporarily deactivate it and “freeze” its use until you locate it. You can also dispute transactions you do not recognize directly from your mobile.
If your business is a legal entity, you can be served through the Eurobank Business App for businesses.
Not a customer yet? 
With the Eurobank Mobile App, you can open an account in just a few minutes without visiting a branch and get a Hybrid Debit Mastercard debit card to use immediately from your mobile.
Learn more about the Eurobank Mobile App at www.eurobank.gr

CLASS T
bluejetty:00084323:ios.description:
Discover the NEW YOU — at home and on the go fitness, reimagined. Workout anytime with thousands of on-demand classes, tracking & motivational features and a full digital community to support you on your journey to a healthier you.
CLASS TYPES:
Bootcamp/HIT
Dance
Toning & Sculpting
Yoga
Core
Strength
Stretching & Recovery
Pilates
Barre
Boxing & Kickboxing
Meditation & Breathing
Nutrition
Running
Machine Cardio
Pre/Postnatal
Stream workouts on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV. Or, cast to your TV with Airplay or Chromecast. Also available on Roku and Amazon Fire TV. Real-time heart rate with Health App + Apple Watch is also available.
FEATURES:
Guided programs & challenges: Designed with a fitness goal in mind, NEOU experts have created curated programs and challenges to help you reach your goals or test your limits. Try favorites like “Project Weight Loss” or “Get Strong.” 
Classes for all levels and preferences: Filter thousands of workouts by difficulty, body focus, duration, equipment, and music to easily find the perfect workout for you.
Track your progress and achievements: Set goals for a number of workouts per week and track your progress within the app. Earn badges for completing a program or challenge, or hitting a workout milestone. 
Personalized recommendations: Answer a few quick questions about your goals and fitness level and you’ll see recommended classes, instructors, and programs for your preferences.
Stay connected with in-app messages: Add instructors and concepts to your favorites to receive alerts for new classes and concepts, recommended workouts, and feedback from instructors. 
Download classes: Take your workouts anywhere! Preload classes to work out offline or reduce data usage.
Ready to Join? Download the app and get unlimited access with a 7-day free trial. Afterward, subscribe to our annual membership and keep sweating with our community of instructors and members. A monthly membership is also available.
TERMS & CONDITIONS
Monthly & Annual subscriptions are available. Select the plan that works best for you!
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://neoufitness.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://neoufitness.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00184821:ios.description:
Experience an epic story campaign, competitive and cooperative multiplayer, and an innovative social hub, all in one game!
In the futuristic world of Shadowgun Legends, humanity is under attack from a deadly alien invader. The last line of defense are the Shadowguns, legendary warriors and heroes. You are a young Shadowgun recruit with limitless potential who can turn the tide of war. So what are you waiting for? Join the fight and show the galaxy who’s boss!
GAME FEATURES
THRILLING STORY CAMPAIGN
Save humanity from an alien invader in an epic Story Campaign spanning over 200+ mission on 4 diverse planets
CO-OP MISSIONS AND RAIDS
Join forces with friends and defeat giant enemy bosses for glory and legendary loot
REAL-TIME PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER TEAM BATTLES
Fight your rivals in unique multiplayer game modes and diverse PvP arenas
RPG ELEMENTS AND CUSTOMIZATION
Choose from over 600 unique weapons including Handguns, Assault Rifles, Sub-Machine Guns, Heavy Machine Guns, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles and Rocket Launchers. From plasma beams to good old-fashioned lead bullets.
Collect over 1000 armor pieces and build your armor sets. Fortified juggernaut, sleek infiltrator or something else entirely? The choice is yours!
Make your Shadowgun stand out with 250+ cosmetic items
Pick your own skills and create your own playstyle - no classes, no restrictions!
INNOVATIVE SOCIAL FEATURES
Interact with other players, visit vendors, accept missions, party hard and much more in game’s persistent Hub
Chat with friends, create battle squads and form guilds
UNIQUE REWARD SYSTEM - FAME
Become a celebrity of the Shadowgun Universe
Get rewarded for how you play the game. Your every action is appreciated with our unique fame system. The more famous you are the more the world will react to your actions!
Play the best RPG Shooting Game for FREE! Join the fight now!
Shadowgun Legends is a groundbreaking mobile game that blurs the lines between console and mobile gaming.
Dive into this free feature-packed FPS RPG and battle a terrifying alien menace, the Torment, who are rampaging across the Galaxy destroying everything in their path.
As a new Shadowgun recruit, you will create your ultimate rockstar warrior with hundreds of weapons, dozens of combat skills, thousands of armor pieces, and a wild collection of cosmetic items and skins. As your fame grows you will indulge in the wild celebrity lifestyle of the most famous warriors in the Universe and carve your name into mankind’s history.
When you’re not mastering shooting skills you can unwind with your friends in the Shadowgun’s neighborhood, where you’ll hang out with other players, hit the bar, chat, interact with NPCs, and most importantly...party!
You can enjoy all this with DECA Games’ renowned cutting-edge visuals, intuitive controls, and wicked sense of humor.
At DECA Games we’ve always challenged ourselves to push the boundaries on mobile devices, and we’re proud of our console quality first-person shooters. From our cutting-edge graphics to our precise control system, over 180 million players worldwide have been blown away by our innovative approach and dedication to quality. Now we’re taking things to the next level. Shadowgun Legends is the ultimate persistent world shooter in the palm of your hand, a hardcore gaming experience that you can take with you anywhere.

bluejetty:00070641:ios.description:
An award-winning app for keeping track of new music releases, music videos, news, and concerts from all your favorite artists and record labels. Critically acclaimed by MacStories, 9to5Mac, iOS Today, AppleInsider, The Sweet Setup, and more.
MacStories: “If you care about new music releases and staying on top of your favorite artists, you need MusicHarbor”
iOS Today: “This is a great app for folks who are trying to find new music from their favorite artists”
9to5Mac: “MusicHarbor does what you need it to do extremely well”
The Sweet Setup: “I discovered a handful of new albums that were already released and I hadn’t even known were out”
■ MacStories Selects 2020: App of the Year
MusicHarbor is a modern, fully featured app that takes advantage of all of the device’s capabilities and the latest iOS technologies.
MUSIC RELEASES:
• View new music from the artists you follow on a chronologically ordered timeline.
• Hide feats/collabs and filter by types such as album, single, EP, remix, live and acoustic. 
• Get a sneak peek of albums that are comming soon and preview available singles.
• Add releases to your calendar and start counting the days until release.
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Control Center, so you can quickly glance at the latest albums.
• Explore and preview top charts by country and genre.
• Go back in time to rediscover music from your favorite artists and celebrate album anniversaries.
MUSIC VIDEOS:
• Track and preview music videos.
• Music videos are categorized into video, lyric video, interview, and live performance.
• Explore and preview the top music videos by country and genre.
NEWS AND CONCERTS:
• Stay updated with the latest news from the artists you follow.
• Jump to Songkick to find upcoming concerts from your favorite artists.
• Read album reviews from Pitchfork, AllMusic, Rate Your Music, and more.
HIGHLY CUSTOMIZABLE:
• Make MusicHarbor your own.
• Customize the layout and information density.
• Choose between light and dark mode.
• 35 alternate app icons for your Home Screen.
• And much, much more.
MAJOR FEATURES:
• Follow unlimited artists.
• Import artists from Apple Music, Spotify, Last.fm, or your local music library.
• Follow record labels.
• Add new releases to your music library or a playlist.
• Filter releases by type (album, single, ep, remix, live and acoustic).
• Add upcoming albums to your calendar.
• Track new music videos.
• Preview songs and music videos.
• Explore and preview top charts by country and genre.
• Stay updated with the latest news from your favorite artists.
• Go back in time to celebrate album anniversaries.
• Bookmark items for later.
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Control Center.
• Open albums directly in Apple Music, Spotify, and other music streaming services.
• Customize your feed’s information density.
• Choose between dozens of custom icons.
• Open events from the artist in Songkick.
• Read album reviews in specialized sources.
• Explore releases in a calendar-like grid.
• View charts and statistics about your music releases and favorite artists.
• Create advanced shortcuts and automation using the Shortcuts app.
Download MusicHarbor now for free and be the first to hear new music releases!
(Some features require the MusicHarbor Premium subscription)

bluejetty:00077054:ios.name: Superstar Soccer
bluejetty:00077054:ios.summary: Welcome to Superstar Soccer, the ultimate mobile game that brings the excitement of football right to your fingertips! Step onto the virtual pitch and experience the adrenaline-pumping action with super easy controls that make it accessible
bluejetty:00077054:ios.description:
Welcome to Superstar Soccer, the ultimate mobile game that brings the excitement of football right to your fingertips! Step onto the virtual pitch and experience the adrenaline-pumping action with super easy controls that make it accessible for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned soccer pro or a casual gamer, Superstar Soccer offers a challenging yet rewarding gameplay experience that is hard to master but oh-so-addictive! Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey through the world of soccer, conquering the league mode and becoming the ultimate soccer superstar!
Gameplay Mechanics:
Superstar Soccer is designed to provide players with a truly immersive and enjoyable soccer experience. The game boasts simple, intuitive controls that allow you to focus on the tactical aspects of the game rather than struggling with complex button combinations. Mastering the controls is essential for success, but fear not, it won't take long to get the hang of it!
- Pass: Swipe toward a teammate to pass the ball with precision and accuracy.
- Shoot: Swipe toward the goal to take a shot with power and finesse.
- Slide-Tackle: Swipe toward an enemy to attempt a well-timed tackle to dispossess your opponents.
Never a Dull Moment:
In Superstar Soccer, we've carefully curated the pace of play to ensure there is never a dull moment on the pitch. Matches are designed to be action-packed, with continuous back-and-forth gameplay that keeps you at the edge of your seat. Say goodbye to long periods of inactivity or tedious waiting times; every moment counts as you strategize, execute plays, and strive to outmaneuver your opponents.
Quick Matches:
Superstar Soccer's matches are quick and snappy. Each game is optimized for mobile play, offering fast-paced action that fits perfectly into your busy schedule. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to indulge in a soccer marathon, Superstar Soccer delivers the excitement you crave without unnecessary delays.

bluejetty:00069827:ios.summary:

Mommy is a clear, easy-to-use baby tracker and diary made by parents, for parents. Log everyday care in seconds, see what is happening now, recognize patterns over time, and keep everyone car
bluejetty:00069827:ios.description:
Understand your baby’s day, not just record it.
Mommy is a clear, easy-to-use baby tracker and diary made by parents, for parents. Log everyday care in seconds, see what is happening now, recognize patterns over time, and keep everyone caring for your baby in sync.
SLEEP GUIDANCE
See how long your baby has been awake or asleep based on your records. When enough information is available, Mommy also offers a gentle estimate of the likely sleep range based on your baby’s age and sleep log. It is a helpful guide, never a strict schedule or medical advice.
A CLEAR TIMELINE
Bring sleep, feedings, diaper changes, and other activities together in one visual history. See today at a glance, compare recent days, filter activities, and explore your full history.
TRACK EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
• Breastfeeding: time each feeding and remember the last side.
• Bottle feeding: record expressed milk or formula and amounts.
• Sleep: track naps, nighttime sleep, and active sleep timers.
• Diaper changes: record wet, dirty, and mixed diapers.
• Pumping: track duration, amount, and side.
• Food and drinks: log complementary foods and liquids.
• Strolls: track when you go out and for how long.
• Health: record temperature, medicines, vitamins, allergies, and notes.
• Growth: follow height, weight, and developmental skills.
• Other activities: create flexible records for the moments unique to your family.
SHARED ACCESS
Invite your partner or another caregiver and keep one diary together. Mommy uses iCloud to keep changes in sync, so everyone can stay up to date.
REMINDERS, INSIGHTS, AND QUICK ACCESS
Create reminders for a specific time or after an activity interval. Review statistics and trends, generate PDF reports, log activities from Apple Watch, check widgets, and follow an active sleep timer with Live Activities.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No separate Mommy account is required. Your diary is stored and synced through your iCloud account. We do not store or have access to your baby’s diary data on our servers.
Terms of Use:
https://trymommy.app/terms/

bluejetty:00069846:ios.name: The Ultimate Buzzer
bluejetty:00069846:ios.summary:
Sometimes a moment just needs a buzzer.
The Ultimate Buzzer puts a big red button in your pocket, along with more than 75 sound effects for game nights, classrooms, parties and the occasional perfectly timed rimshot. Tap a sound and it pla
bluejetty:00069846:ios.description:
Sometimes a moment just needs a buzzer.
The Ultimate Buzzer puts a big red button in your pocket, along with more than 75 sound effects for game nights, classrooms, parties and the occasional perfectly timed rimshot. Tap a sound and it plays right away. Tap a few and they play together.
PICK HOW IT WORKS
• Multi Sound: a grid of sounds you can tap as fast as you like, even several at once.
• Big Button: pick a sound and it fills the screen as one giant button. Made for trivia, quizzes and anyone who likes to slam things.
• Dual Big Button: two giant buttons side by side on iPad, or on iPhone Duo when it's open, for head-to-head rounds.
GAME SHOW NIGHT
Turn trivia night into a real game show. Everyone opens the app on their own iPhone or iPad and buzzes in. The host sees who was first, down to a fraction of a second, marks the answer right or wrong and keeps score. Players connect to the host over your local network, so nobody needs an account. Joining a game is free. Hosting comes with Pro.
KIDS MODE
Big, bouncy buttons with animals, trains and other favorites, plus stars and trophies to earn. Any ads in Kids Mode are G-rated, and a grown-up has to solve a math problem to leave. You can even set the app to open straight into Kids Mode.
A SOUND FOR EVERYTHING
Buzzer, applause, drum roll, rimshot, wah-wah, epic fail, siren, alarm clock, countdown, crickets, cuckoo clock, rooster, cow, UFO and plenty more. They're sorted into Alarms, Animals, Vehicles, Funny, Action, Effects, Around the House and Nature, and you can search or keep your favorites at the top.
THE LITTLE EXTRAS
• SharePlay: on a FaceTime call, tap a sound and everyone hears it.
• Siri, Shortcuts and Control Center: play a sound without opening the app.
• A flashlight button for when the lights go out.
• Pick any accent color and the whole app follows.
GO PRO
Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes ads on all your devices and adds:
• 10 more sounds
• Recording your own sounds, up to 5 seconds each
• Hosting game shows
• Every Kids Mode theme: Ocean, Space, Jungle and Candy
Choose Just Me, or Family to share Pro with up to 5 family members through Family Sharing. Already have The Ultimate Buzzer Pro app? Open it once and this app unlocks too, through iCloud.
Most sounds are in the public domain.

Capture the enemy's Arsenals to win. Deploy your Lines of Communication to keep friendly units in contact. Block enemy lines for strategic advantage. 
"The surprises of this Kriegspiel seem to be inexhaustible," wrote French Situationist Guy Debord. In Debord's view the game represents the totality of factors at play in wartime maneuvers, what he called "the dialectic of all conflicts."
-- Play 2P online against another player
-- Play 2P in person on the same device 
-- Practice against the computer
-- Level editor for customizing formations
-- Language support for French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, and English
Kriegspiel is produced and maintained by Alexander R. Galloway. The game is noncommercial. There are no in-app purchases. No advertisements. No Patreon. No GoFundMe. No monetization of player data. There is literally no possible way to take your money.

bluejetty:00092083:ios.name: DragTuner Log Book & Weather
bluejetty:00092083:ios.summary: The DragTuner run logger is the core of the mobile app. It allows users to log their timeslip, conditions, and other various information. Choose a track from one of the many pre-loaded tracks in the United States or add your own. DragTuner
bluejetty:00092083:ios.description:
The DragTuner run logger is the core of the mobile app. It allows users to log their timeslip, conditions, and other various information. Choose a track from one of the many pre-loaded tracks in the United States or add your own. DragTuner allows you to add the event as well which will be saved for later runs. Choose between ¼ mile and ⅛ mile and enter your timeslip.
Version 2.0.0 introduces some features such as ET Prediction and car configurations. ET Prediction allows a user to predict their ET based on three previous runs and the current weather. Car configurations allow the user to separate their logged runs by vehicle as well as add custom fields for each vehicle.
Track and weather conditions are key to your race car’s performance. When adding a run, under the conditions tab, click Get Weather to get the latest weather based on your location. DragTuner uses location services in your device to get your location and query the closest weather station in your area. We return the following fields: temperature, density altitude, humidity, barometer, dew point, wind speed & direction, and water grains. On this same screen, there are also fields for track temperature and notes.
The notes screen, which can be found under the “Notes” tab on the “Add Run” screen, is used for storing car setup notes. Currently we support the following fields: estimated ET, dial in, delay, tire pressure, and notes.
All of the fields described above can be filtered and sorted upon by using the Filter Run feature by pressing the filter icon on the home screen in the top righthand corner.
DragTuner requires a subscription to use the application. DragTuner subscriptions give the user full access to the app and they are auto-renewing. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period at a price of either monthly or yearly price depending on your subscription. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings on the device after purchase. A free trial period of 7 days is included with the subscription. After the trial period expires, you will be charged at the monthly or yearly price depending on your choice when you sign up.
Terms of use: https://dragtuner.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://dragtuner.com/privacy-policy

Pyonkee is a new dynamic media for developing various ideas. By combining visual blocks, kids/adults are able
bluejetty:00015623:ios.description:
Tired of consuming? Let's enjoy creating! Based on Scratch, Pyonkee provides a real, programming environment, anytime, anywhere!
Pyonkee is a new dynamic media for developing various ideas. By combining visual blocks, kids/adults are able to create original games, animations, and stories on their own. Through the programming process, we will learn about logics, productivity, creativity, and collaborations.
Pyonkee has been developed from the open-source code of "Scratch 1.4" from MIT Media Lab. Since Pyonkee is fully compatible with Scratch 1.4, millions of existing Scratch projects can be used for reference.
Pyonkee's user interface is optimized for touch devices. We do not need cumbersome typing, even a mouse. Just write programs wherever you like. Pyonkee nicely supports pinch-in/out, and font scaling for small devices. Moreover, sound recorder and camera are provided for importing your sounds and pictures into the projects. We can mix various media on Pyonkee and program them.
Moreover, you can share your projects via AirDrop, e-mail, iCloud, and other cloud storage services.
From the version 2.1, you are able to create programs using various iPad sensors and Mesh network protocol. From the version 2.3, more than 100 instruments are available in sound block. You can even play other synth app's sounds by enabling Virtual MIDI.
From the version 2.20, Pyonkee is able to connect to micro:bit. You can get values from various sensors and send analog/digital signals to the pins.
By combining the micro:bit with Pyonkee, you can enjoy an even wider world of programming.
Dive into the fun of visual programming!

Pyonkee is a new dynamic media for developing various ideas. By combining visual blocks, kids/adults are able to create original games, animations, and stories on their own. Through the programming process, we will learn about logics, productivity, creativity, and collaborations.

Pyonkee has been developed from the open-source code of "Scratch 1.4" from MIT Media Lab. Since Pyonkee is fully compatible with Scratch 1.4, millions of existing Scratch projects can be used for reference.

Pyonkee's user interface is optimized for touch devices. We do not need cumbersome typing, even a mouse. Just write programs wherever you like. Pyonkee nicely supports pinch-in/out, and font scaling for small devices. Moreover, sound recorder and camera are provided for importing your sounds and pictures into the projects. We can mix various media on Pyonkee and program them.

Moreover, you can share your projects via AirDrop, e-mail, iCloud, and other cloud storage services.

From the version 2.1, you are able to create programs using various iPad sensors and Mesh network protocol. From the version 2.3, more than 100 instruments are available in sound block. You can even play other synth app's sounds by enabling Virtual MIDI.

From the version 2.20, Pyonkee is able to connect to micro:bit. You can get values from various sensors and send analog/digital signals to the pins.
By combining the micro:bit with Pyonkee, you can enjoy an even wider world of programming.

Dive into the fun of visual programming!

bluejetty:00041663:ios.description:
Defeat the rampaging demon horde, save the Kingdom of Daria, and avenge the death of your parents in the thrilling conclusion to this epic three part series! You’ll need all the power you can muster to finish building your legend, tapping into any of the dozen new prestige classes, including Druid of Decay, Dragon Knight, and even fighting the demons with their own fire by becoming a Demon Master!
"The Lost Heir 3: Demon War" is a 250,000-word interactive fantasy novel by Mike Walter—the conclusion to the trilogy—where your choices control the story. The game is entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Face betrayal, seek romance, battle enemies in war, and navigate the intrigues of court. The fate of the kingdom of Daria is in your hands.
• Play as male or female, gay or straight.
• Pursue romantic interests, get married, have a child!
• Acquire legendary magical artifacts.
• Reach one of seven different endings! Restore peace and harmony to the Kingdom of Daria or plunge the world into chaos, the choice is yours!

bluejetty:00043692:ios.description:
*CAN'T FIND YOUR TV REMOTE, JUST OPEN THIS REMOTE APP AND CONTROL YOUR LG WEBOS TV*
Remote for LG TV is an application that lets you control your LG Smart TV's. It's a virtual remote but this app have all the necessary features of the real remote. This is an application built for folks who are sick and tired of remotes that constantly get lost, doesn't work, or need to be used just right to register on your TV.
To use this app as a remote control for your TV, you must have your iPhone/iPad connected to the same wifi network as your TV. As the application runs through the wireless network, it is not necessary to be near the TV. 
Here is the list of features :
- Volume Control (VolumeUp, VolumeDown, Mute/UnMute)
- Change TV Channels (ChannelUp, ChannelDown, PrevChannel)
- Navigation Control (Left, Right, Up, Down, OK/Confirm, Return)
- Multimedia Control (Play, Pause, Stop, FastForward, Rewind, Previous, Next)
- NumPad Control (Channel using specific number)
- Home, Settings, Menu
- Launch installed applications
- TrackPad
- etc.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS:
Subscription Length: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access full feature of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "1 Week" unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly/monthly/yearly)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. 
Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings.However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Read our full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy at:
https://sites.google.com/view/lg-tv-remote/privacy
https://sites.google.com/view/lg-tv-remote/terms

bluejetty:00031072:ios.summary: Xtrades is a social trading platform for traders and investors to interact and share financial ideas, education, and tools using gamification and monetary incentives. The first large scale discord traders community to have it's own integrat
bluejetty:00031072:ios.description:
Xtrades is a social trading platform for traders and investors to interact and share financial ideas, education, and tools using gamification and monetary incentives. The first large scale discord traders community to have it's own integrated web and mobile application. 
Options and stocks alerts
The traders that pay a subscription fee gain value by being able to access the traders community chat channels and all the options, stocks alerts that are being sent through. On top of this, they are given access to videos, scripts, or any tools that we develop for them in the options and stocks trading world.
Traders Community 
Thousands of traders discuss trades and latest events in our discord traders community. Trust and transparency are the key ingredients of what makes our traders community great and through the power of the community, we can grow together.
Educational Resources
We provide a tons of educational resources, including trading tutorials, market analysis for options and stocks, and investment strategies, to help users improve their trading skills.
Discord integration
Using a plethora of discord integrated bots to maximize server capabilities, including strict price validation, machine learning, and cross community statistical analysis, we bring transparency to the trading alerts business by keeping a track record of our traders over hundreds and thousands of alerts. 
Traders Rewards 
We allow traders to become paid contributors that earn a portion of our subscription revenue through being voted for, or topping the leaderboards through our alerts system. This occurs on a monthly basis, allowing for traders to earn a passive income through our platform by just communicating and interacting on it. 
Machine learning options and stocks alerts 
RoyBaty is a machine learning based algorithm. This algorithm generates trades based on Xtrades traders alerts and predictive machine learning system. Once a trader alert passes the machine learning minimum threshold, a duplicate alert is generated by Roy Baty.
Features 
- Vetted, Statistically Proven Alerts from Elite Traders 
- Push notifications to send the trader alerts 
- Machine learning options and stocks alerts 
- 10K+ Active Daily Traders Community 
- 8-10 Video Trading Lessons Per Month 
- Proprietary Trading Algorithm on Tradingview 
- Daily Options and Stocks Watchlists from Top Traders 
- Trader Income Program 
- Raffle Tickets
- Traders Leaderboard for Options and Stocks 
- Alerts Statistics for Options and Stocks 
- Trading Webinars
- Options Flow  
Terms of Use: https://www.xtrades.net/terms-and-conditions

The DroneDeploy Ground app empowers businesses in construction, engineering, and other industrial sectors to efficiently document and manage ground-level data, providing a powerful complement to drone-based insights. DroneDeploy Ground is the next-generation ground capture app for project teams, including former StructionSite users.
Note: This app is intended for enterprise users with an active DroneDeploy license.
Simplify Ground-Level Data Capture in 3 Easy Steps:
 1. Log in to your DroneDeploy account (trial or active license required).
 2. Connect your 360 camera to capture 360° panoramas and 360° Walkthroughs, or use your device's camera to capture standard photos.
 3. Sync your captures to the DroneDeploy platform for processing, sharing, and analysis.
Once uploaded, your captures are processed and accessible through the DroneDeploy platform, where you can:
 • Collaborate with your team and stakeholders.
 • Inspect, compare, and annotate project data over time.
 • Integrate seamlessly with leading industry tools like Procore, Autodesk Build, and more.
Supported Hardware:
 • Insta360 X5
 • Insta360 X4
 • Insta360 RS 1-inch 
 • Ricoh Theta X
 • Ricoh Theta Z1
Visit our website for a complete list of supported hardware and to learn more about the DroneDeploy ecosystem.
For Business and Professional Use:
The DroneDeploy Ground app is a free companion tool for licensed DroneDeploy enterprise customers. A valid enterprise account is required for uploading and processing captures

DroneDeploy Ground is the next-generation ground capture app for project teams, including former StructionSite users.

Note: This app is intended for enterprise users with an active DroneDeploy license.

Simplify Ground-Level Data Capture in 3 Easy Steps:
	1.	Log in to your DroneDeploy account (trial or active license required).
	2.	Connect your 360 camera to capture 360° panoramas and 360° Walkthroughs, or use your device's camera to capture standard photos.
	3.	Sync your captures to the DroneDeploy platform for processing, sharing, and analysis.

Once uploaded, your captures are processed and accessible through the DroneDeploy platform, where you can:
	•	Collaborate with your team and stakeholders.
	•	Inspect, compare, and annotate project data over time.
	•	Integrate seamlessly with leading industry tools like Procore, Autodesk Build, and more.

Supported Hardware:

	•	Insta360 X5
        •	Insta360 X4
	•	Insta360 RS 1-inch	
	•	Ricoh Theta X
	•	Ricoh Theta Z1

Visit our website for a complete list of supported hardware and to learn more about the DroneDeploy ecosystem.

For Business and Professional Use:
The DroneDeploy Ground app is a free companion tool for licensed DroneDeploy enterprise customers. A valid enterprise account is required for uploading and processing captures

bluejetty:00074220:ios.description:
Traffic Sign Camera helps you see your current speed and the detected speed limit at a glance while you drive. It combines live camera recognition with map-based speed-limit lookup from OpenStreetMap, then shows the result in a clear driving display with a GPS speedometer.
► Top Features
• Live camera-based recognition of European speed limit signs.
• OpenStreetMap speed-limit lookup for roads, city areas, zones, and places where physical signs may be missing.
• Smart merging of camera and map sources into one overall speed-limit display.
• GPS speedometer with color feedback when you approach or exceed the current limit.
• Sound alerts for newly detected signs and overspeed warnings.
• CarPlay support for viewing speed and limit information on your dashboard.
• Configurable km/h or mph units, speed tolerance, warning threshold, camera mode, and map query interval.
• Ultra wide camera support on compatible iPhones for a broader view of roadside signs.
► How It Works
Traffic Sign Camera watches the road ahead with your iPhone camera, finds possible speed-limit signs with on-device machine learning, and reads the sign value with Vision text recognition. At the same time, it can use your current location and course to request map-based speed-limit data. The app combines both sources so you can keep your eyes on one simple limit display.
► Important Limitations
Traffic Sign Camera is a driver assistance tool, not a replacement for your attention or local traffic law.
• Optimized for European speed limit signs. US speed limits are not currently supported.
• Poor lighting, bad weather, dirty windows, unusual signs, or narrow curves can reduce camera recognition quality.
• The app does not currently detect every end-of-limit, town boundary, or special-case road rule.
• Map data depends on OpenStreetMap coverage and an internet connection.
• Missed or incorrect detections can occur. Always follow posted signs and local rules.
► Notes from the Developer
If you like Traffic Sign Camera, a rating helps a lot. For suggestions or support, please contact us by email from inside the app.
► Disclaimer
The author assumes no liability for any damages occurring in connection with this app. Use is entirely at your own risk. By using the app, you accept the complete exclusion of liability and compensation claims.
► Important Notes Concerning Subscriptions
All above subscriptions renew within 24 hours before the current period ends, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Manage or cancel your subscription from iTunes Account settings. See our Terms & Conditions (https://ibn-software.com/app-terms-conditions) and Privacy Policy (https://ibn-software.com/app-privacy-policy).

bluejetty:00073909:ios.description:
The brand new JB4 Mobile application is finally ready for public release and has lots of great new features including:
*Gauge theme customizations
*Built-in raw CSV data viewer
*Revamped User Adj./WMI data editors
*New modern UI completely rewritten from the ground up
*More seamless integration with our backend servers
JB4 Connect Kit Users: 
1) Install the Connect Kit per the installation guide for your vehicle
2) Create your account/sign in with this app
3) Ensure JB4 Mobile has all requested permissions
4) Tap the Connect button in JB4 Mobile
About The App:
JB4 Mobile is a mobile data logger and display for use with the JB4 tuner from Burger Motorsports.
JB4 Mobile allows you to monitor and log multiple parameters from your JB4 equipped car. Parameters such as boost, rpm, fuel trims, air/fuel ratios, ignition advance and much more are available. 
Current Features: 
Live gauges
Data logging
Data graphing
Log export via email
Code reading/deletion
Modify User Adj. (boost, fuel, etc.) settings
Modify WMI settings
Switch maps on the fly
Auto WOT logging
JB4 Firmware Updating
JB4 ® is a registered trademark of Burger Motorsports Inc ® and is used with written permission.

bluejetty:00064974:ios.description:
Hello bank! is a banking service which is 100% mobile. It is offered free of charge and includes a current account, a maximum of two bank cards, and savings accounts. 
The application is:
• Completely secure:
You access our banking services using your own unique Easy Banking code, which you set up. You receive the same level of protection as you already enjoy when you use your bank card and PIN.
• Has a full help service:
The Hello team is on hand 83 hours a week to answer your questions and help you carry out your transactions. 
To try Hello bank! free of charge: install the app
The Hello bank! app gives you access to your banking world, you can use your bank and you have a clear view of your income and spending. 
A few useful features:
• You can log in with your fingerprint or via facial recognition if your phone is equipped with this option.
• The Bancontact function: this enables you to make payments via your smartphone by using the QR code .
As easy as saying "Hello!"
1. Download the free app
2. Submit your request from the app (takes no more than 4 minutes!)
3. Your Hello box and card reader are sent to your home address 
4. Upon approval of your application, we then prepare your bank card(s) and the PIN you need to activate them. 
Like to know more? Just ask!
Telephone +32 (0)2 433 41 45, Monday to Friday (7am to 10pm) and Saturdays (9am to 5pm).
Or send an email to info@hellobank.be or read our FAQs at: https://www.hellobank.be/faq 
Hello bank! from BNP Paribas Fortis.

bluejetty:00056848:android.description:
Change hairstyle is useful and fun at the same time - It allows you to try different hairstyles before going to the hair salon. There is no drawings, all hairstyles are natural hair. Short, medium, or long, straight, curly, or in different colors... all you have to do is pick a picture of you and begin the beauty session.
Start to use this hair changer by selecting a photo from your gallery by tapping on the camera. Select from three types of hairstyles - short, medium, or long. In the hairstyle bar, choose the one you like best among many. Adjust the position and the size of your photo to the hairstyle. You can rotate the photo with the rotation buttons, invert the hairstyle and adjust it to you. 
If you like the results, save them by tapping on the icon in the bottom left .
Try many more hairstyles from the wide range offered by our hair changer and compare how they look on you.
Don't miss the opinions of your friends! Share on Facebook or on any other social network on your cell phone. This is easy with this Change Hairstyle!. Enjoy and find your hairstyle every time you're in the mood for a change!

Lean AI
Take control of your nutrition and fitness with Lean AI, the ultimate app for tracking macros, meals, and workouts. With cutting-edge AI technology, Lean AI makes tracking your meals effortless and accurate, whether you're at home, at the gym, or on the go.
Snap to Track
Easily track your food with a simple snap! Lean AI analyzes photos of your meals, food packages, nutrition facts, and barcodes, instantly calculating your calories and macros. No more manual input – just point, shoot, and let AI do the rest.
Describe Your Meal
Don't have a photo? No problem! Simply describe what you're eating, and Lean AI will estimate the nutrition breakdown for you. Whether you're enjoying a homemade dish or dining out, AI-powered meal descriptions make tracking easier than ever.
Fitness Tracking Built In
Lean AI goes beyond nutrition – it tracks your fitness, too. Log your weightlifting workouts, cardio sessions, or describe your routine, and the app will keep tabs on your progress. Whether you're running, lifting, or resting, Lean AI has your fitness covered.
As Seen on TikTok
Featured on TikTok, Lean AI is making waves in the fitness and nutrition community. Join thousands of users who are transforming their lives by simplifying their health journey with the power of AI.
Why Lean AI?
- Snap photos to track macros instantly
- Scan barcodes or input nutrition facts with ease
- Describe meals for AI-powered nutrition tracking
- Track workouts: running, weightlifting, and more
- Featured on TikTok for its ease and innovation
- Get started today with Lean AI and make nutrition and fitness tracking as easy as snapping a photo!
A subscription is required to view analysis results.

bluejetty:00116334:ios.description:
Believe that the mind needs exercise as well as the body and love to test your brain with code breaking games? We have something for you! In our brainteaser game you will need to solve intriguing puzzles to unravel the secret messages hidden behind them. What will you find? Maybe an interesting quote? Or a piece of wisdom? Get rewarded for each riddle with images that will show your mastery. Prepare to challenge your mind and embark on a journey of discovery and creativity with these ciphers and code games!
Core Features of Our Brain Training Game
- Decode cryptic messages
- Test your mental sharpness
- Develop your strategy
- Track your achievements
- Unlock and collect fun pictures
Logical Puzzles
Learn cryptography while diving into the world of letters and numbers. Here every word puzzle is a code waiting to be cracked. Each message is crafted to challenge your logical thinking and language skills as you uncover hidden meanings and decipher encrypted texts and turn a jumble of letters into words. With a variety of levels, the game offers an engaging experience for both new players and seasoned letter puzzle enthusiasts.
Strategy and Mind-Challenging Fun
Decoding ciphers isn’t just about words — it’s a test of strategy. Analyze patterns, make educated guesses, and adjust your approach to the task as you navigate each unique crypto brain puzzle. The game sharpens your logic as you get each message decoded and brings lots of fun in the process while letting you pass time and relax in a smart way!
Your Personal Picture Collection
Every code puzzle you solve lets you unlock a new image for your collection. Decode all the cryptic puzzles to see all the pictures the game has in store! Your collection will speak for you and show off your decrypting skills as well as, of course, simply look pretty!
Progress Tracking
You can track your journey in our crypto word game and watch your statistics change as you master more puzzles and grow. You can take on different challenges with timed events to get unique rewards and track your time record to become even better. Solve more puzzles in a row to get maximum points!
Are you ready to put your decoding skills to the test? If you’re a fan of cryptology, love logic word games, crossword and anagram puzzles or other types of brain games, prepare for the mysteries, challenge yourself, build a picture collection and become a code cracker in this captivating code puzzle adventure!
Start training your brain right now!
Also, in-app purchases are available in the application, which are made only with the consent of the user.

With Digital Key, you can take control of your car from the palm of your hand, no matter where you are. Our app is designed to provide you with a seamless and intuitive experience, allowing you to stay connected to your car and enjoy a smarter, safer driving experience.

Track your speed with precision using our built-in speedometer. Whether you're cruising on the highway or navigating city streets, Digital Key helps you stay within the speed limit and drive safely.

Analyze your driving habits and improve your performance with detailed logs and statistics. Digital Key provides you with insights into your driving behavior, including distance traveled, average speed, fuel consumption, and more.
Digital Key: Connect Car Play is your all-in-one solution for a smarter, safer, and more convenient driving experience. Download the app today and take the first step toward a more connected and enjoyable journey on the road.

bluejetty:00175191:ios.name: eBay Motors: Parts, Cars, more
bluejetty:00175191:ios.summary:
One of the world’s widest selections of vehicle parts and accessories is available on the eBay Motors app. Use the app to buy and sell vehicles with ease, as well as chat with other auto enthusiasts.
Here are just some of our unique feat
bluejetty:00175191:ios.description:
One of the world’s widest selections of vehicle parts and accessories is available on the eBay Motors app. Use the app to buy and sell vehicles with ease, as well as chat with other auto enthusiasts.
Here are just some of our unique features:
Buy parts and accessories, right from the app
The Motors app offers eBay’s full US inventory of parts and accessories, right at your fingertips. You can also talk shop with a community of auto enthusiasts while buying and selling vehicles. 
My Garage provides a place to easily store your vehicle’s specs so you can effortlessly find, compare, and buy parts that will fit your ride. You can easily switch between your everyday ride, and your restoration “project” without having to constantly enter the same information.
After you've added your vehicle to My Garage, check out eBay’s Fitment Finder. It gives you the confidence that the parts you buy on the eBay Motors app will fit your vehicle. Look for the green checkmarks to quickly pick out the right part for your ride. 
Safely ship your vehicle with confidence 
Our partnership with uShip Logistics has allowed eBay Motors to provide a safe, secure, and affordable option for vehicle transportation.
Securely pay for vehicles with Escrow.com
eBay’s partnership with Escrow.com provides you with the most secure way to purchase your next vehicle online.
Chat with those looking to buy and sell 
The eBay Motors app has a chat experience for users as they look to purchase and sell vehicles. Communication has never been easier.
Connect with a community of auto enthusiasts 
React, share, comment, and connect with other enthusiasts about eBay Motors’ unparalleled inventory. The auto community is alive and well on the eBay Motors app.
Use your phone to scan your license plate and VIN number
Take a picture of your license plate and the eBay Motors app will do the rest--uploading your VIN number and all the details of your vehicle for you.
KEEP IN TOUCH 
For all support-related issues, please email car@ebay.com. For questions and suggestions, email ebay-motors-feedback@ebay.com. Your feedback is important to us.
This app is only intended for use by individuals who are 18 years and older.
All vehicle and parts inventory is currently US-based.

bluejetty:00154538:ios.name: Quakeline
bluejetty:00154538:ios.summary:
After a devastating earthquake strikes Istanbul, can you find the woman you love?
In a fully hand-drawn Istanbul, embark on a journey that tests your instincts and hopes. After the earthquake, you must cross the city — from Bakırköy to Üsk
bluejetty:00154538:ios.description:
After a devastating earthquake strikes Istanbul, can you find the woman you love?
In a fully hand-drawn Istanbul, embark on a journey that tests your instincts and hopes. After the earthquake, you must cross the city — from Bakırköy to Üsküdar — to find the woman you love.
Explore a hand-drawn, post-quake Istanbul — from shattered historic neighborhoods to the edge of the Bosphorus. Every corner hides new stories and challenges. In the heart of chaos, survival is not enough. You must do it without losing your honor.
On your journey to save your girlfriend, you’ll face not only physical obstacles but also emotional and psychological trials. The people you meet among the ruins—and their stories—will push you to make difficult moral choices.
To move forward, you’ll need to solve puzzles, crack safe codes, pick locks, explore devastated locations, and manage your energy wisely.
Quakeline is more than just a game; it is a project that aims to raise awareness about the possible impact of a real earthquake in Istanbul. Through its fictional yet grounded narrative, the game invites players to reflect on survival, resilience, and the human spirit.
Witness the struggle to survive—and the power of hope.
In this unforgettable journey, you’ll not only navigate through debris but also discover the deepest and purest parts of what it means to be human.

listings.description:
100% FREE!  No puzzle packs to buy!  DOWNLOAD NOW!
Thousands of beautiful jigsaw puzzles in many categories!
Take as long as you want to work on these totally free puzzles!


• Thousands of beautiful and interesting puzzles to try, in many different categories such as Animals, Architecture, Nature, and more!
• Easily mark puzzles you like as Favorites so you can work on them later from your My Favorites folder!

• Fun for all ages and skill levels!
• Play puzzles with the piece count that you like for easy relaxation or for more of a challenge - from 6 pieces up to 108 pieces on iPhone, or all the way up to 432 pieces on iPad!
• For expert players, you can play with pieces that rotate!

• Puzzle pieces automatically snap onto to the board, starting at the corners.
• Pieces snap together even before attaching them to the board, so you can build up interesting areas as you find pieces for them!

• Want an easier start?  Tap the Only Edges button to show just the edge pieces so you can get the puzzle borders set up!
• Want a quick peek at the picture, just like looking at the box top?  Press on the Hold For Picture button and see a full-size image underneath any pieces you've already placed.

• You can easily change the color of the background for better contrast if desired

• Some jigsaw apps use the same exact layout of pieces and shapes every time, but not here!  You'll get different puzzle layouts and shapes every time for never-ending fun!

• No timers at all!  Just relax and have fun!

• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!

• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play

Thanks for playing!
Come see us at http://boyhowdytechnology.com

bluejetty:00169850:ios.name: AutoTempest - Car Search
bluejetty:00169850:ios.summary: AutoTempest aggregates millions of listings from the top car listings sites in the USA and Canada, including Cars.com, Truecar, eBay Motors, Carvana, Hemmings, Cars & Bids, Carsoup, and more. We also generate comparison links for other larg
bluejetty:00169850:ios.description:
AutoTempest aggregates millions of listings from the top car listings sites in the USA and Canada, including Cars.com, Truecar, eBay Motors, Carvana, Hemmings, Cars & Bids, Carsoup, and more. We also generate comparison links for other large sites like Autotrader and Cargurus, as well as classifieds like Facebook Marketplace and craigslist, nationwide.
Why spend time searching a bunch of different sites (or apps) separately when you can get everything in one place, and avoid missing the car you're looking for? AutoTempest makes it easy to find your ideal car, wherever it's listed. It's the smart way to find next car.
"AutoTempest.com - All the cars. One search."
Q: What's the point of the app when I can just use the autotempest.com website?
A: If you're happy using AutoTempest in your browser and don't want to use the app, no problem! We will always try to include all features and support all devices on the website. If you're searching for cars regularly though and want a faster way to get into it, maybe the app is for you.
Q: How come you don't have this car from Cargurus/Autotrader/Facebook?
A: AutoTempest pulls together listings from many of the top car listings sites, including Cars.com, Truecar, Carvana, eBay, and many more. That said, there are a few whose listings we don't have direct access to. However, to make your search as easy as possible, we do still link to matching search results from those sites. So you actually can see all their listings matching your search; just click the comparison links at the end of our results. No need to visit multiple sites (or apps) and re-enter your search.
Q: Is the app finished, or do you have more features planned?
A: We're working on improving the advanced search first, to make it more intuitive. Later we'll be adding an optional login to share favorite searches and listings between app and web, and across devices, as well as the ability to manage saved searches and, eventually, saved and ignored vehicles, all from the app. After that, let us know what you'd like to see.
If you have any other questions or feedback, please feel free to leave us a review, or to contact us at app@autotempest.com. We read and reply to all emails.

bluejetty:00152014:ios.name: Puzzle Pic - Jigsaw Solitaire
bluejetty:00152014:ios.summary:
Enjoy Completing Photos by Combining Cards
Even if the cards seem random at first, finding the exact spot they fit brings unmatched satisfaction! Every completed photo is a reward for your brain and focus.
Swipe to move the cards anywhere o
bluejetty:00152014:ios.description:
Enjoy Completing Photos by Combining Cards
Even if the cards seem random at first, finding the exact spot they fit brings unmatched satisfaction! Every completed photo is a reward for your brain and focus.
Swipe to move the cards anywhere on the screen. When cards snap together, you can move them as a group, making gameplay smooth and enjoyable.
Satisfying Chain Reactions
The thrill of multiple cards locking into place at once is seriously addictive.
Designed for All Skill Levels
Whether you have a few minutes or a longer play session, Puzzle Pic Jigsaw Solitaire is ideal. Each level brings new discoveries and challenges!
Wide Variety of Themed Photos
From flowers and landscapes to animals, we continuously add diverse photo packs for endless puzzle fun.
How to Play
Swipe to Move Cards
Drag the cards wherever you like using simple swipe controls.
Move Connected Cards All at Once
When cards snap together, they move as a single group. Plan your moves carefully for bigger chain reactions!
Caution with Large and Small Cards
If you place a small card on top of a larger one, the larger card may shrink. Pay attention and combine carefully.
Despite its simple controls, Puzzle Pic Jigsaw Solitaire offers depth through strategic placement and pattern recognition. Whether you love jigsaw puzzles, swipe puzzle games, or just want a fun and relaxing brain game, Puzzle Pic Jigsaw Solitaire is a must-try!

bluejetty:00028732:ios.description:
Welcome to My City: My Friend's House where you get to create your own stories, pretend-play exciting adventures and so much more!
My City: My Friend's house is filled with lots of new characters, fun rooms and locations and lots of interactable accessories just ready for you to discover, explore and pretend-play with. Make sure to check out the Kids Room and Babies Room. Sit with your friends to watch a movie at the Cinema & Arcade Room or throw a wild pool party at the Garden, the options are endless! With so many fun locations to explore and so many new characters there are no limits to the stories you can play out!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 3-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 9-year old to enjoy!
Game features:
- This game has 8 new locations for kids to explore, role-play and layout their own stories.
- Look for the hidden Cinema & Arcade Room and visit your friend's cozy family Caravan!
- 20 Characters included in this game, feel free to take them to other games. The options are endless!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!

Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
