bluejetty:00132107:ios.name: Omo: Healthy Weight Loss App
bluejetty:00132107:ios.summary: Introducing Omo, the weight loss app designed to help you achieve your weight loss goals with ease! Tired of yo-yo diets, confusing workout routines, and feeling like you're alone in your weight loss journey? Discover Omo, an all-in-one wei
bluejetty:00132107:ios.description:
Introducing Omo, the weight loss app designed to help you achieve your weight loss goals with ease! Tired of yo-yo diets, confusing workout routines, and feeling like you're alone in your weight loss journey? Discover Omo, an all-in-one weight loss app, and build new healthy habits using a psychology-based approach. Lose weight for good!
WEIGHT-LOSS COURSE
Our weight loss course is designed to teach you how to build new healthy habits and help you achieve long-term success. That’s why our weight loss course includes:
- regular motivation and support in goal setting
- introduction to the psychology of eating
- short articles on health and weight loss guides
- new mindset and habit setting with a study-backed methodology
- years of weight-loss industry experience from our expert team
CALORIE COUNTER 
Try our calorie tracking and nutrition coach app. Improve your health, track your food, and reach your target weight with these Omo features:
- Calorie counter - track your daily calorie intake to lose weight
- Macro tracker - track protein, carbs, fat, sugar, fiber, vitamins, and more
- Barcode scanner - find food quickly and easily 
- Water tracker - stay hydrated throughout the day
- Food insights & nutrition tips
Whether your goal is weight loss or weight gain, оur app will calculate your optimal daily macro & calorie intake!
FASTING TRACKER
Intermittent fasting is an efficient way to lose weight and simply get healthier. 
Additionally, fasting: 
- controls blood insulin & sugar levels
- stimulates metabolism
- reduces inflammation - detox mode
- is suitable for vegetarians, vegans, and for those who follow clean eating, low carb/keto diets
STEP COUNTER
Walking is a great way to burn calories, get fit, and lose weight. Set your daily step goals and use a step counter to track your daily steps, burned calories, and weight loss progress. Compatible with Apple Watch and Fitbit activity trackers!
WEIGHT TRACKER
Track your weight loss with the weight tracker feature. Set your goals, follow your progress, and stay motivated!
Omo integrates with HealthKit, so you can export nutrition, weight and body measurements, steps/push count and exercise data from Omo to HealthKit, as well as fitness data and weight and body measurements from HealthKit to Omo.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
You can download the app for free. Further use requires a subscription. At our discretion, we may decide to offer you a free trial per the terms displayed in the app. Please note that:
When opting for a subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews and free trial automatically converts into subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
In addition to the purchased subscription, we may offer you add-on items for an additional fee, either one-off or recurrent. This purchase is optional: your subscription is not conditional on such a purchase. All such offers will be displayed in the app.
Omo Terms of Use: https://legal.omo-app.io/page/terms-of-use
Omo Privacy Notice: https://legal.omo-app.io/page/privacy-policy
Weight loss with Omo, an all-in-one app, is easy! Eat healthily, stay hydrated, and count calories with our weight loss planner.

bluejetty:00166612:ios.description:
Bikee delivers a premium, fully customizable dashboard for your electric bike, providing real-time access to critical data and powerful control features. Connect instantly to your bike via Bluetooth and unlock a world of smart features designed to enhance your riding experience.
Key Features:
Advanced Dashboard Display
• Real-time speedometer with sleek digital design
• Battery level monitoring with voltage information and range estimator
• Total trip distance tracking in both metric and imperial units
• Stylish interface that adapts to day/night riding conditions
Customizable Power Modes
• Create and save custom power profiles tailored to your riding preferences
• Adjust speed limits and throttle settings with precision
• Easily switch between different regions' riding regulations
• Specialized modes for various terrains and riding styles
Smart Navigation
• Built-in GPS map with route guidance
• Address search and destination planning
• Turn-by-turn directions while riding
• Option to show/hide map based on your preference
Ride Recording & Statistics
• Track and save all your rides automatically
• Comprehensive ride history with detailed metrics
• Achievement system to motivate and track progress
• Analyze performance data to improve your riding
Intuitive Controls
• Adjust pedal assist levels on-the-fly (5 levels from ECO to BOOST)
• Toggle headlight with a simple tap
• Quick access to all bike systems through an elegant menu
• Landscape and portrait modes optimized for all devices
Additional Features
• Multilingual support with 8+ languages
• Siri shortcuts for hands-free voice control
• Metric/Imperial unit switching
• Special power-saving mode for extended range
• Support community and easy bug reporting
Bikee works seamlessly with modern electric bikes featuring Bluetooth connectivity. Download today and elevate your electric biking experience with the most comprehensive control and navigation app available.

bluejetty:00120019:ios.description:
The #1 app for parents who want to fuel their kid’s curiosity, boost academics & build lifelong learning skills.
WHAT PARENTS ARE SAYING:
***** “As an early childhood educator, reading specialist & mom, I’ve found Curious World to be the best app out there for young children & worth every penny!”
***** “My daughter loves this app because of the fun kid's games & craft videos! I love this app because I trust that what she’s doing is safe, fun & educational!”
EXPLORE A WORLD OF CURIOSITY-BUILDING FUN! 
Our ever-expanding world of kindergarten learning games, books & kids videos was developed by learning experts to help kids aged 2-7 develop the skills they need for life & we don’t just mean math & literacy…
• Curiosity & problem solving brought to life by amazing characters in videos, games and books
• Social & emotional skills + mindfulness with wonderfully illustrated cartoons
• Craft activities & creative expression with step-by-step tutorials from kids their own age
• New words & languages learned through kids stories & songs
• Cutting edge toddler activities like kids coding, sign language & sight word games
WHY LEARN WITH CURIOUS WORLD
• Hours of entertainment with hundreds of preschool games, books & videos
• Expertly selected content designed to deliver playful pre k learning experiences & inspire a passion for discovery 
• Boost academic knowledge & essential life skills
• Updated weekly - always new things to discover
• 100% safe & worry-free - no ads, no external links, no weird videos
• Content is curated based on age so the app grows with your child
• In the parents dashboard, you have guidance & insight into what they’re learning
• We encourage offscreen time & creative play
• Access your favorite Curious World kindergarten games & books offline
WHAT THE EXPERTS ARE SAYING:
***** “The books are great: Full-color, engaging, actual print books presented in digital format. Kids can read by themselves or be read to & can choose to have the text highlighted as it's being read.” - Common Sense Media
***** “Curious World is full of different types of activities to entertain & educate children. From videos to suggested craft activities, it's a great source of inspiration & learning for children.” - Educational App Store
AWARDS:
• Kidscreen Best Learning Apps & Best Game App (Smartphone)
• Teachers’ Choice Awards for the Family, National Parenting Product Awards
• Cynopsis Kids Imagination Awards – Tablet-Based App
CURIOUS WORLD ALLOWS KIDS TO CHOOSE THEIR OWN LEARNING PATH ACROSS 8 KEY LIFE SKILLS:
• Science games & videos
• Math games for kids
• Language & literacy
• Executive function, memory games for kids & problem solving
• Creative expression including arts, crafts, kids music games & dance
• Social & emotional development
• Family & community & safety
• Kids health & wellbeing
QUESTIONS OR COMMENTS:
We are committed to delivering the best experience for our users.
Please contact us at: customerservice@curiousworld.com
YOUR CURIOUS WORLD SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribing includes a FREE 7-day trial on both annual and monthly plans. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off the auto-renewal function by entering your Apple ID settings, after purchase. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to Curious World.

Only $7.99 per month or $64.99 per year.
Privacy Policy (https://www.curiousworld.com/privacy-policy)

bluejetty:00085958:ios.description:
UpNote is a clean and beautiful app for writing and organizing. It's easy to use with rich features and delightful experience.
UpNote is designed to help you take notes easily and stay focused on what matters most.
UpNote has beautiful fonts and elegant themes that you can adjust to make your writing experience most comfortable and pleasant.
UpNote is an ideal place to keep your diary and journal. It has a powerful lock feature so that you can rest assured that your notes stay private and secure. You can also use Touch ID or Face ID to securely unlock your notes.
UpNote’s intuitive organizing system will keep your note space neat and light. There are many ways to organize your notes: putting them into notebooks, pinning your notes to the top of the note list, bookmarking them for quick reference or linking to other notes. You can also close any notebooks to focus on only most important one.
UpNote’s rich editor makes it perfect for planning and managing your tasks. Simply write down your to-do list and have them synced to all your devices.
UpNote offers highlight, text colors, table, nested list, code and many other important formatting tools so that you could easily format your notes.
UpNote syncs notes instantly on all devices. It also works reliably offline, so you could take note anytime, anywhere.
If you are a markdown user, UpNote is great for you too. It has intuitive shortcuts based on markdown, which makes it more fun to write notes. You can also export your notes to Markdown or PDF.
Try UpNote now and you will fall in love with it!
----
Upgrade to Premium to get full power of UpNote:
- Lock your notes and notebooks
- Insert table and attachments
- Write unlimited number of notes
- Elegant themes and notebook covers
- Export to text PDF, HTML and Markdown
----
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
----
If you have any question or feedback, we would love to hear it. Send an email to support@getupnote.com, and we would love to get in touch with you!
----
Privacy policy: https://getupnote.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://getupnote.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00169343:ios.description:
Experience the thrill of high-speed competition in "Car racing 3D: Race Master” the ultimate car racing game for adrenaline-seeking gamers! Push the limits of speed and skill as you compete against other drivers in heart-pounding races across a variety of dynamic maps tracks. With realistic city physics and stunning graphics and maps, "Car racing game 3D: Race Master" delivers an immersive racing experience like no other. Customize your city car, master the perfect racing line, and dominate the leaderboards in this intense and addictive racing game. Feel the need 4 speed?
Garage Quest: Uncover, Upgrade, Unleash:
Access a wide array of premium and special edition vehicles: classic Muscle car, Sport GT, Police cars, Truck and more, Car Races, Car Driving, Traffic Car Driving, as you advance through levels while speed driving around the city. Choose from high-performance 3D cars with varying speeds. Handpick your favorite rides or customize them in this car racing game.
Experience Extreme 3D Car Crashes Compilation:
Delight in exceptional 3D graphics that simulate the experience of piloting a genuine 3D racing car, complete with supercar details, real environments, real maps, subway, and crash effects as you partake in the drive and racing game or parking in the city.
Feel the 3D cars in the racing mode and driving mode:
Choose your preferred driving mode at any time, from anywhere, for instant access in the 3D
world of city drive car games. There are 7 unique locations with diverse track features, maps, and designed backgrounds with ramps, city, tunnels, parking, subway, and 14 distinct neon lighting designs.
Racing and city drive with 3D cars all over the world with your friends: 
Compete head-to-head against elite speed race masters around the globe in real-time challenges to earn more rewards and coins for upgrades. Form a crew, drive together, engage in global speed competitions, and emerge as the real ultimate race champion. 
Features of Car racing game 3D: Race Master
- Endless real car drive racing games 3D graphics and maps for an immersive racing experience
- Realistic drifting physics and real maps
- A variety of drive racing cars to choose from
- Access to both online and offline racing games maps 2024
- Time trial mode to test your racing skills and parking skills.
- 3D racing games environment
Are you ready to rev your engines and claim victory? Download "Car racing 3D: Race Master" and prove yourself as the real legend by racing against friends & players around the globe.
If you need any technical support or would like to send us some suggestions to improve the game, shoot us an email at gamewayfu@wayfustudio.com.

bluejetty:00156287:ios.description:
Meet the Coffee Experts Behind Hmmba | Hmmba Specialty Coffee Marketplace
Serving Millions Through Delicious Cups of Specialty Coffee.
At Hmmba, we believe in providing Bahrain with the coffee tools, equipment, and accessories they need.
Our Mission
Our mission is to bring the best selection of coffee tools, accessories, and equipment to the Bahrain market. We work along with the top brands that serve the right espresso, brewing, and barista tools to the specialty coffee community. We also work in raising awareness about specialty coffee, roasting, coffee tools, espresso machines, and coffee grinders through our Blog and social networking
Our History
The founders of Hmmba saw how important coffee is to residents of Bahrain. It's what brings people together, unites families, and creates friendships. However, many people didn't have the at-home brewing equipment they needed to craft truly delectable beverages. That's why we chose to create our marketplace. Today, we're a provider of specialty coffee tools and equipment so that locals can serve up tasty cups of coffee and enjoy this age-old tradition.
Exclusive Collections
We offer hundreds of specialty coffee products that are available in packages exclusive to the Hmmba marketplace. Find all the tools you need to create coffee-shop-grade beverages.
Global Coffee Selections
Our specialty coffee is sourced from all around the world. We bring unique flavors from the farthest corners of the earth so that you can enjoy them here in Bahrain. 
Coffee Experts
We have a deep love for coffee, which is what has enabled us to create a community of coffee experts. We support you on your coffee-making journey no matter how you prefer to craft your brew.
Connect With Us
Are you ready to start your coffee journey? Get in touch and we'll help make your dreams a reality. Info@hmmba.com

bluejetty:00128144:ios.name: Company of Heroes Collection
bluejetty:00128144:ios.summary: The Company of Heroes Collection combines the critically acclaimed World War II game and its two exhilarating expansions into one fully loaded, real-time strategy package. Take command on both sides of the Battle for Normandy, mastering fas
bluejetty:00128144:ios.description:
The Company of Heroes Collection combines the critically acclaimed World War II game and its two exhilarating expansions into one fully loaded, real-time strategy package. Take command on both sides of the Battle for Normandy, mastering fast-moving combat and advanced squad-based tactics on the explosive battlefields of northern France.
In Operation Overlord, lead the US Army's Able Company during the D-Day landings, and spearhead the charge from the beaches of Normandy. Then, direct US, British and German forces alike in the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor expansions, with new campaigns as well as diverse new factions to command in the hugely replayable Skirmish mode.
ALL PRESENT AND CORRECT
From the classic Company of Heroes campaign to the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor expansions, this is the complete package without compromise.
FROM D-DAY TO THE FALAISE POCKET
Command both Allies and Axis forces in 38 challenging missions based on pivotal moments that shaped the course of World War II.
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Take the fight for Normandy online in intense multiplayer skirmishes for up to 4 players.
STRATEGY WITHOUT LIMITS
No timers, hidden costs or in-app purchases — get every moment of tension-packed, tactical action from the word go.
TAILORED FOR TOUCHSCREEN
Tailored to and optimised for iPhone and iPad, the Company of Heroes Collection puts an intuitive interface front and centre, for total touch control in the heat of battle.
ENORMOUS REPLAYABILITY
With four unique factions to command and master, numerous maps to conquer, and adjustable difficulty levels, Skirmish mode offers enormous replayability.
===
Company of Heroes requires iOS 15 or later. You need 6GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.
A further 1.5GB of free space is required to install the Opposing Fronts expansion pack. A further 750MB of free space is required to install the Tales of Valor expansion pack.
Supported iPhones:
 • iPhone 6S / 6S Plus and later
 • Any iPhone SE
 • iPod Touch 7th Generation (2019)
Supported iPads:
 • iPad mini 5th Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad Air 3rd Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad 5th Generation (2017) and later
 • Any iPad Pro
• If you require assistance, please contact our support team at support@feralinteractive.com

bluejetty:00097084:ios.name: twocents: Social Finance
bluejetty:00097084:ios.summary:
twocents is the social network where your username is your verified net worth. It's where money meets memes, honesty, and a little chaos.
Ask the questions you'd never post under your real name. Get real answers from verified multi-million
bluejetty:00097084:ios.description:
twocents is the social network where your username is your verified net worth. It's where money meets memes, honesty, and a little chaos.
Ask the questions you'd never post under your real name. Get real answers from verified multi-millionaires. Track your net worth, flex your wealth or your crippling debt, and see exactly where you stand.
twocents is an identity-free, unfiltered space to connect with others and see the world through the lens of wealth. It's transparency for finance, status… and life.
KEY FEATURES:
Find Your People
- Post your daily thoughts, your most unhinged purchases, your hottest takes.
- Slide into the comments for debates and the occasional roast session.
- Get into group chats with people on your level, for the discussions you can't have anywhere else.
Debate Hot Topics
- Drop polls and watch how opinions split by wealth in real time.
Post Your Wins (and Fails)
- Share the transactions worth posting: the impulse buys, the flexes, the "why did I do this" moments.
- Show off your budgeting glow-up or your latest budgeting disaster. We've all overdrafted for something dumb.
- Use built-in budgeting tools to actually get your money together … or at least track the chaos.
Talk About Your Interests:
- Stocks, crypto, personal finance, dating, politics, pop culture. Money's the theme, not the limit.
Get Real Advice
- Ask your dumbest or most desperate money questions and get answers from verified multi-millionaires.
Climb the Leaderboard:
- Check the Top 100 and the highest debt.
- Track your come-up and watch your ranking grow.
See the Receipts
- Verified net worths broken down by demographic.
- Real purchases from real people.
- Compare your spending habits to people of all wealth levels.
Money is just the backdrop: you can talk about anything here. And grow your wealth along the way.
SECURE BY DESIGN
twocents is powered by Plaid: the same service trusted by apps like Venmo and Robinhood. You connect through them, not us. twocents is read-only. We can't move or withdraw your money, make trades, or access your private identifying information. Your money stays your money. Your info stays your info.
We don't collect emails, phone numbers, or personal data. Your credentials stay on your device and sync securely via iCloud.

bluejetty:00136248:ios.description:
Discover your ideal places on Earth with Linea, the first geo-astrology app that reveals where you’re most likely to find love, success, and happiness!
With Linea, explore your unique astrological map and get personalized insights into cities and countries that align best with your birth chart. Start each day with the knowledge to make meaningful choices based on the universe’s guidance!
Key Features:
Astrocartography – Uncover places worldwide where you’re more likely to thrive. Whether it’s love, career, or adventure, Linea highlights places around the world aligned with your destiny and warns of areas to avoid.
Daily Horoscopes – Stay connected to the planets with daily insights tailored to your chart, helping you navigate each day with confidence and clarity.
Future Predictions – Understand where your path leads. Get insights on where you’ll find prosperity, love, and success, or where to settle down for long-term happiness.
Birth Chart Analysis – Dive deep into your unique birth chart to better understand your strengths, challenges, and areas of potential, guiding you toward a life of purpose.
Compatibility Check – Check if you’re aligned to share the same space with someone significant. Discover if a particular location is ideal for both of you or if it’s better to explore elsewhere.
Why Linea?
Linea goes beyond traditional horoscopes, offering a comprehensive, location-based astrological approach to living your best life. With personalized guidance based on the stars, you’ll find where on Earth you’re meant to be. 
Download Linea today and let the stars guide you to a happier, more fulfilled life!
Trial or paid subscription is required to:
- add extra profiles (family members, friends and any others) to use compatibility mode while searching for desired places or daily forecast
- see future daily astro-geo forecast, except Today's forecast

bluejetty:00069243:ios.description:
Open for new experiences. 
The advanced myAudi app brings you closer to your Audi. 
For the latest version, we have thoroughly revised the myAudi app for you – with smart design, user-friendly operation and new functions. Plan fast, efficient or your favorite routes with the intelligent route planner, receive useful answers from the AI-supported Audi assistant and control important vehicle functions wherever you are – with just a few taps of the finger. 
As well as new features, the myAudi app offers noticeable improvements to familiar functions. Important vehicle functions can now be controlled even more easily from a distance. And with the optimized app routines, you can now precondition your Audi even more easily and plan charging processes seamlessly. 
Regardless of whether you drive a fully electric, combustion or e-hybrid vehicle – the latest version of the myAudi app will make your driving experience smarter, more connected and more convenient. 
Key features at a glance: 
Audi assistant: Just ask instead of spending time looking it up – the AI-supported Audi assistant understands your questions and provides clear information about your vehicle in real time – without the need for the owner’s manual. 
Improved route planner: The new route planner takes account of real-time traffic data, current range and charge scheduling – and sends your desired route directly to the MMI. This makes every journey an experience. 
Individual upgrades: The new shopping area offers individual recommendations based on your current vehicle configuration. Discover exciting functions on demand, Audi connect services and plenty more besides. 
Digital key: Lock, unlock or start your Audi by smartphone and share access to the vehicle simply by app. Ideal for spontaneous trips – without having to look for the key. 
App routines: Charge outside peak times, precondition your vehicle – and automate everyday routines in the way that suits you best: based on time, location or vehicle status. 
Remote vehicle control: Find your vehicle, check the lighting or start the air conditioning in advance. The myAudi app allows you to access central vehicle functions even more directly.

App routines: Charge outside peak times, precondition your vehicle – and automate everyday routines in the way that suits you best: based on time, location or vehicle status. 

Remote vehicle control: Find your vehicle, check the lighting or start the air conditioning in advance. The myAudi app allows you to access central vehicle functions even more directly.

bluejetty:00084095:ios.name: Quadropoly - Monopolist Tycoon
bluejetty:00084095:ios.summary: Welcome to Quadropoly, free and unique take on the classic online property card trading board game that has captured the hearts and minds of millions of families across all countries. Quadropoly offers a variant of the original game, with t
bluejetty:00084095:ios.description:
Welcome to Quadropoly, free and unique take on the classic online property card trading board game that has captured the hearts and minds of millions of families across all countries. Quadropoly offers a variant of the original game, with the ability for players to learn business tactics from the most patient and experienced teacher of all – Artificial Intelligence.
A well-devised product of our digital era, this game utilizes Machine Learning models, trained on all games played by millions of players since 2016. The AI’s proficiency ensures an ultimate challenge, engaging for players of all skill levels, both online and offline. Stunning graphics and a user-friendly interface designed to provide players with a seamless way to enjoy free games, spend quality time with family and friends or learn new tactics from AI in the single player mode. Whether playing offline or in the multiplayer mode, you get to improve your financial confidence and cashflow management skills by competing with other players and becoming a dominating classic board game monopolist.
● Quadropoly supports both Portrait and Landscape layouts optimised for all possible screen sizes and orientations. Players can choose which layout suits them best on a Main Menu screen.
● Quadropoly isn't just a game, it's a strategic simulation exercise designed to help players of all ages and social classes refine their investment and negotiation skills. One of the cornerstones of Quadropoly is its commitment to Fair Play. There is no cheating or re-rolling, and no hidden luck parameters affect the outcome. Players can enable Pro Setting for free – Roll Your Own Dice to be able to use any external Dice generator or use a real thing. In this game players as well as AI rely only on their business and negotiation skills to succeed. The AI doesn't distinguish whether their trading partner is another AI or a human, nor their intelligence regardless of the difficulty: trade offer evaluations are influenced by pretty much everything on the board, but not by who their opponent is.
● Quadropoly stands out by providing support for all official rules by the book and accommodating various editions of the classic board game, including support for hundreds of house rules. With AI advice available anytime during gameplay, players can rapidly improve their skills in any online business trading game. It's an educational platform where anyone can learn the market value of assets, enhance their negotiation skills, and manage their cashflow more effectively.
● One of the most exciting features of Quadropoly is the ability to watch replays of completed games from the Leaderboards. This feature helps learning new tactics and becoming a better player.
● The variable animation speed and improved balance make the game complete within just 6-15 minutes, making it a perfect choice for those seeking a quick yet exciting game. Each AI in the game is unique, reflecting its personality through its risk-taking tendencies and its attitude towards property. AI bots are adept at mimicking real people, showcasing emotions like annoyance, desperation, or greed.
● Quadropoly is known by its eight difficulty levels. Players can advance at their own pace, and the number of scores given per game depends on the number of tactics used. This ensures the best players' ability to get a higher score per game, advance 10 to 50 times faster than beginners and unlock top levels quickly. Top AI levels are capable of participating in World Championships, promising a challenging yet fair competition even for expert players.
Quadropoly is more than just a board game, it's a true immersive experience. With its innovative features, engaging gameplay, and commitment to fair play, it's a game that you will never want to put down. So come and join the fun, play with friends and family, and experience the thrill of outsmarting the competition and becoming the ultimate monopolist in the world of Quadropoly!

bluejetty:00023424:ios.name: Live BART
bluejetty:00023424:ios.summary:
Have you ever tried to catch a train at a BART station, but didn't exactly know when the train was coming? How about guessing how long the train is, only to find out the train was shorter than you thought?
If so, then Live BART is for you!
bluejetty:00023424:ios.description:
Have you ever tried to catch a train at a BART station, but didn't exactly know when the train was coming? How about guessing how long the train is, only to find out the train was shorter than you thought?
If so, then Live BART is for you! Live BART will instantly locate the nearest BART station, and display all the upcoming real-time estimated departures for that station. Additionally, you can also choose to select any other BART station, and get its estimated departures.
KEY FEATURES:
- Locates your nearest BART station instantly.
- Displays real-time estimated departures loaded directly from BART servers.
- Shows useful information for upcoming trains:
- Destination
- Estimated time until departure
- Route color
- Number of cars
- Train Platform
- Allows you to select a station by distance or by name
- Trip Planner with unique “Get a seat” mode, based on train congestion
- Feedback tab to send messages directly to the development team
- Alerts screen to view BART delays and emergencies
SERVICE REQUIREMENTS:
- Location Services
- A working internet connection

bluejetty:00015178:ios.description:
Draw funny animals! Learn the alphabet! Expand your device with pen and paper!
DRAWNIMAL is a unique app where kids draw adorable animals while learning the alphabet. With your phone or tablet placed on paper, kids select an animal face from the alphabet menu and draw around the device. The app then instructs how to draw the rest of the animal body. The digital screen is inventively extended with a simple physical interaction, which encourages kids to think outside the box. Hilarious and delightful animations motivate to keep learning.
Our primary goal with the app was to expand your device by using simple tangible tools like pen and paper.
Features:
+ Play with up to 35 animals
+ Get the first 5 animals (A-E) for free
+ Draw animals and see them come alive with animation
+ Practice the alphabet in a creative and interactive way
+ Switch between 6 languages
+ Lively animations and impressive audio
+ No failing, no goal, no wrong or right
+ Supports all iPads and iPhones with iOS 16 or later
+ No internet access needed!
+ No advertisements!
Available in 6 languages with full voice acting: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Dutch!
Learn more about YATATOY: yatatoy.com
Contact us for assistance or to give feedback: https://yatatoy.com/info/
MADE BY YATATOY

** Real Citizen Calculator Gst main features at a glance: 
- Advanced yet easy to use business calculator app for iPhone
- Stylish and elegant citizen calculator themes.
- GST/TAX calculator with adjustable parameter
- Unlimited steps check & memory.
- Faster & Accurate in Performance.
- Share calculation with ease.
** Gst Search OR Gst Verify
GST Search or GST verify tool is to identify the name, address and other GSTIN details of any taxpayer in India. GST Search helps you to verify business details and let you know whether GSTIN taxpayer is active or not. GST search gives details as follows :
- Legal name of business
- State Jurisdiction
- Taxpayer type
- GSTIN status
- GSTIN filling status
** REAL CITIZEN CALCULATOR (CITIZEN CALCULATOR/CASIO CALCULATOR THEME)

- BASIC CALCULATIONS (+,-,*,/): For Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division
- PERCENTAGE KEY (%): Calculate Percentage and also add/subtract to core values.
- MEMORY KEYS (M+,M-,MRC): Used to add/subtract value into memory.
- GRAND TOTAL (GT): The GT Key is to recall the Grand Total Memory!
- CHECK UP & DOWN (CHECK): To check the calculation from first same as Citizen Calculator App.
- MARKUP (MU): Markup refers to the difference between the selling price and its cost, expressed as a percentage above the cost.
-CORRECT & DELETE : To update while checking or delete digit wise.
** GST CALCULATOR & TAX CALCULATOR
- Easy and the quickest way to calculate Goods and Service Tax (GST) on sales or purchase of goods or services including IGST, CGST and SGST calculations.

Real Citizen Calculator Gst offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription at INR 499/year to provide you premium ad free big calculator. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00154542:ios.description:
Get ready to swallow everything in sight!
Welcome to Black Hole - Eat Everything, a super fun and relaxing black hole game inspired by classic io games and the most popular eating games. Control a mysterious blackhole, swallow fruits, snacks, and giant desserts, and grow bigger with every bite. It’s one of the most satisfying games you’ll ever play — part puzzle, part collecting adventure, and all fun!
Start Small, Grow Big, Swallow All
Your journey begins with a tiny hole. Start by swallowing small fruit like strawberries, apples, and watermelons. As your hole grows, you’ll take down burgers, donuts, pizzas, and even giant cakes. But this isn’t just about eating everything — it’s about clever moves and puzzle-solving strategy.
How to Become the Ultimate Eating Champion:
Find & Swallow: Move your hole to swallow everything in sight — from apples and avocados to sweet donuts and cupcakes.
Control the Black Hole: Watch as objects drop into your blackhole, giving you that perfect antistress and satisfying feeling.
Clear the Plate: Devour all the required items to complete each level and unlock more challenges.
Solve Puzzles: Plan your path carefully to navigate tricky layouts and fill every space.
Relax or Challenge: Play casually for stress relief, or take on tougher levels to prove your skill.
A Delicious World to Explore
Every level is bursting with colorful snacks and playful puzzles. Roll through piles of fruit, collect cupcakes, and glide past obstacles as you grow your hole bigger and bigger. If you love color hole mechanics, collecting games, or puzzle games for free, this is the perfect game for you.
Why Players Love This Game:
Super smooth and satisfying gameplay that’s perfect for relaxation.
Easy to play, but filled with fun puzzles for free.
A mix of digging games, eating games, and collecting games.
Thousands of creative levels with snacks, fruit, donuts, and cakes.
Inspired by donut county, holedown, and whole.io — beloved classics of io free games.
No pressure, just the joy of watching everything get swallowed by your hole!
Grow, Eat, and Conquer
With each level, your hole becomes more powerful. From tiny treats to massive feasts, nothing can escape the pull of your blackhole. Use your brain to solve puzzles, find clever angles, and swallow everything to clear the board. Whether you call it a blak hole, a donut hole, or just the ultimate void — the thrill of eating games has never been so fun.
From juicy fruit to giant cakes, every bite brings you closer to becoming the ultimate champion. Glide through obstacles, collect every piece, fill in the gaps, and grow until nothing is left on the board. This is your world now — one delicious snack at a time.
Download Black Hole - Eat Everything now
Jump into a colorful, playful, and deeply satisfying world. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing antistress escape or a puzzle challenge, this black hole game is for you. Swallow, collect, grow, and become the ultimate hole master!

bluejetty:00159371:ios.description:
Phone Security: Privacy Shield – Efficient Mobile Security and Cleanup for Your Phone
Phone Security: Privacy Shield is a comprehensive iOS tool designed to keep your device secure, organized, and optimized. From clearing up storage to ensuring your system is up-to-date, this app helps you maintain peak performance with ease.
Key Features:
1. Comprehensive Cleanup:
- Automatically detect and remove duplicate photos, blurry images, and large files.
- Organize and clean up screenshots, hidden photos, and low-quality images to reclaim valuable storage space.
- Perform a one-tap scan across photos, videos, and system data to quickly clean and optimize your device.
2. Advanced Security Scan:
- Check if your device is protected with a secure password, safeguarding your personal data.
- Ensure your Phone is running the latest system updates to stay protected from security risks.
- Enhance your privacy and security by maintaining up-to-date device settings.
3. Comprehensive Device Info:
- Access detailed information about your device, including battery health, CPU and RAM usage, network performance, and more.
- Monitor your device’s performance in real-time to ensure it's running smoothly.
4. Clean Guide:
- Follow easy, step-by-step guides to clear app caches for popular social media apps like YouTube, WhatsApp, and TikTok.
- Offload unused apps to free up even more space and keep your device running efficiently.
Phone Security: Privacy Shield gives you the tools to clean, secure, and optimize your Phone, all in one easy-to-use app. Download now to keep your phone running at its best!
Choose from the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
You may cancel your subscription at any time.
Free trial allows you unlimited access to all features for the duration of 3 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 3 days free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone
Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the Account Settings:
- Open the Settings app.
- Tap your name.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription that you want to manage.
For support or more information, reach out to us at: Baker981@163.com
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/phone-securit-privacy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/phone-securit-term-of-use

It supports tons of cool features: quick search, moving, deleting, opening, and sharing files, as well as renaming, unzipping, and copy-paste.

Survive endless roguelike waves with auto-firing turrets and devastating upgrade cards. Every run is different. Battle real players in PvP, join an alliance, and climb seasonal leaderboards in this modern tower defense RPG.

Upgrade weapons, choose powerful cards between waves, and adapt as enemies grow smarter. Every battle plays differently.

DYNAMIC BATTLEFIELDS

Download now, rally your alliance, and rise through the ranks. The battlefield is waiting.

bluejetty:00076727:ios.description:
SmartHub provides utility and telecommunications customers account management at their fingertips. Customers can view their usage and billing, manage payments, notify customer service of account and service issues and receive special messaging from their local utility or telecommunications company. NISC serves over 500 telecoms and utilities across the nation, install the application to determine if your local organization is supported. 
Additional Features:
Bill & Pay -
Quickly view your current account balance and due date, manage recurring payments and modify payment methods. You can also view bill history including PDF versions of paper bills directly on your mobile device. Make a payment now or schedule it for a future date.
My Usage -
View energy usage graphs to identify high usage trends. Navigate graphs quickly using an intuitive gesture based interface. 
Contact Us -
Easily contact your service provider by email or phone. You can also submit one of the many predefined messages, with the ability to include pictures and GPS coordinates.
News -
Provides a convenient way to monitor news that may affect your service such as rate changes, outage information and upcoming events.
Service Status -
Displays service interruption and outage information. You can also report an outage directly to your service provider.
Maps -
Displays facility and payment dropbox locations on a map interface.
Manage Wifi -
Easily manage your WiFi network and connected devices. Maintain passwords, troubleshoot issues, create and control guest networks, limit access to connected devices, create rules with parental controls and check internet speed.

bluejetty:00042242:ios.name: Finalist: Daily Planner
bluejetty:00042242:ios.summary: Inspired by paper planners, Finalist shows your calendar, tasks, notes, reminders and weather forecast in one beautiful timeline. It even pulls in your Journal Suggestions and Activity Rings to keep you inspired. Gorgeous themes make planni
bluejetty:00042242:ios.description:
Inspired by paper planners, Finalist shows your calendar, tasks, notes, reminders and weather forecast in one beautiful timeline. It even pulls in your Journal Suggestions and Activity Rings to keep you inspired. Gorgeous themes make planning a joy, not a chore.
Finalist is built for people who finish things, no complex workflows or productivity theater.
NOTES, IN YOUR PLANNER
Your planner remembers what you wrote. A dedicated Notes tab gives you notebooks, tags and search. Keep native notes that sync over iCloud, or connect a folder of plain markdown files, including your Obsidian vault, and edit them in place. Tasks inside your markdown files become real Finalist tasks: dated, tagged and checkable anywhere in the app.
YOUR DAY, ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app puts your whole day one glance away: events, tasks, reminders and habits in one scrollable view, topped by a Now card that always knows what matters next. Check off pinned lists from the wrist, grocery list included, and add tasks by keyboard, scribble or dictation. Complications and a Smart Stack widget round it out. (Requires watchOS 26.)
DESIGN YOUR DAY
Choose between two Daily designs: Daybook, the classic stacked layout, or Broadsheet, a newsprint-inspired look that shines on iPad and Mac. Rearrange sections with the layout editor and save your own presets. On the rebuilt Timeline, drag tasks onto the grid to sketch your day in pencil, then commit when it's real.
"I've tried dozens of planning apps, this is the one that finally works." - Beta user
"The integration of Reminders and Lists reduces the apps I need daily and makes planning actually fun." - Beta user
Built with native Apple technologies: no accounts to create, syncs over iCloud, supports Family Sharing, and runs on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro and Mac. Full database backup, export and import via JSON and OPML.
Finalist is a love letter to paper planners. Give it a try, it feels great :)
Purchasing information
To get the full functionality in Finalist you will need to either purchase a subscription or a one time In-App Purchase for Lifetime access. The purchase amount will be applied to your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Lifetime purchase is a one-time fee. For more information, see our Terms of Use at https://finalist.works/eula/ and our Privacy Policy at https://finalist.works/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00146551:ios.description:
Learn Kannada SmartApp: The World’s #1 Kannada Learning App
Learn Kannada SmartApp is the leading platform to help users worldwide learn the Kannada language with ease. Created by Varun Anantha, this app is designed to break language barriers and provide a seamless experience for anyone keen to learn Kannada. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your Kannada skills, the app offers a comprehensive solution to learn spoken Kannada, write Kannada letters, and even grasp Kannada grammar fundamentals.
What Makes Learn Kannada SmartApp Unique?
nitially launched in 2017 as a two-person project, the app quickly gained popularity and recognition for its innovative approach to Kannada learning. With increasing demand from users, especially for iOS devices, the app was rebuilt and relaunched in 2021, becoming the top Kannada teaching app. Here’s what the app offers:
1. Ten Days Course: Kannada in Just 10 Days!
This structured course is perfect for anyone looking to grasp Kannada essentials quickly.
Focus on daily-use words: Learn commonly used Kannada words and phrases.
Pronunciation and examples: Each word includes accurate pronunciation and example sentences to help with usage.
2. Flexi Course: Learn Your Way
Tailored for flexible learning, this feature lets you explore:
a. Words by Category: Learn Kannada vocabulary organized into everyday categories like Numbers, Vegetables, Fruits, and more.
b. Conversations: Master real-world dialogues for scenarios like talking to an auto-driver, visiting a doctor, and more.
c. Antonyms: Expand your vocabulary by learning words and their opposites.
d. Quizzes for Specific Sets: Take quizzes for specific word categories or even based on difficulty levels for targeted practice.
3. Grammar: Comprehensive Kannada Fundamentals
The app helps you dive deeper into the Kannada language with easy-to-follow explanations, videos, and practice tools.
Kannada Alphabet: Learn to write Kannada letters through on-screen animations and practice using an interactive scribble pad.
Kannada Syllables: Understand syllables with detailed tutorials and embedded videos.
Compound Letters: Learn compound letters through structured theory and video guides.
4. Quizzes: Interactive and Customizable
Test your knowledge with quizzes that adapt to your learning. Choose from formats like:
Listen & Choose
Read & Choose
Match Pairs
Translate Sentence
Plus, take quizzes tailored to specific sets of words or based on your difficulty level to sharpen your skills further.
5. Global Leaderboard: Compete and Celebrate Learning
Earn points as you learn and complete quizzes. Climb the Global Leaderboard and see where you rank among learners worldwide.
6. Streak: Build and Maintain a Daily Learning Habit
Stay motivated with the streak feature, encouraging consistent daily learning. Compete with others on the Streak Leaderboard to stay on track.
7. Offline Access: Learn Anytime, Anywhere
No internet? No problem! Download lessons and continue your learning journey offline.
8. Dedicated Support and Feedback
For any suggestions, feedback, or assistance, reach out directly to the developer via WhatsApp at +91-8618316754. Your input matters and helps make the app even better.
Why Choose Learn Kannada SmartApp?
Built single-handedly by Varun Anantha, this app reflects dedication to quality and user needs.

bluejetty:00096629:ios.description:
Take a mindful pause and find clarity in a noisy world.
Omna is for those who seek a safe space to unwind, reflect, and grow. 
Rooted in science and backed by time-tested techniques, our app offers a compassionate and structured approach to mental wellness. 
From guided exercises to personalized self-care routines, we’re here to empower you to navigate your emotions and cultivate healthier habits at your own pace.
What you’ll find inside:
Personalized mental health plans. Simple daily routines and exercises to manage anxiety, burnout, procrastination, and more
Mood tracking. Tools to keep track of your feelings, uncover thought patterns, and get helpful summaries through AI-powered analysis
Soothing sounds and guided routines. Relax, sleep, or focus with calming audio tools
AI chat assistant. A safe, non-judgmental companion to talk to or receive gentle guidance from
Stories & insights. Daily doses of insight to uplift and shift your perspective
Quizzes. Quick self-check tools to help you better understand where you're at mentally and emotionally
Articles on real-life challenges. From self-worth and trouble focusing to work-life balance, find helpful information on how to deal with your daily struggles
Important disclaimer:
We do not offer any medical help. All the information Omna provides is intended for educational purposes only. Do not use it for self-diagnosis or treatment. Please seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions.
About our AI assistant:
Our AI chat assistant is supported by the OpenAI models. We use the latest AI models to provide you with more personalized insights and in-depth analysis. Don’t worry, your personal data is safe and secure in accordance with strict privacy standards. 
Subscriptions & terms:
Our service is subscription-based. We offer a few different plans you can choose from depending on your needs. Subscriptions renew automatically within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel it anytime in your account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://omna.me/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://omna.me/terms

bluejetty:00068673:ios.name: Wheel +: Spin Roulette Picker
bluejetty:00068673:ios.summary: Wheel + is a random picker app: build your own spinning wheel, type in your options, and spin to pick one at random. Use it to decide where to eat, whose turn is next, who wins a giveaway, or anything else you can't settle. No account is ne
bluejetty:00068673:ios.description:
Wheel + is a random picker app: build your own spinning wheel, type in your options, and spin to pick one at random. Use it to decide where to eat, whose turn is next, who wins a giveaway, or anything else you can't settle. No account is needed, and the app is free to download and use.
[Features]
- Quick and simple: type your options and spin
- Up to 500 slices per wheel, 200 wheels saved automatically
- Over 100 music tracks, sound effects, and visual effects combined
- Weight settings to adjust each option's chance
- Handy modes such as Tap to Stop and Remove Once Chosen
- Passcode lock with Face ID and Touch ID, plus dark mode
[Function Details]
■ Background music and sound effects
A large collection of funny sounds and voices, the kind you often hear in YouTube videos. Winning sounds range from a simple fanfare to a boxing gong and a cash register sound, and each wheel can have its own combination. Save your favorite setup as the default for new wheels.
■ Up to 500 slices, 200 saved wheels
Each wheel holds up to 500 options, and up to 200 wheels are saved automatically. Swipe left on a wheel in the list to duplicate it and make a variation in seconds. You can also reorder options and wheels.
■ Weight: adjust the odds
Give each option a weight to change how likely it is to be selected. Set "Win" to 1 and "Lose" to 99 for a 1-in-100 chance of winning. Keep every weight the same and every option has an equal chance.
■ Remove Once Chosen
With this mode on, each winning option is removed from the wheel, so you can keep spinning until only one is left. Perfect for turn order, elimination games, and drawings where the same option is never picked twice.
■ Tap to Stop
When this mode is on, the wheel starts slowing down at the moment you tap. Add your own timing instead of leaving it all to chance.
■ Spin time
Set how long each wheel spins, from 3 to 20 seconds. Keep it short for quick decisions, or stretch it out to build suspense.
■ Special visual effects
Just when the wheel seems to have decided, the selection shifts to the neighboring slice, the wheel suddenly spins again, or the screen goes dark for a moment. You can set how often they happen.
■ Passcode lock and dark mode
Lock the app with a passcode, and unlock it with Face ID or Touch ID. Dark mode is also included.
[Ways to use it]
- Decide where to eat or what to cook for dinner
- Pick who goes first, who cleans up, or who presents next
- Enter names and draw giveaway winners
- Spice up party games and penalty games
- Draw winners or bingo numbers at weddings and local events
- Pick random topics or winners on YouTube and live streams
- Enter the numbers 1 to 6 and it can even stand in for dice
- Make a yes-or-no wheel when you just can't decide
[Recommended for]
- Anyone who wants a wheel spinner or random name picker for prizes and everyday choices
- Teachers, families, and workplaces that decide turns fairly
- Streamers and event hosts who want a draw that looks good
[Pricing]
The app is free to use. It will not suddenly stop working or start charging you.
To remove ads or use every music track, sound effect, and visual effect without limits, the paid Premium Pack is available, with a free 3-day trial. Choose from three plans: monthly, yearly, or a one-time purchase that you keep forever.
[Data and environment]
- When you switch to a new iPhone, your wheels transfer automatically with Apple's Quick Start (iOS to iOS only; data cannot be transferred to other OS version)
- Works offline, so you can spin even with no signal
- Works on both iPhone and iPad
- Available in 35 languages
[Contact]
If you have any questions about the app, please contact us from "Help" -> "Contact Us" on the app's settings screen.
There are no annoying notifications.
Whenever you can't decide, spin Wheel + and let it settle things.
[Terms of Service]
https://komorebi-studio.com/tos_en.html
[Privacy Policy]
https://komorebi-studio.com/policyredirect.html

bluejetty:00021723:ios.summary: The SilverCloud Mobile location management software app will allow users of the SilverCloud the ability to view and monitor the precise location of LandAirSea GPS trackers installed on vehicles and/or assets, whether it's a single vehicle o
bluejetty:00021723:ios.description:
The SilverCloud Mobile location management software app will allow users of the SilverCloud the ability to view and monitor the precise location of LandAirSea GPS trackers installed on vehicles and/or assets, whether it's a single vehicle or an entire fleet of vehicles, from anywhere conveniently from their iPhone or iPad mobile device. 
With the SilverCloud Mobile App, users will be able to monitor the speed and battery life of each device by tapping on the icon located on the map. The location also updates automatically, showing the real-time GPS location of the user's vehicles and/or mobile devices. Users will also have the option of generating the Historical Playback of their tracking data to see precisely where their devices travelled. 
Vehicle updates will be based on user's data plan - 1 minute, 10 seconds, 5 seconds, or as fast as 3 second continuous updates. 
About LandAirSea Systems: 
LandAirSea Systems, Inc. has been a leading manufacturer of GPS tracking systems since 1994. Since its inception, LandAirSea has been pioneering the manufacturing and development of both historical and real-time GPS-based surveillance technology, supplying vehicle tracking systems for law enforcement agencies, fleet management services and personal vehicle tracking. 
All of the GPS tracking devices offered by LandAirSea undergo extensive predevelopment research and testing to ensure that our customers are receiving quality products guaranteed to deliver real, measurable results. LandAirSea is committed to designing and manufacturing GPS products that provide precision, simplicity and durability.

bluejetty:00166075:ios.description:

No pitching brands.
No complicated negotiations.
No follower requirements.
Whether you’re an experienced influencer or just starting out, Noise helps creators:
- Create Content With Purpose
Discover content opportunities built around proven formats that perform across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more.
- Earn Real Money Through Creator Opportunities
Participate in paid opportunities while focusing on creativity instead of outreach or promotion.
- Grow as a Creator Over Time
Build real posting experience, confidence, and momentum - no followers needed!

Clear guidance and simple expectations make it easy to focus on creating.

- Digital Marketers looking for their next opportunity
- Stay at home mom’s (SAHM) looking for some extra money on the side
- Anyone looking for a side hustle

- Get paid for creating content about brands
- Apply to join brand deals in seconds
- Analytics to help you understand your content and improve
- Flexible schedule - You determine when you want to create content
- Track your earnings in real time

- Easy and fast payouts
You don’t need to be an influencer to start - and you can start with 0 followers!
Start Creating With Noise
Download Noise and join the hundreds of thousands of other creators earning today. Noise is a place where creator opportunities are designed to grow with you - whether you’re already an influencer or just getting started as a new UGC creator with no followers.

bluejetty:00126867:ios.description:
Celebrate Easter with Amen through our Daily Catholic Prayers, bible readings, rosary & more!
Amen is the Catholic Bible and prayers app that helps inspire your conversation with God. The daily readings, Catholic Mass recordings, and nourishing Scripture passages allow you to further your relationship with God. Our recordings of Catholic prayers let you pray as you go about your daily routine.
Calm your mind with Christian meditations and sleep recordings, then nourish your soul with the holy Rosary & Catholic prayers. Dive even deeper with immersive Bible study & Catholic daily readings.
Our new Daily Carousel at the top of the Today Screen has convenient, practical daily content to build your spiritual habits.
Daily Catholic Prayers
- Immerse yourself in the spirit of Easter with our Catholic bible, prayers & readings!
- Enjoy Catholic daily readings & devotions
- The prayer app: Find inspiration with prayers such as the Morning Offering, Act of Hope, & more
- New prayers added regularly
- 20 prayers in Spanish, now available!
- Save your favorite prayers & pray as you go about your day
- Prayer journal: Keep journal entries & notes of your favorite prayers
Catholic Bible Studies & Stories
- Immerse yourself in new audio Bible study experiences
- Our immersive audio Bible studies will nourish your soul
- Experience the Scriptures and the life of Christ vividly like never before
Catholic Rosary
- Pray the Rosary in standard, meditative, and scriptural formats
- Enjoy the Catholic Rosary with optional background music
Daily Catholic Mass Readings
- Listen to insights on the daily Catholic Mass readings from Scripture scholar Dr. Tim Gray
- Opening the Word: Explore reflections on the Sunday Mass readings from trusted Catholic theologians and speakers
- Re-discover the Word of God and the Catholic Mass with spiritual guidance
Christian & Catholic Meditations
- Meditate through guided lectio divina
- Biblical, Christian meditations for every day of the week
- Enjoy a diverse selection of Catholic meditations such as "Guard your Mind," "Delivered from Shame," and more
- Enjoy sleep stories that bring you into stories inspired by Scripture
- Learn how to pray and grow in your Catholic spirituality with new learning series now on Amen
Improve your relationship with God with our Catholic prayers & Bible app. Our Christian meditations, Catholic Rosary prayers, Scriptures, and Catholic daily readings help you pursue more profound communion with God.
Amen can save your meditation and sleep sessions to your Apple Health app.

bluejetty:00140543:ios.description:
Welcome to Blitzopia, the chaos realm. Blessed with elemental powers, you are the last hope to bring peace. 
In Hero Blitz, an action roguelike offline game where you will slash monsters, dodge enemies' attacks, conquer endless dungeons, and upgrade your power. Each run is different, with random maps, elemental upgrades and loot to build your perfect hero gear set.
Main Features:
▶ Fast-paced Hack and Slash Combat – Slash through enemies in this roguelike action RPG! Use quick reflexes to dodge, dash, jump, and strike in dynamic dungeon exploration combat. Face epic boss fights and survive chaotic bullet hell patterns!
▶ Elemental Skill Roguelike System – After each round, choose a random elemental skill upgrade: Fire - Burn enemies with splash damage; Ice - Freeze and stun; Lightning - Chain electric shocks; Toxic - Poison damage over time
▶ Unlock Unique Heroes – 10+ chibi anime heroes, each with their own abilities, element, and Ultimate Skill. Collect and build your dream hero for every dungeon run.
▶ Gear Up with Loot – Collect 50+ items, weapons, and runes. From katanas to hammers, darts, gloves to pets—upgrade your gear and dominate every roguelike dungeon.
▶ Multiple Dungeon Modes – Test your skills in challenging dungeon crawler gameplay: Boss Raid; Shadow War Tower, Idle RPG Resource Dungeon.
▶ Offline Gameplay – A true offline game! No Wi-Fi needed. Enjoy single player solo adventures anywhere, anytime.
Whether you love roguelike RPGs, hack and slash games, deep gear upgrades, or Anime chibi hero, Hero Blitz is your next addiction.

bluejetty:00143254:ios.description:
myPRP is used by patients to securely access images and reports of scans performed at a PRP Diagnostic Imaging practice. You may also request appointments through this app.
When your results are ready to view, you will receive an SMS message containing a link to a registration instructions page with an activation code. You will need to use this code to activate your account and set a password. You will be able to use your account to access to all future studies performed at any practice in the PRP Imaging network.
The 'Request an Appointment' feature allows you to organise a visit to one of our practices. Please enter details of the imaging required and upload a photo of the referral form filled out by your doctor. Our friendly staff will then contact you to organise and confirm the appointment.
If you need assistance with myPRP please email myprp@prpimaging.com.au with a description of the problem.
For more information about PRP Imaging visit www.prpimaging.com.au
Please Note: Your doctor will be able to access your images and report as soon as they are available. You should always return to your doctor to discuss your results.

bluejetty:00100424:ios.summary: BookBuds is a cozy social reading app that makes reading with friends easy, fun, and motivating. Sit around your own virtual bonfire, track reading time, build daily streaks, and compete on a shared leaderboard to see who’s reading the most
bluejetty:00100424:ios.description:
BookBuds is a cozy social reading app that makes reading with friends easy, fun, and motivating. Sit around your own virtual bonfire, track reading time, build daily streaks, and compete on a shared leaderboard to see who’s reading the most.
Whether you’re trying to read more books, finish your TBR list, build a reading habit, or simply stay accountable with friends, BookBuds turns reading into a shared experience instead of something you do alone.
Read Together Around a Virtual Bonfire
Start a reading session and watch your BookBud glow as you read. Your friends can join you anytime, making reading feel cozy, warm, and connected.. even when you’re miles apart.
Track Your Reading Time Effortlessly
No more manual book logs. BookBuds automatically tracks your reading minutes with a built-in reading timer.
Compete on a Social Reading Leaderboard
See who in your friend group is reading the most each day, week, or month. Build streaks. Climb the leaderboard. Celebrate wins together.
Invite Your Friends & Build a Reading Circle
Reading is more fun when you do it together. Share your BookBuds link, invite friends, compare progress, and stay motivated as a group. Achieve your 2026 reading goals together!
Perfect for Your TBR + Self-Improvement Goals
If your 2026 goals are focused on reading more books, reducing screen time, or developing mindful habits, BookBuds makes it easier.. and way more fun!
Why BookBuds Works
Reading feels fun, not forced
Friends keep you accountable
Streaks build momentum
The bonfire creates a comforting ritual
Competition sparks motivation
Tracking is automatic
Start Your Reading Journey Today
Read more books, stay consistent, and build a habit that sticks: all with your friends beside you around a cozy virtual bonfire.
Download BookBuds and make reading social again.
Link to our privacy policy: https://privacypolicybookbuds.vercel.app/
Link to our terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Subscriptions & Billing
BookBuds offers optional auto-renewing subscriptions that unlock premium features such as advanced reading analytics, enhanced customization, and additional Pro tools. 
Subscriptions are available in monthly and yearly plans and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from your Apple ID account settings. 
All core social reading features — including reading with friends, bonfire sessions, leaderboards, profiles, and chats — remain free to use without a subscription.

bluejetty:00033719:ios.description:
Transform your indoor rides with the virtual and esports cycling platform thoughtfully designed for a realistic experience!
Follow your own training plan, easily organize a group ride with friends, or race for real with a wide selection of event types - all in TrainingPeaks Virtual. Feel confident with consistent updates and frequently added new features, keeping you in sync with the fast-paced world of cycling and virtual training. Unlock stronger rides on your trainer, no road required.
Key Features:
Real-World Physics: In TrainingPeaks Virtual, tactics matter. Experience a more realistic ride with proprietary real-world physics, including drafting, cornering, braking and line choice.
Lightning-Fast Syncing: With TrainingPeaks Virtual as part of the TrainingPeaks ecosystem, you’ll never waste time finding or transferring your data. Hop on your trainer and ride!
Centralized Workout Hub: Find all your workouts where you want them, when you want them. Easily select from an open-world ride following multiple terrain types, apply one of many default structured training rides, or access your planned workouts from your coach. Reach fitness goals by following every step of your structured training with power and pace targets, workout previews, and more.
Race with Credible Results: Participate in esports from home. TrainingPeaks Virtual offers a wide selection of event types, including team racing, keirin, elimination and more. DS Mode helps your team strategize, and unparalleled sub-millimeter accuracy guarantees results the whole team can see and trust.

bluejetty:00128365:ios.description:
Tile Journey – a relaxing triple tiles matching puzzle game, is more than just a match 3 puzzle game — it’s a peaceful journey where you can relax, unwind, and sharpen your mind all at once. 
How to Play Tile Journey
Tile Journey is simple to learn but packed with strategic depth. Here's how it works:
-- Match 3 Tiles or make triple matches to Clear the Board. Tap on the puzzle board to pick up tiles. Your goal is to collect three identical tiles to make a match and remove them from your collection tray. When all tiles are cleared, you win the level!
-- Watch Out for Overflow. You can only hold a limited number of tiles at once. If your tray fills up without a match, it’s game over. Plan your moves carefully and think ahead.
-- Unlock New Skins & Themes. As you complete levels, unlock new visual themes and tile sets to personalize your gameplay. From floral patterns to cute animals to zen-inspired tiles, every theme adds a touch of charm to your relaxing puzzle experience.
Special Features That Make This Triple Tiles Matching Game Stand Out
Relaxing Puzzle Game Design:
-- Designed to help you unwind after a long day. 
-- Gentle sound effects and soft visuals provide a zen atmosphere.
-- No stressful timers while playing. Stay in a relaxing vibe. 
Innovative Tile Matching Puzzle Mechanics:
--Inspired by classic tile matching puzzles but enhanced with new triple matching logic.
--A refreshing twist on traditional match-3 tile puzzle games. 
--Easy to pick up, hard to master.
Daily Events & Challenges:
-- Enjoy brand new puzzles and limited-time events.
-- Special tiles, bonus rewards, and themed challenges keep things fresh and engaging.
-- Always something new to look forward to! 
Power-ups & Hints:
-- Stuck on a level? Use intuitive power-ups like undo, hint, or shuffle to get back on track.
--Perfect for both casual and hardcore puzzle solvers. 
Brain Teasing Levels:
-- Carefully designed puzzles increase in difficulty as you progress. 
-- Each level helps you train your logical thinking and train your memory.
-- Great for boosting mental agility while having fun.
Match Tiles Offline – Anytime, Anywhere:
-- No internet? No problem. Tile Journey is a fully offline match 3 puzzle game.
Start Your Tile Journey Today
Tile Journey is the perfect tile matching puzzle game to relax your mind and unwind anytime you want. Whether you’re a fan of match 3 tiles or triple tiles mechanics, looking for a fun brain teaser, or just need a relaxing escape journey, this game has something for you. Train your brain, challenge your logic, and experience the calm joy of tile matching like never before.
Download Tile Journey now and join the ever-growing tile-matching fun! Discover the soothing satisfaction of triple matching tiles, explore hundreds of levels, and enjoy daily puzzle challenges—all at your own pace.

bluejetty:00076607:android.description:
What is NucleApp?
NucleApp is a dynamic platform to build apps without the need for any programming/coding knowledge or technical skills. It helps users to create any type of app with simple and easy steps. It can create professional-level apps with equipped tools and can be used by any Android, iOS, and Web platforms for free. 
NucleApp has strong expertise from ‘SurveyHeart’ which is another successful company run by the Same Founder. With NucleApp, the world of app development becomes accessible to everyone. Empower your creativity and turn your ideas into reality with this revolutionary app creation platform. Start building your app today and unlock the limitless possibilities of mobile technology. 
Why NucleApp?
Easy-to-use Interface:
The interface is intuitive and easy to use. You don't need any technical skills to get started. Our app provides a clean and user-friendly interface that guides you through the entire app creation process. You can easily navigate through various sections and modules to build your desired app.
Intuitive Drag-and-Drop Interface: 
NucleApp simplifies the app development process by providing a visual drag-and-drop interface. You can effortlessly design and arrange app screens, buttons, images, and other elements to create a stunning and professional-looking app.
App Templates:
Choose from a wide variety of pre-built 80+ app templates that cater to different industries and app types. These templates provide a solid foundation for your app and save you time in designing its basic structure. You can customize and personalize these templates according to your requirements. Discover our extensive collection of categorized pre-built app templates including Real estate, art & Fashion, Lifestyle & Wellness, Transportation, Content Creation, Reading & literature, organization & productivity, Education, Events & planning, communication & contacts, Cooking & Food, Sports, Technology & Design, Health & Wellness, Travel & Tourism, Business & Employment, News and Information, Shopping, Photography & Creativity and etc.,
Screen Builder:
The screen builder typically provides a visual representation of the app screen or page being designed. It may resemble the final appearance of the app, allowing developers to see a real-time preview as they make changes.
App Builder:
The app builder provides the functionality to search the screens created by the user. With this feature, users can easily manage and navigate through their collection of screens by applying sorting options based on criteria such as screen name, creation date, or other relevant parameters. Additionally, users can utilize the search functionality to quickly find specific screens by entering keywords or filters, making it efficient to locate and work with the desired screens within the app builder. 
App Link Creation:
After Publishing the app, it typically generates a unique link that serves as the access point for your app. This link can be shared with your users, friends, or potential customers, allowing them to easily access and install the app. The generated link serves as a gateway to your app and can be distributed through various channels. You can share the link via messaging apps, email, and social media platforms, or even embed it on your website. By sharing the link, you enable others to directly download and install your app on their devices. It also provides options to submit your app to official app stores.
Preview:
This feature provides a real-time representation of how the screen will look. This allows for immediate feedback and evaluation of the screen's appearance and functionality, enabling users to identify any necessary adjustments or refinements. Previewing the screen helps ensure a polished and user-friendly experience by allowing developers to iteratively fine-tune the design and achieve the desired look and feel before proceeding with further development or publishing the app.

Measure your well-being and identify areas for improvement through self-management
Choose actions to enhance your well-being
Explore health and wellness options offered by your employer based on your self-assessment

Become aware of improvements and maintain your daily balance

Unfortunately, one kid is too jealous to let him do that… It’s Christmas Eve. A boy named Christopher writes a letter to Santa Claus. As impossible as it seems, the good wizard reads his letter and sends him the Golden Ticket to the Polar Express! Still, the trip is going to be rough because a group of bad boys wants to steal all Christmas gifts made for the good kids! And their sneaky leader, Harmverse, is up to no good… This is a free version of the Christmas Spirit: Golden Ticket! Solving the mysteries is not so easy, try to prove the opposite using your mind and ingenuity!

You can be a real explorer, because the world of our games every corner is filled with hidden items!
