bluejetty:00066157:ios.description:
Welcome to My Block - a challenging and addictive block game that will bring a lot of fun to you!
Welcome to the universe of My Block! It is a novice-friendly addictive game, that has constant changes during the game progress, ensuring that you never get bored. You can win only if your mind is clear and your logic is strong. Perfect yourself by improving your high score! 
It’s not just an ordinary block puzzle game, but a whole new gaming world based on the traditional concept and able to bring fresh sensation for the familiar gameplay. 
Main features:
Simple rules, comfortable control
Smooth animation and splendid graphic design
Two Modes: Normal and Challenges
Variety of challenges with different difficulties, gaming board sizes, etc.
Different tools that you can use for passing the levels
Always progressing to make you beat your own score
Daily challenges for the long-lasting gaming experience 
Normal mode:
Use your best skills and strategy to score as much as possible in one round
Game board with no stress and no time limits, 
Challenges mode:
Different difficulties, different goals
Different sizes of the game board with creative stages
The more lines you remove the higher prize you get
How to play:
Move blocks across the board
When blocks form a horizontal or vertical line, that line will disappear from the board
Once the block is fixed on the board, it can’t be moved.
When there is no space for the new block, the round is finished 
VIP membership subscription
- You can subscribe for VIP membership, It gives you 300 coins + 5 refresh + 5 rotation everyday.
- The VIP membership is a weekly subscription, that costs $6.99 and starts after a 3-day free trial.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews at the same price unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user and after purchase, auto-renewal may be turned off in the user's iTunes Account Settings. 
- No cancellation of the current subscription period is allowed.
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the trial period to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/HT202039 for more information
Our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: http://www.myblockpuzzleios.com/privacy.html
Contact us:
We would be happy if you tell us any advice and suggestion about our game.
Our email address: blockpuzzle.help@boooea.com.
Our goal is to deliver you a great gaming experience, so we will constantly work on making My Block more interesting and positive.

bluejetty:00175343:ios.description:
TextFree is the first—and still the best—free phone number app. Join the hundreds of millions of people who use TextFree for free, unlimited calling and texting.
TextFree is easy to use and boasts a list of features you won’t get from other apps. Choose a local phone number with unlimited calling and texting. Send photos, videos, GIFs, audio messages, emojis, and PDFs. Custom ring and text tones make it easy to identify when your TextFree number is ringing, and custom wallpapers let you personalize your experience.
Need more features? Upgrade to TextFree Plus to remove ads and get unlimited access to verification codes for online accounts. You’ll also lock in your number so it won’t change or expire while you’re subscribed—unless you choose to change it yourself.
TEXTFREE FEATURES
- Select a free phone number with an area code of your choice
- Choose from a bank of custom number combinations
- Unlimited calls & texts let you communicate for free over WiFi
- Share photos, videos, and GIF messages
- Send and receive audio messages, emojis, and PDFs
- Use group texting to stay in touch with friends and family
- Automatically respond to calls and texts with Auto-Reply
- Assign custom ring and text tones to your TextFree number
- Personalize your experience with custom wallpapers
- No phone? No problem—get TextFree on your iPod, iPad, or computer.
- Access 24/7 Customer Support
TEXTFREE PLUS FEATURES
- All standard TextFree features, plus…
- Unlock verification shortcodes to validate online accounts and apps
- Enjoy an ad-free experience
- Reserve your phone number to prevent it from expiring
- Change your phone number as often as needed
- Silence spam & send it to voicemail
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is TextFree really free?
Yes—your number, texting, and calling are all free. TextFree is ad-supported, which is how we're able to offer it at no cost, but if you'd rather go ad-free (and get more features), TextFree Plus has you covered.
Does TextFree give you a real phone number?
A TextFree number is a dialable U.S. or Canadian phone number with its own area code. It runs over Wi-Fi or data rather than a traditional carrier plan, but works just like one for texting and calling.
Does TextFree work without a phone plan?
Yes. TextFree runs on Wi-Fi or mobile data—no carrier required. As long as you have an internet connection, you're good to go.
Is TextFree private and secure?
TextFree doesn't sell or share your information with third parties or use your messages to train AI models. Our servers are encrypted to keep your data secure. For full details, see our privacy policy.
Who is TextFree for?
TextFree is for anyone who needs a phone number without the cost or commitment of a carrier plan—plus anyone who wants a second number for side hustles, online marketplaces, or anywhere they'd rather not share their real digits.
Do I need to provide a government-issued ID to create a TextFree account?
No. You do not need to submit a government-issued ID to sign up for TextFree. To create an account, you'll need to verify your email address or sign in using a supported Google or Apple account.
Download TextFree today and try it!

bluejetty:00130183:ios.description:
Diamond Finder for Minecraft allows you to easily locate valuable ores, biomes and structures in your Minecraft world, including diamonds, emeralds, gold, iron, lapis, redstone, and coal. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, this app will help you find the resources you need to progress through the game.
Compatible with all platforms including Bedrock edition and Java edition, and all devices including Mac, iOS, PS4, Xbox, and PC, this app supports Minecraft on any device that runs it. Using the app is simple - just type in your world seed and coordinates, and the app will show you the exact locations of the veins of diamond ore deep underground. With this information, you can plan your mining strategy to retrieve the valuable resources while avoiding the dangers of the game such as creepers, skeletons, and zombies.
Whether you're looking to speed run Minecraft or just want to explore the game, the app is perfect for players of all levels. The "seeds" tab also provides a selection of popular Minecraft seeds to help you discover new and exciting worlds to play the game in.
Upgrade your Minecraft gameplay with the Diamond Finder App - the ultimate tool for locating resources in your Minecraft world.

bluejetty:00088326:ios.name: Zola Baby Registry
bluejetty:00088326:ios.summary:
Meet Zola Baby, the baby registry that has it all.
With the Zola Baby app, you can register for everything you need to prepare for your little one’s arrival. Shop a curated selection of the most popular gifts from the most trusted brands.
bluejetty:00088326:ios.description:
Meet Zola Baby, the baby registry that has it all.
With the Zola Baby app, you can register for everything you need to prepare for your little one’s arrival. Shop a curated selection of the most popular gifts from the most trusted brands. Add gifts from any other store onto one registry that’s easy for your friends and family to shop. Add zero-fee cash funds for everything from diapers to college tuition. Get a personalized checklist to make sure you have everything you need. Plus, count down the exciting weeks until your little one’s arrival! 
With the free Zola Baby app: 
• Shop the gifts you really need: We’ve gathered all the best gifts from the brands you love and trust in one place so you don’t have to spend hours shopping around.
• Add gifts from any other store: Yup, ANY other store, big or small. We make it easy for all your gifts to live in one place so your loved ones can shop with ease.
• Add zero-fee cash funds: You can start a diaper fund, set money aside to extend your parental leave, or get a head start on your little one’s college fund. You choose when to send the cash to your bank account.
• Enjoy a 15% expected arrival discount: Use your discount 60 days before your little one’s arrival and 30 days after, so you have absolutely everything you need, when you need it.
• Count down the weeks until your little one’s arrival: Add a countdown to your phone so you can savor every moment of this journey, and track baby’s growth along the way.
• Get a personalized checklist: We’ll make sure you have everything you need to be as prepared as possible when your little one arrives.
• Choose when your gifts ship: Taking a babymoon? Renovating the nursery? You decide when to ship your gifts so they arrive when you’re ready. 
• Exchange gifts before they ship: The last thing you need when preparing for your little one is lugging returns back to the store. Exchange your gifts online before they ship and save time (and stress!).
• Use your Zola credit on Zola Baby: Have some credits leftover from your wedding registry? Use them on Zola Baby quickly and easily. 
• Get one-on-one customer support: Our baby registry experts are standing by to help you with any and all of your questions, from how to manage your registry to choosing your stroller.
• Baby brain already kicked in? Enter: Instant Registry: With a single click, automatically add our most-popular picks to your wishlist in under 60 seconds. 
Who We Are 
Zola Baby is the ultimate baby registry for today’s parents. Starting a family looks different for everyone, and we’re proud to support all parents on this exciting and deeply personal journey. We strive to make it as easy as possible for expecting parents to feel prepared for their little one’s arrival, and we’re there every step of the way with guidance, support, and compassion.

DFCU Mobile™ puts 24/7 account access in the palm of your hand. Use DFCU mobile to easily and securely manage your DFCU Financial accounts anytime, anywhere. Check your account balances, deposit checks, transfer funds, pay bills, find the nearest branch location and more. 
You must be enrolled in DFCU Online to use this app. To enroll, launch the app and choose “New Enrollment” (located below the Log In button). 
DFCU Mobile provides: 
•A consistent, intuitive and secure experience. 
•Access to your account balances and history. 
•Funds Transfers between your accounts and those of other DFCU Online users. 
•Mobile Deposit. 
•Expanded eDocuments Center including statements from as far back as 7 years. 
•Messaging which allows you to securely communicate with us electronically. 
•Customized alerts you can set to notify you by text, email, and phone about important account information. 
•Touch authentication for Touch ID-enabled Apple iOS devices. 
•Face ID authentication for Face ID-enabled Apple iOS devices. 
•Faster log-in through your updated app.

bluejetty:00016214:ios.description:
Plunge into a fairy world of coloring with the Coloring Book for Me app, a perfect tool to relax and release your inner artist. Find joy and color your stress away!
Coloring Book for Me brings you:
- Custom mandalas: bring to life your unique designs in the mandala creation mode
- 'Color with a photo’ feature: experience a new way of coloring - apply a photo snapped in real-time or from your Camera Roll to uncolored cells on a coloring page and create a matchless work of art in a few taps
- 20+ categories of unique coloring pages from talented illustrators - with collection updates, you’ll always have something new to color
- Your own coloring pictures in the app: import outline drawings from your camera or Camera Roll to color them right on your device
- 40+ beautiful preset Solid and Gradient color palettes: choose one that fits best and fill a picture with colors from soft and muted to bold and lively
- Custom palettes: combine any colors you like to create a matchless work of art
- Various coloring tools: color in a simple way with the tap-to-color tool or have real coloring experience using markers and pencils
- A wonderful collection of relaxing sounds
- Post-editing effects: add a vignette effect, change contours, apply textures & filters
- Apple Pencil support: enjoy an easy and intuitive process of coloring on the crisp screen of iPad Pro.
Upgrade to the Premium version and get unlimited access to 
- an expansive and constantly growing collection of wonderful coloring pages for adults and even more palettes, 
- relaxing sounds & textures. 
Don’t limit your creative talents, choose from any image you'd like and color it in the most enjoyable way - without ads and watermarks!

* Notifications - so that you will be kept informed when New or Special pictures are added to the app.
* Photos - so that you can import your pictures for coloring and save your artwork;
* Camera - so that you can capture your own coloring pages to color them in the app.

bluejetty:00061336:ios.name: Jira Data Center
bluejetty:00061336:ios.summary:
The Jira Data Center and Server app lets teams who use Jira collaborate and give updates from anywhere.
This mobile app works with self-hosted:
- Jira Core (Server) and Jira Software (Data Center and Server) instances running Jira 8.3 and
bluejetty:00061336:ios.description:
The Jira Data Center and Server app lets teams who use Jira collaborate and give updates from anywhere.
This mobile app works with self-hosted:
- Jira Core (Server) and Jira Software (Data Center and Server) instances running Jira 8.3 and later
- Jira Service Management (Data Center and Server) instances running versions 4.15 and later.
For more info on how to use this app, see: https://go.atlassian.com/jira-dc-server-app.
With the app, you can:
- Manage projects from your fingertips
- Respond to project updates and important conversations
- View, create, and edit your issues, wherever you are
- View boards and transition issues to get the work moving
- Collaborate on the go by commenting, and mentioning your teammates
- Get real-time notifications about activity in your projects
Do I need the this app or the Cloud app?
To check if this is the right app for your site, open Jira in your browser and go to Help ( ? ) > About Jira. If your Jira version number is 8.3 or later you can use this app! If your version number starts with 1000, then you'll need the Jira cloud app instead.
Feedback
Shake your device with the app open to message the product team. We want to hear from you!
Prior to login, we collect some anonymous info from the app to help us make sure the app is working well.

Collect those birds and beat the scores of friends and p
bluejetty:00063314:ios.description:
Endless Doves – Collect Doves, Don't Crash!
He dreams of flying... Who is he? Why does he crash? How does he fly? That doesn't matter! What does matter is obsessive bird collecting!
Collect those birds and beat the scores of friends and people you don't even know! Brag on the usual social network hangouts then collect even more birds and do it all over again!
Don't like doves? We have you covered. Using the doves as a crude form of currency (Dove Dollars?) you can unlock a whole other host of flying things. Like Pelicans and Chickens!... shhhh.
It's based on our hit game '8 bit Doves' which is level based and not free. If you like this there's a good chance you will like that too so skip coffee one day and buy that instead!
You play with only two buttons which means they are big and easy to hit with your thumbs. But then it's one of those super hard 'argh I hate this... but must have one more go' type of games too so yeah.
That's about it. If you read this far you may as well hit the download button. enjoy :) or don't... it's free so you can always delete it again.

Raenest (formerly Geegpay) – Your Global Money Partner
Raenest is your all-in-one global finance platform that helps you receive, spend, send, invest, and manage your money across borders, effortlessly.
Wherever you are, Raenest empowers you with the financial tools you need to belong in the global economy.
Join 1,000,000+ global citizens - individuals, freelancers, creators, remote workers, and entrepreneurs already managing their finances with Raenest.
What You Can Do With Raenest
Open Global Accounts (USD, GBP, EUR)
Create global accounts in your name in minutes. No paperwork.
Receive payments from over 190 countries, including clients, marketplaces, families, and employers worldwide.
Convert currencies instantly at real-time market rates with zero hidden fees.
Save and hold money in global currencies.
Spend Freely with USD Virtual & Physical Cards
Create cards that work everywhere - Google Ads, Meta, Apple, Upwork, AWS, AliExpress, Namecheap, and more.
Add to Google Pay for contactless payment
Spend globally with no surprise charges or restrictions.
Make Global Transfers to 50+ Countries
Send money worldwide instantly and securely.
Enjoy affordable fees and transparent exchange rates.
Perfect for freelancers, families, and businesses with cross-border needs.
Buy US Stocks & ETFs
Invest in top U.S companies like Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia.
Diversify with ETFs and earn dividends in USD.
Build long-term wealth.
Use Stablecoins (USDC & USDT)
Receive global payments in USDC or USDT — fast, secure, and borderless.
Supports Ethereum, TRON, Solana, and Polygon.
Converts easily to USD
Perfect for freelancers and businesses that favours receiving payments worldwide speedily.
Send Invoices. Get Paid Instantly.
Generate professional invoices in seconds.
Accept payments from multiple methods: bank transfer, card, and more.
Automate recurring payments and get paid faster.
Built for a Global Generation
Whether you’re in Lagos, New York, Nairobi, Paris, Accra, or London, Raenest keeps you connected to your money, across continents.
Transparent Fees
Instant Transactions
Trusted by 1,000,000+ Users
Regulated & Secure
Your Global Partner for Every Step
From receiving to saving, spending, sending, investing, and growing, Raenest is more than a fintech. It’s your partner in financial success.

bluejetty:00088521:ios.description:
Tor Browser VPN helps protect your internet connection on iPhone and iPad with WireGuard. Connect in one tap and choose from server locations across 12 countries: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Ireland, India, Japan, Sweden, Singapore, the United States, and South Africa.
WHY USE TOR BROWSER VPN
• WireGuard-based encrypted VPN tunnel
• One-tap connection and automatic server selection
• Server search and country selection
• Protection on public Wi-Fi and mobile networks
• IP address masking while connected
• Lightweight, battery-efficient VPN protocol
• Automatic server health monitoring for improved availability
• Built-in browser for convenient private browsing
• Native iPhone and iPad support
PRIVACY AND SECURITY
When connected, Tor Browser VPN routes your device's internet traffic through an encrypted WireGuard tunnel to the selected VPN server. A VPN can improve connection privacy, but it does not make you anonymous or prevent every form of tracking. Please review our Privacy Policy before use.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Some VPN locations and premium features require an active auto-renewable subscription. Available plans and prices are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
Support: https://approtic.in
Contact: abhinay@approtic.in

Play Chess – Learn, Train & Challenge with the Ultimate Chess App
Take your chess to the next level with the ultimate chess app for iPhone and iPad. Whether you’re a beginner learning chess, an intermediate player looking to improve, or an advanced competitor training like a grandmaster, our app has everything you need.
Powered by an award-winning chess engine, it feels like you’re playing against a real opponent – not just a computer. With 100 skill levels, automatic ELO rating tracking, and personalized difficulty that adapts to your style, you’ll always find the perfect challenge.
No accounts. No fuss. Just download and start playing chess instantly.
Key Features
World Chess Champion Software 2026 Award Winner using Ginkgo
150 difficulty levels – from beginner to grandmaster strength
Adaptive chess engine – plays like a human and adjusts to your skill
ELO rating calculator – track your progress and growth
Powerful AI – ranked 4th in the World Microcomputer Chess Championship

Database of famous chess games – study, replay, and analyze the masters
Multiple modes – Classic, Blitz, Training, Two-Player, and Analysis Mode
Custom boards and sets – from traditional chess book style to modern themes
Full chess rules supported – castling, en passant, pawn promotion, and more
Minimal ads, no login required – play chess instantly without interruptions
Whether you enjoy casual games, serious training, or fast-paced blitz chess, this app has you covered. Always challenging, sometimes aggressive, and never boring – just like real chess should be.
Perfect for:
Beginners who want to learn chess step by step
Casual players who enjoy fun, relaxing games
Competitive players who want to train like a grandmaster
Puzzle lovers who want to sharpen their tactics

bluejetty:00177770:ios.description:
The Ultimate Basketball Game
Put on your sneakers, and get ready to go onto the court in this brand new basketball game! Experience basketball like never before, in this fresh and easy to play basketball game. In Mini Basketball you will enjoy a casual gameplay experience, while still remaining loyal to the original game. It’s time for you to get the crowds roaring in the arenas, score some amazing 3 pointers, and build the strongest team that ever existed!
Pick up and Play
Welcome to the first casual experience of basketball. Mini Basketball has a casual pick up and play feel that still remains true to the original sport. No need to waste time on endless mechanics, just pick it up and jump straight into the action
Build, Upgrade and Customize Your Team
In Mini Basketball you will be able to win players, from common to epic ones, and upgrade them to turn your team into the most feared opponents on any pitch. Not only can you build your team, but you will also be able to fully customize it to your image with more than 100 customizable options from:
Unique logos, jerseys, shorts, sneakers.
Personalize your gameplay experience by choosing the ball you prefer, mascots, cheerleaders and dunks!
Name your team
Win the rarest pieces of equipment and show them off!
Play through Different Tiers and Tournaments
Unique and original arenas and courts that will get bigger, louder, and more impressive as you progress through your basketball career. Several tournaments where you will go through playoff stages and win a trophy at the end of the road!
Whether it’s on your court, or in an international setting, every game will feel different. New and more impressive arenas are on their way, so keep an eye out for future updates.
Rule the World
Climb up the leaderboards to win amazing prizes and always be on top of the competition. Every week you will have a chance to move up the leagues, from the Brass League to the All-Stars League, so make sure that you grab those promotion spots by the end of the week to win bigger and better prizes!
--------------------------------------
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).
Contact us: 
support@miniclip.com

bluejetty:00168004:ios.summary: Once upon a time, in the mystical realm of Asgard, the World Tree Yggdrasil stood tall and proud, its branches reaching towards the heavens. The gods of Asgard, led by Odin, revered the magnificent tree, for it was the lifeline that connect
bluejetty:00168004:ios.description:
Once upon a time, in the mystical realm of Asgard, the World Tree Yggdrasil stood tall and proud, its branches reaching towards the heavens. The gods of Asgard, led by Odin, revered the magnificent tree, for it was the lifeline that connected their realm with the rest of the cosmos.
However, as the Twilight of the Gods descends, a colossal explosion engulfs the World Tree, causing it to burn and shatter, giving rise to fragments imbued with potent energy known as "The Sacred Flame" scattered throughout the vastness of the cosmos. In their unending journey, the exiles of the sacred realm stumble upon these shattered fragments, and some among them gain the power of the Flame, ascending as new gods.
But not all welcome the arrival of the new gods, especially those displaced, the old gods. And thus, a war spanning thousands of years, the "War of the Gods," erupts.
As the Chosen One, your destiny awaits on this legendary continent, where you shall forge your own tale of greatness...
-Features-
【Nordic Fantasy Open World】
Step into the world of Norse mythology and embark on your adventure beneath the mysterious, colossal World Tree. Accompanied by a brand-new realistic weather simulation system, where various weather conditions change in real-time, every step you take allows you to admire breathtaking scenery.
【Challenge Epic Bosses】
The bravest warriors will challenge the fiercest enemies! Cooperate with your team and defeat powerful, epic bosses!
【Lead The Global Combat】
Engage in the real-time extensive server-wide war, fighting for the honor of your alliance! Lead elite squads, hack your way through the battlefield, and let your fame echo throughout the world!
【Adventure With Valkyrie】
Forge deep bonds with Valkyries amidst thrilling adventures, mutually redeeming each other in times of peril!
【Customize Mythic Image】
The game employs the latest facial realism system, enabling you to finely customize facial features and even the texture of your character's skin. Unrestricted by skin color and body type, embark on your adventure in the image you prefer!
【Build Your Skill Tree】
Make strategic use of the skill tree system, customizing your exclusive skills for different combat scenes!

gnome-extensions:PRIME_Helper@z-ray.de.name: PRIME Helper
gnome-extensions:PRIME_Helper@z-ray.de.summary:
A GPU profile switcher designed to work with PRIME (prime-select). Fork of PRIME GPU Profile Selector.
Change to upstream:
- Some bug fixes
-- Icon selection in the widget
-- Better discover of the prime-select binary
- New features: (Available in Offload mode)
-- Run application on your dGPU right from within nautilus "Scripts - Run on nVidia GPU"
-- prime-run cli script to run apps on your dGPU from the terminal or as Steam launch option: "$HOME/.local/bin/prime-run %command%"
All changes are also merged with PRIME GPU Profile Selector but we have no control over whether it's updated on extension.gnome.org or not.
Therefore this extension exists.
